// ==UserScript==

// @name         TheFreshMaker

// @namespace    http://tampermonkey.net/

// @version      4.4.0

// @description  TheFreshMaker v4.4.0 — persistent Global/VIP chat tabs with heartbeat recovery plus isolated temporary claim tabs.

// @author       BF Helper + Grok

// @match        *://betfury.com/*

// @match        *://betfury.io/*

// @grant        GM_openInTab

// @grant        GM_setValue

// @grant        GM_getValue

// @grant        GM_deleteValue

// @require      https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/canvas-confetti@1.5.1/dist/confetti.browser.min.js

// @run-at       document-idle

// ==/UserScript==

(function() {

  'use strict';

  window.TFM_PILL_ONLY_MODE = true;

  const VERSION = '4.4.0';

  // Work out what job this browser tab owns before any managers start. The
  // marker is kept in both the URL hash and sessionStorage so SPA navigation
  // and a normal page reload cannot accidentally turn a helper into a
  // controller.
  const TFM_URL_PARAMS =
    new URLSearchParams(
      window.location.search
    );

  const TFM_HASH_PARAMS =
    new URLSearchParams(
      window.location.hash
        .replace(/^#/, '')
    );

  function readTabSession(
    key,
    fallback = ''
  ) {
    try {
      return sessionStorage
        .getItem(key) ||
        fallback;
    } catch (error) {
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  function writeTabSession(
    key,
    value
  ) {
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem(
        key,
        String(value)
      );
    } catch (error) {}
  }

  const markedChatRole =
    String(
      TFM_HASH_PARAMS.get(
        'tfmChatRole'
      ) ||
      TFM_URL_PARAMS.get(
        'tfmChatRole'
      ) ||
      ''
    ).toLowerCase();

  const markedGeneration =
    String(
      TFM_HASH_PARAMS.get(
        'tfmGeneration'
      ) ||
      TFM_URL_PARAMS.get(
        'tfmGeneration'
      ) ||
      ''
    );

  if (
    ['global', 'vip']
      .includes(markedChatRole) &&
    markedGeneration
  ) {
    writeTabSession(
      'tfmChatRole',
      markedChatRole
    );

    writeTabSession(
      'tfmChatGeneration',
      markedGeneration
    );
  }

  const sessionChatRole =
    readTabSession(
      'tfmChatRole'
    ).toLowerCase();

  const chatRole =
    ['global', 'vip']
      .includes(markedChatRole)
      ? markedChatRole
      : (
        ['global', 'vip']
          .includes(sessionChatRole)
          ? sessionChatRole
          : null
      );

  const chatGeneration =
    markedGeneration ||
    readTabSession(
      'tfmChatGeneration'
    );

  const markedClaimTab =
    (
      TFM_URL_PARAMS.get(
        'autoClaim'
      ) === 'true'
    ) ||
    (
      TFM_HASH_PARAMS.get(
        'tfmClaimTab'
      ) === '1'
    );

  if (markedClaimTab) {
    writeTabSession(
      'tfmClaimTab',
      '1'
    );
  }

  const TFM_TAB_CONTEXT =
    Object.freeze({
      chatRole,
      chatGeneration,
      claimTab:
        markedClaimTab ||
        readTabSession(
          'tfmClaimTab'
        ) === '1',
      controllerCandidate:
        !chatRole &&
        !markedClaimTab &&
        readTabSession(
          'tfmClaimTab'
        ) !== '1'
    });

  window.TFM_TAB_CONTEXT =
    TFM_TAB_CONTEXT;

  const SCHEMA_VERSION = 4;

  console.log(`[TheFreshMaker] Initializing v${VERSION} — v4 Core Architecture Active`);

  if (window.BF_HELPER_LOADED) return;

  window.BF_HELPER_LOADED = true;

  // ===== DISPOSABLE RESOURCES MANAGER =====

  class Disposables {

    constructor() {

      this.intervals = new Set();

      this.timeouts = new Set();

      this.observers = new Set();

      this.listeners = [];

    }

    addInterval(id) {

      this.intervals.add(id);

      return id;

    }

    addTimeout(id) {

      this.timeouts.add(id);

      return id;

    }

    addObserver(obs) {

      this.observers.add(obs);

      return obs;

    }

    addEventListener(el, event, fn, options) {

      el.addEventListener(event, fn, options);

      this.listeners.push({ el, event, fn, options });

      return () => el.removeEventListener(event, fn, options);

    }

    clear() {

      this.intervals.forEach(id => clearInterval(id));

      this.timeouts.forEach(id => clearTimeout(id));

      this.observers.forEach(obs => {

        try { obs.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}

      });

      this.listeners.forEach(({ el, event, fn, options }) => {

        try { el.removeEventListener(event, fn, options); } catch (e) {}

      });

      this.intervals.clear();

      this.timeouts.clear();

      this.observers.clear();

      this.listeners = [];

    }

  }

  // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====

  function throttle(fn, wait = 250) {

    let last = 0, timeout;

    return function(...args) {

      const now = Date.now();

      if (now - last >= wait) {

        last = now;

        fn.apply(this, args);

      } else {

        clearTimeout(timeout);

        timeout = setTimeout(() => {

          last = Date.now();

          fn.apply(this, args);

        }, wait - (now - last));

      }

    };

  }

  function safeRun(fn, label = 'task') {

    try {

      return fn();

    } catch (e) {

      console.error(`[BetFury Helper] Error in ${label}:`, e);

    }

  }

  function shuffle(arr) {

    const a = arr.slice();

    for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {

      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));

      [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];

    }

    return a;

  }

  function clamp(value, min, max) {

    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));

  }

  // ===== STORAGE WITH MIGRATION =====

  class Storage {

    static get(key, defaultValue = null) {

      try {

        const stored = GM_getValue(key);

        if (stored === undefined) {

          return defaultValue;

        }

        if (typeof stored === 'string') {

          try {

            return JSON.parse(stored);

          } catch (e) {

            return stored;

          }

        }

        return stored;

      } catch (e) {

        return defaultValue;

      }

    }

    static set(key, value) {

      try {

        GM_setValue(

          key,

          typeof value === 'string'

            ? value

            : JSON.stringify(value)

        );

      } catch (e) {

        console.error('[Storage] set error', e);

      }

    }

    static clear(key) {

      try {

        GM_deleteValue(key);

      } catch (e) {

        console.error('[Storage] clear error', e);

      }

    }

    static migrate() {

      const currentSchema = Storage.get('bf_schemaVersion', 0);

      if (currentSchema >= SCHEMA_VERSION) {

        return;

      }

      console.log(

        `[Storage] Migrating from schema ${currentSchema} to ${SCHEMA_VERSION}`

      );

      // Migration from 0->1: Validate stats shape

      if (currentSchema < 1) {

        const stats = Storage.get('bf_stats', {});

        if (typeof stats.coinsWon !== 'number') {

          stats.coinsWon = 0;

        }

        if (typeof stats.boxesClaimed !== 'number') {

          stats.boxesClaimed = 0;

        }

        if (typeof stats.coindropsSniped !== 'number') {

          stats.coindropsSniped = 0;

        }

        Storage.set('bf_stats', stats);

      }

      // Migration from 1->2: Ensure positions are clamped

      if (currentSchema < 2) {

        const positions = Storage.get(

          'bf_spritePositions',

          {}

        );

        Object.keys(positions).forEach(key => {

          const pos = positions[key];

          if (

            typeof pos.x !== 'number' ||

            typeof pos.y !== 'number'

          ) {

            delete positions[key];

          } else {

            positions[key] = {

              x: Math.max(0, pos.x),

              y: Math.max(0, pos.y)

            };

          }

        });

        Storage.set(

          'bf_spritePositions',

          positions

        );

      }

      // Migration from 2->3: enrich stats and UI/event defaults

      if (currentSchema < 3) {

        const stats = {

          ...DEFAULTS.stats,

          ...(Storage.get('bf_stats', {}) || {})

        };

        if (!stats.sessionStart) {

          stats.sessionStart = Date.now();

        }

        Storage.set('bf_stats', stats);

        if (

          Storage.get('bf_debugMode', undefined) === undefined

        ) {

          Storage.set(

            'bf_debugMode',

            DEFAULTS.debugMode

          );

        }

        if (!Storage.get('bf_uiSettings', null)) {

          Storage.set(

            'bf_uiSettings',

            DEFAULTS.uiSettings

          );

        }

        if (!Storage.get('bf_visuals', null)) {

          Storage.set(

            'bf_visuals',

            DEFAULTS.visuals

          );

        }

      }

      Storage.set(

        'bf_schemaVersion',

        SCHEMA_VERSION

      );

    }

  }

  Storage.migrate();

  class DebugLogger {

    constructor(limit = 300) {

      this.limit = limit;

      this.entries = [];

    }

    log(type, message, data = null) {

      const entry = {

        time: Date.now(),

        type,

        message,

        data

      };

      this.entries.push(entry);

      if (this.entries.length > this.limit) {

        this.entries.splice(

          0,

          this.entries.length - this.limit

        );

      }

      if (settings.get('debugMode')) {

        console.log(

          `[TheFreshMaker ${type}] ${message}`,

          data ?? ''

        );

      }

      return entry;

    }

    get(limit = this.limit) {

      return this.entries.slice(-limit);

    }

    clear() {

      this.entries.length = 0;

    }

    export() {

      return JSON.stringify(

        this.entries,

        null,

        2

      );

    }

  }

  const debugLogger = new DebugLogger();

  class SettingsBackupManager {

    static snapshot() {

      const payload = {

        version: VERSION,

        schema: SCHEMA_VERSION,

        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),

        settings: settings.data

      };

      Storage.set(

        'bf_backup_latest',

        payload

      );

      return payload;

    }

    static exportText() {

      return JSON.stringify(

        this.snapshot(),

        null,

        2

      );

    }

    static importText(text) {

      const payload = JSON.parse(text);

      if (

        !payload ||

        typeof payload.settings !== 'object'

      ) {

        throw new Error(

          'Invalid TheFreshMaker backup'

        );

      }

      Object.entries(

        payload.settings

      ).forEach(([key, value]) => {

        settings.set(

          key,

          value

        );

      });

      this.snapshot();

      return true;

    }

    static recover() {

      const backup = Storage.get(

        'bf_backup_latest',

        null

      );

      if (!backup?.settings) {

        return false;

      }

      Object.entries(

        backup.settings

      ).forEach(([key, value]) => {

        settings.set(

          key,

          value

        );

      });

      return true;

    }

  }

  // ===== EVENT SYSTEM =====

  class EventManager {

    constructor() {

      this.events = new Map();

    }

    on(event, callback) {

      if (!this.events.has(event)) {

        this.events.set(

          event,

          new Set()

        );

      }

      this.events

        .get(event)

        .add(callback);

      return () => this.off(

        event,

        callback

      );

    }

    once(event, callback) {

      const off = this.on(

        event,

        data => {

          off();

          callback(data);

        }

      );

      return off;

    }

    off(event, callback) {

      const set = this.events.get(event);

      if (!set) {

        return;

      }

      set.delete(callback);

      if (!set.size) {

        this.events.delete(event);

      }

    }

    emit(event, data = {}) {

      const set = this.events.get(event);

      if (!set) {

        return;

      }

      [...set].forEach(callback => {

        try {

          callback(data);

        } catch (e) {

          console.warn(

            '[TheFreshMaker Event Error]',

            event,

            e

          );

        }

      });

    }

    clear(event) {

      event

        ? this.events.delete(event)

        : this.events.clear();

    }

  }

  const eventManager = new EventManager();

  function debugLog(...args) {

    if (settings.get('debugMode')) {

      console.log(

        '[TheFreshMaker DEBUG]',

        ...args

      );

    }

  }

  function randomDelay(min, max) {

    return Math.floor(

      Math.random() *

      (max - min + 1)

    ) + min;

  }

  function safeQueryAll(selector) {

    try {

      return Array.from(

        document.querySelectorAll(selector)

      );

    } catch (e) {

      return [];

    }

  }

  function isElementValid(el) {

    try {

      return (

        !!el &&

        document.contains(el) &&

        el.offsetParent !== null

      );

    } catch (e) {

      return false;

    }

  }

  function isElementClickable(el) {

    if (

      !isElementValid(el) ||

      el.disabled ||

      el.offsetWidth <= 0 ||

      el.offsetHeight <= 0

    ) {

      return false;

    }

    const style = getComputedStyle(el);

    return (

      style.display !== 'none' &&

      style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&

      style.pointerEvents !== 'none' &&

      Number(style.opacity || 1) > 0

    );

  }

  const COINDROP_TEXT_EXACT = [

    'get coindrop'

  ];

  const COINDROP_TEXT_FALLBACK = [

    'claim coindrop',

    'collect coindrop',

    'receive coindrop',

    'coindrop',

    'get drop'

  ];

  const SUCCESS_WORDS = [

    'you win',

    'you won',

    'congratulations',

    'successfully claimed',

    'reward received',

    'claimed successfully',

    'coindrop claimed',

    'reward added'

  ];

  function normalizeText(value) {

    return String(value || '')

      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')

      .trim()

      .toLowerCase();

  }

  function parseRgb(value) {

    const match = String(value || '').match(

      /rgba?\((\d+)[, ]+(\d+)[, ]+(\d+)/i

    );

    return match

      ? {

          r: Number(match[1]),

          g: Number(match[2]),

          b: Number(match[3])

        }

      : null;

  }

  function isRedButton(el) {

    try {

      const style = getComputedStyle(el);

      const colours = [

        style.backgroundColor,

        style.borderTopColor,

        style.color

      ]

        .map(parseRgb)

        .filter(Boolean);

      return colours.some(

        ({ r, g, b }) =>

          r >= 130 &&

          r > g * 1.25 &&

          r > b * 1.25

      );

    } catch (e) {

      return false;

    }

  }

  function getButtonTextMatch(el) {

    const text = normalizeText(

      el?.textContent

    );

    if (

      COINDROP_TEXT_EXACT.includes(text)

    ) {

      return {

        type: 'exact',

        text,

        score: 100

      };

    }

    if (

      COINDROP_TEXT_FALLBACK.includes(text)

    ) {

      return {

        type: 'fallback-exact',

        text,

        score: 70

      };

    }

    if (

      text.includes('coindrop') &&

      /get|claim|collect|receive/.test(text)

    ) {

      return {

        type: 'keyword',

        text,

        score: 55

      };

    }

    return null;

  }

  async function naturalPointerSequence(el) {

    if (!isElementClickable(el)) {

      return false;

    }

    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();

    const target = HumanBehavior.mouseJitter(

      rect.left + rect.width / 2,

      rect.top + rect.height / 2,

      Math.min(8, rect.width / 5)

    );

    const fromX = Math.max(

      0,

      target.x + randomDelay(-90, 90)

    );

    const fromY = Math.max(

      0,

      target.y + randomDelay(-60, 60)

    );

    const path = HumanBehavior.curvedMousePath(

      fromX,

      fromY,

      target.x,

      target.y,

      randomDelay(90, 180)

    );

    for (const point of path.slice(-10)) {

      document.dispatchEvent(

        new MouseEvent('mousemove', {

          bubbles: true,

          cancelable: true,

          clientX: point.x,

          clientY: point.y

        })

      );

      await new Promise(resolve =>

        setTimeout(

          resolve,

          randomDelay(4, 12)

        )

      );

    }

    const options = {

      bubbles: true,

      cancelable: true,

      clientX: target.x,

      clientY: target.y,

      button: 0,

      buttons: 1

    };

    if (window.PointerEvent) {

      el.dispatchEvent(

        new PointerEvent(

          'pointerover',

          options

        )

      );

      el.dispatchEvent(

        new PointerEvent(

          'pointerenter',

          options

        )

      );

      el.dispatchEvent(

        new PointerEvent(

          'pointerdown',

          options

        )

      );

    }

    el.dispatchEvent(

      new MouseEvent(

        'mouseover',

        options

      )

    );

    el.dispatchEvent(

      new MouseEvent(

        'mouseenter',

        options

      )

    );

    el.dispatchEvent(

      new MouseEvent(

        'mousedown',

        options

      )

    );

    await new Promise(resolve =>

      setTimeout(

        resolve,

        randomDelay(38, 96)

      )

    );

    el.dispatchEvent(

      new MouseEvent('mouseup', {

        ...options,

        buttons: 0

      })

    );

    if (window.PointerEvent) {

      el.dispatchEvent(

        new PointerEvent('pointerup', {

          ...options,

          buttons: 0

        })

      );

    }

    el.click();

    if (window.PointerEvent) {

      el.dispatchEvent(

        new PointerEvent('pointerleave', {

          ...options,

          buttons: 0

        })

      );

    }

    return true;

  }

  function advancedClick(el) {

    if (!isElementClickable(el)) {

      return false;

    }

    naturalPointerSequence(el).catch(

      error => {

        console.warn(

          '[TheFreshMaker] natural click failed',

          error

        );

      }

    );

    return true;

  }

  function getSuccessSnapshot() {

    const texts = new Set();

    safeQueryAll(

      'div,span,p,h1,h2,strong,b,[role="alert"],[role="status"]'

    ).forEach(el => {

      const text = normalizeText(

        el.textContent

      );

      if (

        text &&

        text.length < 240 &&

        SUCCESS_WORDS.some(

          word => text.includes(word)

        )

      ) {

        texts.add(text);

      }

    });

    return texts;

  }

  function hasYouWinMessage(

    baseline = null

  ) {

    const current = getSuccessSnapshot();

    if (!baseline) {

      return current.size > 0;

    }

    return [...current].some(

      text => !baseline.has(text)

    );

  }

  class ClaimVerifier {

    constructor(button, baseline) {

      this.button = button;

      this.baseline =

        baseline ||

        getSuccessSnapshot();

      this.initialText = normalizeText(

        button?.textContent

      );

    }

    inspect() {

      if (

        hasYouWinMessage(this.baseline)

      ) {

        return {

          success: true,

          signal: 'new-success-message'

        };

      }

      if (

        !document.contains(this.button)

      ) {

        return {

          success: true,

          signal: 'button-removed'

        };

      }

      if (this.button?.disabled) {

        return {

          success: true,

          signal: 'button-disabled'

        };

      }

      const currentText = normalizeText(

        this.button?.textContent

      );

      if (

        this.initialText &&

        currentText &&

        currentText !== this.initialText &&

        !currentText.includes('coindrop')

      ) {

        return {

          success: true,

          signal: 'button-state-changed'

        };

      }

      return {

        success: false,

        signal: 'unconfirmed'

      };

    }

    async wait(

      timeoutMs = 2200,

      intervalMs = 120

    ) {

      const started = performance.now();

      while (

        performance.now() - started <

        timeoutMs

      ) {

        const result = this.inspect();

        if (result.success) {

          return result;

        }

        await new Promise(resolve =>

          setTimeout(

            resolve,

            intervalMs

          )

        );

      }

      return this.inspect();

    }

  }

  function setNativeValue(

    element,

    value

  ) {

    if (element.isContentEditable) {

      element.textContent = value;

      return;

    }

    const proto =

      element.tagName === 'TEXTAREA'

        ? HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype

        : HTMLInputElement.prototype;

    const descriptor =

      Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(

        proto,

        'value'

      );

    if (descriptor?.set) {

      descriptor.set.call(

        element,

        value

      );

    } else {

      element.value = value;

    }

  }

  function sendThankYou() {

    const selectors = [

      'input[placeholder*="message" i]',

      'textarea[placeholder*="message" i]',

      '[contenteditable="true"]',

      'div[role="textbox"]'

    ];

    const input = selectors

      .map(selector =>

        document.querySelector(selector)

      )

      .find(isElementValid);

    if (!input) {

      eventManager.emit(

        'THANK_YOU_SKIPPED'

      );

      return;

    }

    const messages =

      settings.get(

        'thankYouMessages'

      ) ||

      DEFAULTS.thankYouMessages;

    const message =

      messages[

        Math.floor(

          Math.random() *

          messages.length

        )

      ];

    setTimeout(() => {

      if (!isElementValid(input)) {

        return;

      }

      input.focus();

      setNativeValue(

        input,

        ''

      );

      input.dispatchEvent(

        new InputEvent('input', {

          bubbles: true,

          inputType:

            'deleteContentBackward',

          data: null

        })

      );

      let index = 0;

      const timer = setInterval(() => {

        if (!isElementValid(input)) {

          clearInterval(timer);

          return;

        }

        if (index >= message.length) {

          clearInterval(timer);

          setTimeout(() => {

            input.dispatchEvent(

              new KeyboardEvent(

                'keydown',

                {

                  key: 'Enter',

                  code: 'Enter',

                  bubbles: true

                }

              )

            );

            input.dispatchEvent(

              new KeyboardEvent(

                'keyup',

                {

                  key: 'Enter',

                  code: 'Enter',

                  bubbles: true

                }

              )

            );

            eventManager.emit(

              'THANK_YOU_SENT',

              { message }

            );

          }, randomDelay(650, 1200));

          return;

        }

        const current =

          input.isContentEditable

            ? input.textContent

            : input.value;

        setNativeValue(

          input,

          current + message[index++]

        );

        input.dispatchEvent(

          new InputEvent('input', {

            bubbles: true,

            inputType: 'insertText',

            data: message[index - 1]

          })

        );

      }, randomDelay(55, 130));

    }, randomDelay(900, 1600));

  }

  // ===== HUMAN BEHAVIOR ENGINE =====

  class HumanBehavior {

    static get randomVariation() {

      return (

        Math.random() +

        Math.random() +

        Math.random() +

        Math.random() -

        2

      ) * 0.5;

    }

    static gaussianDelay(

      base,

      variation = 0.3

    ) {

      const factor =

        1 +

        (

          this.randomVariation *

          variation

        );

      return Math.max(

        base * 0.6,

        base * factor

      );

    }

    static naturalDelay(

      min,

      max

    ) {

      const rand = Math.random();

      if (rand < 0.85) {

        return (

          min +

          Math.random() *

          (max - min)

        );

      }

      return (

        max +

        Math.random() *

        (max * 0.4)

      );

    }

    static mouseJitter(

      x,

      y,

      intensity = 2

    ) {

      const jitterX =

        x +

        (

          Math.random() - 0.5

        ) * intensity;

      const jitterY =

        y +

        (

          Math.random() - 0.5

        ) * intensity;

      return {

        x: jitterX,

        y: jitterY

      };

    }

    static curvedMousePath(

      fromX,

      fromY,

      toX,

      toY,

      duration

    ) {

      const steps =

        Math.floor(duration / 16);

      const controlX =

        fromX +

        (toX - fromX) / 2 +

        (

          Math.random() - 0.5

        ) * 100;

      const controlY =

        fromY +

        (toY - fromY) / 2 +

        (

          Math.random() - 0.5

        ) * 50;

      const positions = [];

      for (

        let i = 0;

        i <= steps;

        i++

      ) {

        const t = i / steps;

        const t1 = 1 - t;

        const x =

          t1 * t1 * fromX +

          2 * t1 * t * controlX +

          t * t * toX;

        const y =

          t1 * t1 * fromY +

          2 * t1 * t * controlY +

          t * t * toY;

        positions.push({

          x: Math.round(x),

          y: Math.round(y),

          delay: i * 16

        });

      }

      return positions;

    }

    static createMouseEvent(

      element,

      eventType = 'mousemove'

    ) {

      if (!element) {

        return;

      }

      const rect =

        element.getBoundingClientRect();

      const { x, y } =

        this.mouseJitter(

          rect.left +

            rect.width / 2,

          rect.top +

            rect.height / 2,

          3

        );

      try {

        const event =

          new MouseEvent(

            eventType,

            {

              bubbles: true,

              cancelable: true,

              clientX: x,

              clientY: y,

              screenX: x,

              screenY: y

            }

          );

        element.dispatchEvent(event);

      } catch (e) {}

    }

    static randomIdle(

      min = 2000,

      max = 8000

    ) {

      return this.naturalDelay(

        min,

        max

      );

    }

  }

  // ===== ACHIEVEMENTS =====

  class AchievementManager {

    static checkAchievements() {

      const stats =

        settings.get('stats') ||

        DEFAULTS.stats;

      const achievements =

        settings.get('achievements') ||

        {};

      Object.keys(

        ACHIEVEMENTS

      ).forEach(key => {

        if (achievements[key]) {

          return;

        }

        const ach =

          ACHIEVEMENTS[key];

        let progress = 0;

        if (

          key.startsWith('coins')

        ) {

          progress = stats.coinsWon;

        } else if (

          key.startsWith('boxes')

        ) {

          progress =

            stats.boxesClaimed;

        }

        if (

          progress >= ach.target

        ) {

          achievements[key] = {

            unlocked: true,

            date:

              new Date()

                .toISOString()

          };

          settings.set(

            'achievements',

            achievements

          );

          if (

            ach.tier &&

            ach.tier !== 'bronze'

          ) {

            console.log(

              '[Achievement] Unlocked: ' +

              ach.name

            );

            menuManager.showToast(

              '🏆 Achievement: ' +

              ach.name +

              ' - ' +

              ach.reward

            );

            Effects.showFireworks();

          }

          const currentSkin =

            settings.get(

              'menuSkin'

            );

          const tierOrder = [

            'default',

            'bronze',

            'silver',

            'gold',

            'diamond',

            'mystic',

            'cosmic',

            'ultra',

            'legend'

          ];

          const currentTierIndex =

            tierOrder.indexOf(

              currentSkin

            );

          const newTierIndex =

            tierOrder.indexOf(

              ach.tier

            );

          if (

            newTierIndex >

            currentTierIndex

          ) {

            settings.set(

              'menuSkin',

              ach.tier

            );

            if (

              menuManager.element

            ) {

              menuManager

                .applyMenuSkin();

            }

          }

        }

      });

    }

    static addCoinsWon(

      amount = 1

    ) {

      const stats =

        settings.get('stats') ||

        DEFAULTS.stats;

      stats.coinsWon =

        (stats.coinsWon || 0) +

        amount;

      settings.set(

        'stats',

        stats

      );

      this.checkAchievements();

    }

    static addBoxesClaimed(

      amount = 1

    ) {

      const stats =

        settings.get('stats') ||

      stats.boxesClaimed =

          stats.boxesClaimed ||

        ) + amount;

      settings.set(

      );

    static addCoindropsSniped(

    ) {

      const stats =

  // ===== AUDIO =====

  class AudioManager {

    constructor() {

      this.unlocked = false;

      this.init();

    }

    init() {

      const unlock = () => {

        if (!this.unlocked) {

          this.unlocked = true;

          document.removeEventListener(

            'click',

            unlock

          );

          document.removeEventListener(

            'touchstart',

            unlock

          );

        }

      };

      document.addEventListener(

        'click',

        unlock,

        { once: true }

      );

      document.addEventListener(

        'touchstart',

        unlock,

        { once: true }

      );

    }

    async play(

      soundType = 'drop'

    ) {

      if (!this.unlocked) {

        return;

      }

      const url =

        settings.get(

          'soundUrls'

        )[soundType];

      if (!url) {

        return;

      }

      try {

        const audio =

          new Audio(url);

        audio.volume =

          settings.get(

            'volume'

          );

        audio.play().catch(

          () => {}

        );

      } catch (e) {}

    }

  }

  const audioManager =

    new AudioManager();

  class Effects {

    static showFireworks() {

      try {

        const colors = [

          '#26a69a',

          '#00bcd4',

          '#7c4dff',

          '#ffb74d',

          '#ff5252',

          '#80deea'

        ];

        const bursts = [

          {

            particleCount: 45,

            spread: 60,

            scalar: 1.0,

            origin: {

              x: 0.5,

              y: 0.45

            }

          },

          {

            particleCount: 30,

            spread: 80,

            scalar: 0.9,

            origin: {

              x: 0.3,

              y: 0.5

            }

          },

          {

            particleCount: 30,

            spread: 80,

            scalar: 0.9,

            origin: {

              x: 0.7,

              y: 0.5

            }

          }

        ];

        bursts.forEach(

          (burst, index) => {

            setTimeout(() => {

              confetti({

                particleCount:

                  burst.particleCount,

                startVelocity:

                  30 +

                  Math.random() *

                  20,

                spread:

                  burst.spread,

                ticks:

                  80 +

                  Math.floor(

                    Math.random() *

                    20

                  ),

                origin:

                  burst.origin,

                scalar:

                  burst.scalar,

                colors:

                  shuffle(colors)

                    .slice(0, 4)

              });

            }, index * 150);

          }

        );

      } catch (e) {}

    }

    static createPulse(element) {

      if (!element) return;

      const pulse =

        document.createElement('div');

      pulse.style.cssText =

        'position:fixed;' +

        'pointer-events:none;' +

        'border:2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.25);' +

        'border-radius:50%;' +

        'opacity:1;' +

        'z-index:10000;';

      const rect =

        element.getBoundingClientRect();

      pulse.style.width =

        element.offsetWidth + 'px';

      pulse.style.height =

        element.offsetHeight + 'px';

      pulse.style.left =

        rect.left + 'px';

      pulse.style.top =

        rect.top + 'px';

      document.body.appendChild(

        pulse

      );

      pulse.animate(

        [

          {

            transform: 'scale(1)',

            opacity: 0.9

          },

          {

            transform: 'scale(1.6)',

            opacity: 0

          }

        ],

        {

          duration: 600,

          easing:

            'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)'

        }

      );

      setTimeout(() => {

        if (pulse.parentNode) {

          pulse.remove();

        }

      }, 700);

    }

  }

  // ===== UI BUILDER =====

  class UIBuilder {

    static createButton(

      text,

      onClick,

      styling = ''

    ) {

      const btn =

        document.createElement(

          'button'

        );

      btn.textContent = text;

      btn.onclick = onClick;

      btn.style.cssText =

        styling +

        'padding:8px 12px;' +

        'border:none;' +

        'border-radius:8px;' +

        'cursor:pointer;' +

        'font-size:13px;' +

        'font-weight:700;' +

        'transition:all 0.18s ease;';

      return btn;

    }

    static createToggle(

      initialState,

      onChange

    ) {

      const container =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      container.style.cssText =

        'display:inline-flex;' +

        'background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02);' +

        'border-radius:22px;' +

        'padding:3px;' +

        'cursor:pointer;' +

        'user-select:none;' +

        'align-items:center;';

      const start =

        UIBuilder.createButton(

          'ON',

          () => {

            onChange(true);

            updateToggle(true);

          },

          'background:' +

            (

              initialState

                ? '#00bfa5'

                : 'transparent'

            ) +

            ';color:' +

            (

              initialState

                ? 'white'

                : '#bbb'

            ) +

            ';'

        );

      const stop =

        UIBuilder.createButton(

          'OFF',

          () => {

            onChange(false);

            updateToggle(false);

          },

          'background:' +

            (

              !initialState

                ? '#3a3a3a'

                : 'transparent'

            ) +

            ';color:' +

            (

              !initialState

                ? 'white'

                : '#bbb'

            ) +

            ';'

        );

      const updateToggle = state => {

        start.style.background =

          state

            ? '#00bfa5'

            : 'transparent';

        start.style.color =

          state

            ? 'white'

            : '#bbb';

        stop.style.background =

          !state

            ? '#3a3a3a'

            : 'transparent';

        stop.style.color =

          !state

            ? 'white'

            : '#bbb';

      };

      container.appendChild(start);

      container.appendChild(stop);

      return {

        element: container,

        update: updateToggle

      };

    }

    static createSlider(

      initialValue,

      onChange,

      min = 0,

      max = 1,

      step = 0.05

    ) {

      const input =

        document.createElement(

          'input'

        );

      input.type = 'range';

      input.min = String(min);

      input.max = String(max);

      input.step = String(step);

      input.value = String(

        clamp(

          Number(initialValue),

          min,

          max

        )

      );

      input.style.cssText =

        'width:100%;' +

        'height:6px;' +

        'cursor:pointer;' +

        'accent-color:#00bfa5;';

      input.addEventListener(

        'input',

        event => {

          const value = clamp(

            Number(event.target.value),

            min,

            max

          );

          onChange(value);

        }

      );

      return input;

    }

  }

  // ===== DRAGGABLE =====

  class Draggable {

    static attach(

      element,

      saveKey = null

    ) {

      let isDragging = false;

      let startX = 0;

      let startY = 0;

      let offsetX = 0;

      let offsetY = 0;

      const onPointerDown = e => {

        if (

          e.target &&

          (

            e.target.tagName ===

              'INPUT' ||

            e.target.tagName ===

              'BUTTON' ||

            e.target.tagName ===

              'SELECT'

          )

        ) {

          return;

        }

        isDragging = true;

        element.dataset.bfDragging =

          'true';

        startX = e.clientX || 0;

        startY = e.clientY || 0;

        offsetX =

          startX -

          element

            .getBoundingClientRect()

            .left;

        offsetY =

          startY -

          element

            .getBoundingClientRect()

            .top;

        element.style.cursor =

          'grabbing';

        element.style.zIndex =

          '10001';

      };

      const onPointerMove = e => {

        if (!isDragging) {

          return;

        }

        element.style.left =

          (

            e.clientX -

            offsetX

          ) + 'px';

        element.style.top =

          (

            e.clientY -

            offsetY

          ) + 'px';

      };

      const onPointerUp = () => {

        if (!isDragging) {

          element.dataset.bfDragging =

            'false';

          return;

        }

        isDragging = false;

        element.dataset.bfDragging =

          'false';

        element.style.cursor =

          'grab';

        element.style.zIndex =

          element.id === 'bf-pill'

            ? '10000'

            : '9999';

        if (!saveKey) {

          return;

        }

        const pos = {

          x: Math.max(

            0,

            element.offsetLeft

          ),

          y: Math.max(

            0,

            element.offsetTop

          )

        };

        if (saveKey === 'menu') {

          settings.set(

            'menuPosition',

            pos

          );

        } else if (

          saveKey === 'pill'

        ) {

          settings.set(

            'pillPosition',

            pos

          );

        } else {

          const positions =

            settings.get(

              'spritePositions'

            ) || {};

          positions[saveKey] = pos;

          settings.set(

            'spritePositions',

            positions

          );

        }

      };

      element.addEventListener(

        'pointerdown',

        onPointerDown

      );

      document.addEventListener(

        'pointermove',

        onPointerMove

      );

      document.addEventListener(

        'pointerup',

        onPointerUp

      );

      return {

        destroy: () => {

          element.removeEventListener(

            'pointerdown',

            onPointerDown

          );

          document.removeEventListener(

            'pointermove',

            onPointerMove

          );

          document.removeEventListener(

            'pointerup',

            onPointerUp

          );

        }

      };

    }

  }

  // ===== PILL BUTTON =====

  class PillButton {

    constructor() {

      this.element = null;

      this.badge = null;

      this.dragInstance = null;

      this.disposables =

        new Disposables();

      this.create();

      this.setupMutationObserver();

    }

    create() {

      const existing =

        document.getElementById(

          'bf-pill'

        );

      if (

        existing &&

        existing.parentNode

      ) {

        existing.remove();

      }

      const pill =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      pill.id = 'bf-pill';

      pill.setAttribute(

        'role',

        'button'

      );

      pill.setAttribute(

        'tabindex',

        '0'

      );

      const pillPos =

        settings.get(

          'pillPosition'

        ) ||

        DEFAULTS.pillPosition;

      pill.style.cssText = `

        position:fixed;

        width:60px;

        height:40px;

        left:${pillPos.x}px;

        top:${pillPos.y}px;

        background:

          linear-gradient(

            135deg,

            #141619 0%,

            #222428 100%

          );

        border-radius:12px;

        display:flex;

        align-items:center;

        justify-content:center;

        color:#dbeeea;

        font-weight:700;

        font-size:13px;

        cursor:grab;

        user-select:none;

        z-index:10000;

        box-shadow:

          0 8px 28px

          rgba(0,0,0,0.75);

        border:

          1px solid

          rgba(255,255,255,0.03);

        padding:0;

        margin:0;

      `;

      pill.addEventListener(

        'mouseenter',

        () => {

          pill.style.transform =

            'translateY(-2px) scale(1.03)';

          pill.style.boxShadow =

            '0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.82)';

        }

      );

      pill.addEventListener(

        'mouseleave',

        () => {

          pill.style.transform =

            'translateY(0) scale(1)';

          pill.style.boxShadow =

            '0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';

        }

      );

      const label =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      label.textContent = 'BF';

      label.style.cssText =

        'pointer-events:none;';

      const badge =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      badge.id =

        'bf-pill-badge';

      badge.style.cssText = `

        position:absolute;

        top:-6px;

        right:-6px;

        min-width:20px;

        height:20px;

        background:

          linear-gradient(

            90deg,

            #2ad5b3,

            #16a6b8

          );

        color:#001f1f;

        font-weight:900;

        font-size:11px;

        border-radius:999px;

        display:flex;

        align-items:center;

        justify-content:center;

        padding:0 6px;

        box-shadow:

          0 6px 16px

          rgba(0,0,0,0.65);

        pointer-events:none;

      `;

      pill.appendChild(label);

      pill.appendChild(badge);

      document.body.appendChild(

        pill

      );

      this.element = pill;

      this.badge = badge;

      if (this.dragInstance) {

        this.dragInstance.destroy();

      }

      this.dragInstance =

        Draggable.attach(

          pill,

          'pill'

        );

      pill.addEventListener(

        'click',

        e => {

          if (

            pill.dataset

              .bfDragging ===

            'true'

          ) {

            return;

          }

          e.stopPropagation();

          menuManager.toggle();

        }

      );

      this.updateBadge();

      this.disposables

        .addInterval(

          setInterval(

            () =>

              this.updateBadge(),

            900

          )

        );

    }

    updateBadge() {

      if (!this.badge || !this.element) {

        return;

      }

      const nextTime =

        settings.get('nextClaimTime');

      const sniperOn =

        settings.get('sniperEnabled');

      const running =

        settings.get('autoClaimRunning');

      if (

        nextTime &&

        nextTime > Date.now()

      ) {

        const seconds =

          Math.ceil(

            (

              nextTime -

              Date.now()

            ) / 1000

          );

        if (seconds >= 60) {

          this.badge.textContent =

            Math.floor(

              seconds / 60

            ) + 'm';

        } else {

          this.badge.textContent =

            seconds + 's';

        }

        this.badge.style.background =

          'linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd54f,#00bcd4)';

        this.badge.style.color =

          '#001f1f';

      } else {

        const s =

          sniperOn

            ? 'S'

            : '';

        const c =

          running

            ? 'C'

            : '';

        const text =

          s && c

            ? 'SC'

            : s || c

              ? s || c

              : '•';

        this.badge.textContent =

          text;

        this.badge.style.background =

          sniperOn || running

            ? 'linear-gradient(90deg,#2ad5b3,#16a6b8)'

            : 'linear-gradient(90deg,#5a5f6b,#3a3f4a)';

        this.badge.style.color =

          sniperOn || running

            ? '#001f1f'

            : '#e6eef6';

      }

      if (

        sniperOn &&

        running

      ) {

        this.element.style.background =

          'linear-gradient(135deg,#0f3130 0%,#143f3c 100%)';

      } else if (

        sniperOn &&

        !running

      ) {

        this.element.style.background =

          'linear-gradient(135deg,#2b2140 0%,#3b2b5a 100%)';

      } else if (

        !sniperOn &&

        running

      ) {

        this.element.style.background =

          'linear-gradient(135deg,#3a2a16 0%,#4b351e 100%)';

      } else {

        this.element.style.background =

          'linear-gradient(135deg,#141618 0%,#222428 100%)';

      }

    }

    destroy() {

      if (

        this.element &&

        this.element.parentNode

      ) {

        this.element.remove();

      }

      if (this.dragInstance) {

        this.dragInstance.destroy();

      }

      this.disposables.clear();

    }

    recreate() {

      this.destroy();

      this.create();

    }

    setupMutationObserver() {

      const obs =

        new MutationObserver(

          throttle(() => {

            if (

              !document.getElementById(

                'bf-pill'

              )

            ) {

              this.recreate();

            }

          }, 500)

        );

      obs.observe(

        document.body,

        {

          childList: true,

          subtree: true

        }

      );

      this.disposables

        .addObserver(obs);

    }

  }

  let pillButton = null;

  // ===== MENU MANAGER =====

  class MenuManager {

    constructor() {

      this.element = null;

      this.isOpen = false;

      this.dragInstance = null;

      this.disposables =

        new Disposables();

      this._expandedProfiles = {};

    }

    applyMenuSkin() {

      if (!this.element) {

        return;

      }

      const skinKey =

        settings.get(

          'menuSkin'

        ) || 'default';

      const skin =

        MENU_SKINS[skinKey] ||

        MENU_SKINS.default;

      this.element.style.background =

        skin.background;

      this.element.style.border =

        skin.border;

      this.element.style.boxShadow =

        '0 20px 60px rgba(3,8,12,0.85)';

      const header =

        this.element.querySelector(

          '#bf-menu-header'

        );

      if (header) {

        header.style.background =

          skin.headerBg;

        header.style.borderBottom =

          '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';

      }

      const title =

        this.element.querySelector(

          '#bf-menu-title'

        );

      if (title) {

        title.style.color =

          skin.titleColor;

      }

    }

    buildThemeEditor(

      themeName,

      themeData,

      isBuiltIn = false

    ) {

      const profileBox =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      profileBox.className =

        'bf-profile-dropdown';

      const profileHeader =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      profileHeader.className =

        'bf-profile-name';

      const icon =

        isBuiltIn

          ? '🎮'

          : '★';

      profileHeader.innerHTML =

        '<span>' +

        icon +

        ' ' +

        themeName +

        ' (' +

        themeData.sprites.length +

        ' images)</span>' +

        '<span style="font-size:12px;">▼</span>';

      const spriteList =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      spriteList.className =

        'bf-sprite-list';

      spriteList.style.display =

        'none';

      themeData.sprites.forEach(

        (spriteUrl, idx) => {

          const spriteItem =

            document.createElement(

              'div'

            );

          spriteItem.className =

            'bf-sprite-item';

          const urlDisplay =

            document.createElement(

              'div'

            );

          urlDisplay.className =

            'bf-sprite-item-url';

          urlDisplay.textContent =

            spriteUrl.substring(

              0,

              50

            ) +

            (

              spriteUrl.length > 50

                ? '...'

                : ''

            );

          urlDisplay.title =

            spriteUrl;

          const btnsContainer =

            document.createElement(

              'div'

            );

          btnsContainer.className =

            'bf-sprite-item-btns';

          const copyBtn =

            UIBuilder.createButton(

              'Copy',

              () => {

                navigator.clipboard

                  .writeText(

                    spriteUrl

                  );

                menuManager.showToast(

                  '✓ URL copied'

                );

              },

              'background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00bcd4,#00acc1);color:#012f2b;'

            );

          const editBtn =

            UIBuilder.createButton(

              'Edit',

              () => {

                const newUrl =

                  prompt(

                    'Enter new URL:',

                    spriteUrl

                  );

                if (newUrl) {

                  themeData.sprites[

                    idx

                  ] = newUrl;

                  if (isBuiltIn) {

                    const builtInThemes =

                      settings.get(

                        'builtInThemes'

                      ) || {};

                    builtInThemes[

                      themeName

                    ] = themeData;

                    settings.set(

                      'builtInThemes',

                      builtInThemes

                    );

                  } else {

                    const customThemes =

                      settings.get(

                        'customThemes'

                      ) || {};

                    customThemes[

                      themeName

                    ] = themeData;

                    settings.set(

                      'customThemes',

                      customThemes

                    );

                  }

                  menuManager.showToast(

                    '✓ Image updated'

                  );

                  menuManager.recreate();

                }

              },

              'background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7c4dff,#6a1b9a);'

            );

          const deleteBtn =

            UIBuilder.createButton(

              'Remove',

              () => {

                if (

                  confirm(

                    'Delete this image?'

                  )

                ) {

                  themeData.sprites

                    .splice(idx, 1);

                  if (isBuiltIn) {

                    const builtInThemes =

                      settings.get(

                        'builtInThemes'

                      ) || {};

                    builtInThemes[

                      themeName

                    ] = themeData;

                    settings.set(

                      'builtInThemes',

                      builtInThemes

                    );

                  } else {

                    const customThemes =

                      settings.get(

                        'customThemes'

                      ) || {};

                    if (

                      themeData.sprites

                        .length === 0

                    ) {

                      delete customThemes[

                        themeName

                      ];

                    } else {

                      customThemes[

                        themeName

                      ] = themeData;

                    }

                    settings.set(

                      'customThemes',

                      customThemes

                    );

                  }

                  menuManager.showToast(

                    '✓ Image removed'

                  );

                  menuManager.recreate();

                }

              },

              'background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff6b6b,#c92a2a);'

            );

          btnsContainer.appendChild(

            copyBtn

          );

          btnsContainer.appendChild(

            editBtn

          );

          btnsContainer.appendChild(

            deleteBtn

          );

          spriteItem.appendChild(

            urlDisplay

          );

          spriteItem.appendChild(

            btnsContainer

          );

          spriteList.appendChild(

            spriteItem

          );

        }

      );

      const addMoreBtn =

        UIBuilder.createButton(

          '+ Add Image',

          () => {

            const newUrl =

              prompt(

                'Enter image URL:'

              );

            if (newUrl) {

              themeData.sprites.push(

                newUrl

              );

              if (isBuiltIn) {

                const builtInThemes =

                  settings.get(

                    'builtInThemes'

                  ) || {};

                builtInThemes[

                  themeName

                ] = themeData;

                settings.set(

                  'builtInThemes',

                  builtInThemes

                );

              } else {

                    'customThemes'

            }

      spriteList.appendChild(

        addMoreBtn

if (!isBuiltIn) {
        const deleteThemeBtn = UIBuilder.createButton('Delete Theme', () => {
          if (confirm('Delete "' + themeName + '" theme?')) {
            const customThemes = settings.get('customThemes') || {};
            delete customThemes[themeName];

        spriteList.appendChild(deleteThemeBtn);
      }

      profileHeader.onclick = () => {
        if (spriteList.style.display === 'none') {
          spriteList.style.display = 'block';
          profileHeader.querySelector('span:last-child').textContent = '▲';
        } else {
          spriteList.style.display = 'none';
          profileHeader.querySelector('span:last-child').textContent = '▼';
        }
      };

      profileBox.appendChild(profileHeader);
      profileBox.appendChild(spriteList);

      return profileBox;
    }

          font-weight:700;
        ">
          Claim Sound (Thank you)
        </label>

        <input
          id="bf-sound-claim"
          type="url"
          placeholder="https://..."
          style="
            width:100%;

            background:rgba(20,22,24,0.9);
            color:#dbeeea;

              1px solid
              rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            border-radius:8px;

          "
        >

          font-size:12px;

        ">
          Win Sound (Victory)
        </label>

        <input
          id="bf-sound-ty"
          type="url"
          placeholder="https://..."
          style="
            width:100%;
            padding:8px;
            background:rgba(20,22,24,0.9);
            color:#dbeeea;
            border:
              1px solid
              rgba(255,255,255,0.03);

          "
        >

        <button
          id="bf-save-sounds"

              linear-gradient(

                #c92a2a
              );

            font-weight:700;

            border-radius:8px;
            border:none;
            cursor:pointer;
          "
        >
          Save Sounds
        </button>
      `;

      soundSection.appendChild(
        soundContent
      );

      // ===== RESET SECTION =====
      const resetSection =
        document.createElement(
          'details'
        );

      resetSection.style.cssText =
        'background:rgba(255,255,255,0.01);' +
        'padding:10px;' +
        'border-radius:8px;';

      resetSection.innerHTML = `
        <summary style="
          font-weight:800;
          color:#ff6b6b;
          cursor:pointer;
        ">
          ⚙️ Advanced
        </summary>
      `;

      const resetContent =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      resetContent.style.cssText =
        'margin-top:10px;' +
        'display:flex;' +
        'flex-direction:column;' +
        'gap:8px;';

      resetContent.innerHTML = `
        <button
          id="bf-reset-stats"
          style="
            background:
              linear-gradient(
                90deg,
                #ff9999,

              );

          "
        >
          Reset Stats
        </button>

        <button
          id="bf-reset-all"
          style="
            background:
              linear-gradient(
                90deg,

                #cc0000
              );
            color:white;
            font-weight:700;
            padding:8px;
            border-radius:8px;
            border:none;

          "
        >
          Reset ALL Settings
        </button>
      `;

      resetSection.appendChild(

      );

      content.appendChild(
        statsSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        sniperSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        claimSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        spritesToggleSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        rowSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        volumeSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        sizeSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        achievementsSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        savedImagesSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        customThemeSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        soundSection
      );

      content.appendChild(
        resetSection
      );

      menu.appendChild(header);
      menu.appendChild(content);

      document.body.appendChild(
        menu

      this.element = menu;

      this.applyMenuSkin();

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        menu.style.opacity = '1';

        menu.style.transform =
          'translateY(0) scale(1)';
      });

      this.setupEventListeners();

      if (this.dragInstance) {
        this.dragInstance.destroy();
      }

      this.dragInstance =
        Draggable.attach(
          menu,
          'menu'
        );

      const onOutsideClick =
        event => {
          if (!this.element) {
            return;
          }

          if (
            !this.element.contains(
              event.target
            ) &&
            event.target !==
              document.getElementById(
                'bf-pill'
              )
          ) {
            this.toggle();
          }
        };

      const onEscape =
        event => {
          if (
            event.key ===
            'Escape'
          ) {
            this.toggle();
          }
        };

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'mousedown',
          onOutsideClick
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'keydown',
          onEscape
        );
}

    setupEventListeners() {
      const sniperToggle = UIBuilder.createToggle(!!settings.get('sniperEnabled'), (state) => {
        settings.set('sniperEnabled', state);
        sniper.updateStatus();
        if (pillButton) pillButton.updateBadge();
      });
      const sniperToggleHolder = document.getElementById('bf-sniper-toggle');
      if (sniperToggleHolder) sniperToggleHolder.appendChild(sniperToggle.element);

      const spritesToggle = UIBuilder.createToggle(!!settings.get('spritesEnabled'), (state) => {
        settings.set('spritesEnabled', state);
        if (state) spriteManager.refresh();
        else spriteManager.destroyAll();
      });
      const spritesToggleHolder = document.getElementById('bf-sprites-toggle');
      if (spritesToggleHolder) spritesToggleHolder.appendChild(spritesToggle.element);

      const claimHolder = document.getElementById('bf-claim-startstop');
      if (claimHolder) {
        const startStopBtn = UIBuilder.createButton(settings.get('autoClaimRunning') ? 'Stop Auto-Claim' : 'Start Auto-Claim', () => {
          const running = settings.get('autoClaimRunning');
          if (running) {
            autoClaim.stop();
            startStopBtn.textContent = 'Start Auto-Claim';
          } else {
            autoClaim.start();
            startStopBtn.textContent = 'Stop Auto-Claim';
          }
          if (pillButton) pillButton.updateBadge();
        }, 'background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00bfa5,#00acc1);color:#012f2b;');
        claimHolder.appendChild(startStopBtn);
      }

      const profileSelect = document.getElementById('bf-profile');
      if (profileSelect) {
        profileSelect.value = settings.get('profile');
        profileSelect.onchange = (e) => settings.set('profile', e.target.value);
      }

      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('bf-theme');
      if (themeSelect) {
        themeSelect.value = settings.get('theme');
        themeSelect.onchange = (e) => {
          settings.set('theme', e.target.value);
          spriteManager.refresh();
        };
      }

      const volumeSliderHolder = document.getElementById('bf-volume-slider');
      if (volumeSliderHolder) {
        volumeSliderHolder.appendChild(
          UIBuilder.createSlider(
            settings.get('volume'),
            (val) => settings.set('volume', val)
          )
        );
      }

      const sizeHolder = document.getElementById('bf-size-slider');
      const sizeDisplay = document.getElementById('bf-size-display');

      if (sizeHolder) {
        const sizeInput = document.createElement('input');
        sizeInput.type = 'range';
        sizeInput.min = '60';
        sizeInput.max = '320';
        sizeInput.step = '5';
        sizeInput.value = settings.get('spriteSize') || DEFAULTS.spriteSize;
        sizeInput.style.cssText = 'width:100%;cursor:pointer;height:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#243447,#2b2f3a);border-radius:6px;';

        const updateSizeDisplay = (value) => {
          if (sizeDisplay) {
            sizeDisplay.textContent = value + 'px';
          }
        };

        updateSizeDisplay(sizeInput.value);

        sizeInput.oninput = (event) => {
          const value = clamp(
            Number(event.target.value),
            60,
            320
          );

          settings.set('spriteSize', value);
          updateSizeDisplay(value);
          spriteManager.refresh();
        };

        sizeHolder.appendChild(sizeInput);
      }

      // ===== CUSTOM THEME HANDLERS =====
      const addSpriteUrlBtn = document.getElementById('bf-add-sprite-url');
      const spriteUrlsHolder = document.getElementById('bf-sprite-urls');

      if (addSpriteUrlBtn && spriteUrlsHolder) {
        addSpriteUrlBtn.onclick = () => {
          const input = document.createElement('input');
          input.type = 'url';
          input.placeholder = 'https://file.garden/...';
          input.style.cssText = 'width:100%;padding:8px;background:rgba(20,22,24,0.9);color:#dbeeea;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;';
          spriteUrlsHolder.appendChild(input);
        };
      }

      const saveCustomThemeBtn = document.getElementById('bf-save-custom-theme');

      if (saveCustomThemeBtn) {
        saveCustomThemeBtn.onclick = () => {
          const themeNameInput = document.getElementById('bf-custom-theme-name');
          const themeName = themeNameInput ? themeNameInput.value : '';

          if (!themeName) {
            alert('Please enter a theme name');
            return;
          }

          const urlInputs = Array.from(
            spriteUrlsHolder.querySelectorAll('input[type="url"]')
          );

          const sprites = urlInputs
            .map(input => input.value)
            .filter(value => value);

          if (sprites.length === 0) {
            alert('Please add at least one image URL');
            return;
          }

          const customThemes = settings.get('customThemes') || {};

          customThemes[themeName] = {
            name: themeName,
            sprites
          };

          settings.set('customThemes', customThemes);
          this.showToast('✓ Theme "' + themeName + '" saved!');
          this.recreate();
        };
      }

      // ===== SOUND HANDLERS =====
      const soundDropInput = document.getElementById('bf-sound-drop');
      const soundClaimInput = document.getElementById('bf-sound-claim');
      const soundTyInput = document.getElementById('bf-sound-ty');
      const saveSoundsBtn = document.getElementById('bf-save-sounds');

      const soundUrls = settings.get('soundUrls') || {};

      if (soundDropInput) {
        soundDropInput.value = soundUrls.drop || '';
      }

      if (soundClaimInput) {
        soundClaimInput.value = soundUrls.claim || '';
      }

      if (soundTyInput) {
        soundTyInput.value = soundUrls.ty || '';
      }

      if (saveSoundsBtn) {
        saveSoundsBtn.onclick = () => {
          const newUrls = {
            drop: soundDropInput.value || DEFAULTS.soundUrls.drop,
            claim: soundClaimInput.value || DEFAULTS.soundUrls.claim,
            ty: soundTyInput.value || DEFAULTS.soundUrls.ty
          };

          settings.set('soundUrls', newUrls);
          this.showToast('✓ Sounds saved!');
        };
      }

      // ===== RESET HANDLERS =====
      const resetStatsBtn = document.getElementById('bf-reset-stats');
      const resetAllBtn = document.getElementById('bf-reset-all');

      if (resetStatsBtn) {
        resetStatsBtn.onclick = () => {
          if (confirm('Reset all stats?')) {
            settings.set('stats', DEFAULTS.stats);
            settings.set('achievements', DEFAULTS.achievements);
            this.showToast('✓ Stats reset');
            this.recreate();
          }
        };
      }

      if (resetAllBtn) {
        resetAllBtn.onclick = () => {
          if (confirm('Reset ALL settings? This cannot be undone!')) {
            Object.keys(DEFAULTS).forEach(key => {
              settings.set(key, DEFAULTS[key]);
            });

            this.showToast('✓ All settings reset');
            this.recreate();
          }
        };
      }
    }

    toggle() {
      if (this.isOpen && this.element) {
        this.element.style.opacity = '0';
        this.element.style.transform = 'translateY(6px) scale(0.98)';

        this.disposables.addTimeout(
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (this.element && this.element.parentNode) {
              this.element.remove();
            }

            if (this.dragInstance) {
              this.dragInstance.destroy();
            }

            this.element = null;
            this.disposables.clear();
          }, 260)
        );

        this.isOpen = false;
      } else {
        this.create();
        this.isOpen = true;
      }

      if (pillButton) {
        pillButton.updateBadge();
      }
    }

    updateClaimTimer() {
      if (!this.element || !this.isOpen) {
        return;
      }

      const timerElement = document.getElementById('bf-claim-timer');

      if (!timerElement) {
        return;
      }

      const nextTime = settings.get('nextClaimTime');

      if (nextTime && nextTime > Date.now()) {
        const seconds = Math.ceil(
          (nextTime - Date.now()) / 1000
        );

        const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);

        timerElement.textContent =
          'Next claim in ' +
          minutes +
          'm ' +
          (seconds % 60) +
          's';
      } else {
        timerElement.textContent = 'Ready to claim';
      }
    }

    showToast(message, duration = 1800) {
      safeRun(() => {
        const toast = document.createElement('div');

        toast.textContent = message;

        toast.style.cssText =
          'position:fixed;' +
          'left:50%;' +
          'top:10%;' +
          'transform:translateX(-50%);' +
          'background:rgba(6,8,10,0.95);' +
          'color:#bff4ea;' +
          'padding:10px 14px;' +
          'border-radius:10px;' +
          'z-index:20000;' +
          'box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);' +
          'font-weight:700;' +
          'opacity:0;' +
          'transition:opacity 180ms ease, transform 260ms ease;';

        document.body.appendChild(toast);

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          toast.style.opacity = '1';
          toast.style.transform =
            'translateX(-50%) translateY(0)';
        });

        this.disposables.addTimeout(
          setTimeout(() => {
            toast.style.opacity = '0';
            toast.style.transform =
              'translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px)';

            this.disposables.addTimeout(
              setTimeout(() => {
                if (toast.parentNode) {
                  toast.remove();
                }
              }, 260)
            );
          }, duration)
        );
      }, 'showToast');
    }

    recreate() {
      this.element = null;
      this.isOpen = false;
      this.create();
      this.isOpen = true;
    }
  }

  const menuManager = new MenuManager();

  // ===== LIFELIKE PROFILE SPRITE MANAGER =====
  class SpriteManager {
    constructor() {
      this.sprites = [];
      this.actors = [];
      this.theme = null;
      this.stationary = true;
      this.ensureStyles();
      this.init();
    }

    init() {
      this.refresh();
    }

    ensureStyles() {
      if (document.getElementById('tfm-lifelike-sprite-styles')) return;

      const style = document.createElement('style');
      style.id = 'tfm-lifelike-sprite-styles';
      style.textContent = `
        /* Pill-only chrome: companions and event effects stay active. */
        #tfm-live-hud,
        #tfm-stats-panel,
        #tfm-event-toast-container,
        #tfm-performance-badge,
        #tfm-integrity-badge {
          display: none !important;
        }

        .bf-companion {

          touch-action: none;

        .bf-companion[data-bf-dragging="true"] {
          transition: none !important;

        .bf-companion-motion {
          width: 100%;

          animation: none !important;
          will-change: transform;
        }

        .bf-companion.bf-mode-flyer .bf-companion-motion {

          animation-duration: 3.2s;

        }

          animation-duration: 1.1s;
        }

        .bf-companion.bf-companion-hopping .bf-companion-motion {
          animation: tfm-companion-hop 720ms cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1);
        }

        .bf-companion-image {
          display: block;
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          object-fit: contain;
          pointer-events: none;
          user-select: none;
          -webkit-user-drag: none;
          filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 13px rgba(0, 0, 0, .5));
          transform-origin: 50% 75%;
        }

        .bf-companion.bf-mode-flyer .bf-companion-image {
          filter:
            drop-shadow(0 10px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55))
            drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(114, 255, 226, .18));
        }

        @keyframes tfm-companion-breathe {
          0%, 100% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(0) rotate(0deg) scaleY(1); }
          50% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(-3px) rotate(-.7deg) scaleY(1.018); }
        }

        @keyframes tfm-companion-hover {
          0%, 100% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(0) rotate(-1deg); }
          50% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(-9px) rotate(1.2deg); }
        }

        @keyframes tfm-companion-walk {
          0%, 100% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(0) rotate(-.9deg); }
          50% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(-5px) rotate(.9deg); }
        }

        @keyframes tfm-companion-glide {
          0%, 100% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(0) rotate(-1.5deg); }
          50% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(-7px) rotate(1.5deg); }
        }

        @keyframes tfm-companion-hop {
          0%, 100% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(0) scaleY(1); }
          18% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(3px) scaleY(.94); }
          55% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(-24px) scaleY(1.03); }
          82% { transform: scaleX(var(--tfm-face, 1)) translateY(2px) scaleY(.97); }
        }

      (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(style);
