    randomBetween(min, max) {
      return min + Math.random() * (max - min);
    }

    clampPosition(value, min, max) {
      return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
    }

    generatePerimeterPositions(count, size) {
      const width = window.innerWidth || 1200;
      const height = window.innerHeight || 800;
      const padding = 24;
      const usableWidth = Math.max(1, width - size - padding * 2);
      const usableHeight = Math.max(1, height - size - padding * 2);
      const perimeter = Math.max(1, 2 * (usableWidth + usableHeight));
      const positions = [];

      for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) {
        let distance = (index / Math.max(1, count)) * perimeter;
        let x = padding;
        let y = padding;

        if (distance <= usableWidth) {
          x += distance;
        } else if ((distance -= usableWidth) <= usableHeight) {
          x += usableWidth;
          y += distance;
        } else if ((distance -= usableHeight) <= usableWidth) {
          x += usableWidth - distance;
          y += usableHeight;
        } else {
          distance -= usableWidth;
          y += usableHeight - distance;
        }

        positions.push({
          x: this.clampPosition(x, padding, Math.max(padding, width - size - padding)),
          y: this.clampPosition(y, padding, Math.max(padding, height - size - padding))
        });
      }

      return positions;
    }

    generateNaturalStart(theme, meta, index, count, actorWidth, actorHeight) {
      const viewportWidth = Math.max(320, window.innerWidth || 1200);
      const viewportHeight = Math.max(420, window.innerHeight || 800);
      const padding = 24;
      const usableWidth = Math.max(1, viewportWidth - actorWidth - padding * 2);
      const x = padding + usableWidth * ((index + 1) / (count + 1));
      let y;

      if (theme === 'dbz') {
        y = Math.max(padding, viewportHeight * .16 + (index % 2) * 56);
      } else if (meta.mode === 'walker') {
        y = viewportHeight - actorHeight - padding - (index % 2) * 16;
      } else {
        y = padding + Math.min(viewportHeight * .24, index * 34);
      }

      return {
        x: this.clampPosition(x, padding, Math.max(padding, viewportWidth - actorWidth - padding)),
        y: this.clampPosition(y, padding, Math.max(padding, viewportHeight - actorHeight - padding))
      };
    }

    getSpriteMeta(theme, index) {
      const entries = LIVELY_SPRITE_META[theme] || [];
      return entries[index] || {
        name: `Companion ${index + 1}`,
        nativeFacing: 'right',
        mode: 'static',
        sizeScale: 1,
        aspect: 1
      };
    }

    isLifelikeTheme(theme) {
      return theme === 'pokemon' || theme === 'dbz';
    }

    selectSpriteUrls(theme) {
      const customThemes = settings.get('customThemes') || {};
      const builtInThemes = settings.get('builtInThemes') || {};

      if (customThemes[theme]) return customThemes[theme].sprites || [];

      // The bundled Pokémon and Goku assets intentionally replace older saved
      // built-in URLs for these two profiles.
      if (this.isLifelikeTheme(theme) && THEMES[theme]) {
        return THEMES[theme].sprites || [];
      }

      if (builtInThemes[theme]) return builtInThemes[theme].sprites || [];
      return THEMES[theme]?.sprites || [];
    }

    refresh() {
      this.destroyAll();

      if (
        TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
          .chatRole ||
        TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
          .claimTab
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (!settings.get('spritesEnabled') || !document.body) return;

      this.ensureStyles();
      const theme = settings.get('theme');
      const spriteUrls = this.selectSpriteUrls(theme);
      if (!spriteUrls.length) return;

      this.theme = theme;
      const baseSize = Number(settings.get('spriteSize') || DEFAULTS.spriteSize);
      const storedPositions = settings.get('spritePositions') || {};
      const generatedPositions = this.generatePerimeterPositions(spriteUrls.length, baseSize);
      const updatedPositions = { ...storedPositions };

      spriteUrls.forEach((url, index) => {
        safeRun(() => {
          const meta = this.getSpriteMeta(theme, index);
          const height = Math.round(this.clampPosition(baseSize * Number(meta.sizeScale || 1), 36, 300));
          const width = Math.round(this.clampPosition(height * Number(meta.aspect || 1), 36, 380));
          const key = this.isLifelikeTheme(theme)
            ? `sprite_lifelike_v2_${theme}_${index}`
            : `sprite_${theme}_${index}`;
          const fallback = this.isLifelikeTheme(theme)
            ? this.generateNaturalStart(theme, meta, index, spriteUrls.length, width, height)
            : generatedPositions[index];
          const saved = storedPositions[key] || fallback;
          const position = {
            x: this.clampPosition(Number(saved.x || 0), 8, Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - width - 8)),
            y: this.clampPosition(Number(saved.y || 0), 8, Math.max(8, window.innerHeight - height - 8))
          };

          const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
          wrapper.className = `bf-sprite bf-companion bf-mode-${meta.mode}`;
          wrapper.dataset.companionKey = key;
          wrapper.dataset.bfDragging = 'false';
          wrapper.title = meta.name;
          wrapper.style.cssText += `
            width:${width}px;
            height:${height}px;
            left:${position.x}px;
            top:${position.y}px;
          `;

          const motion = document.createElement('div');
          motion.className = 'bf-companion-motion';
          motion.style.setProperty('--tfm-face', '1');

          const image = document.createElement('img');
          image.className = 'bf-companion-image';
          image.src = url;
          image.alt = meta.name;
          image.draggable = false;
          image.dataset.spriteKey = key;
          image.onerror = () => {
            wrapper.style.opacity = '.45';
            wrapper.title = `${meta.name} failed to load`;
          };

          motion.appendChild(image);
          wrapper.appendChild(motion);
          document.body.appendChild(wrapper);

          const actor = {
            wrapper,
            motion,
            image,
            meta,
            key,
            width,
            height,
            timer: null,
            pausedUntil: 0,
            dragInstance: null,
            onPointerDown: null,
            onPointerUp: null
          };

          actor.dragInstance = Draggable.attach(wrapper, key);
          actor.onPointerDown = () => {
            this.freezeActor(actor);
            this.clearActorTimer(actor);
          };
          actor.onPointerUp = () => {
            if (!this.actors.includes(actor)) return;
            actor.pausedUntil = 0;
          };
          wrapper.addEventListener('pointerdown', actor.onPointerDown);
          document.addEventListener('pointerup', actor.onPointerUp);

          this.actors.push(actor);
          this.sprites.push(image);
          updatedPositions[key] = position;

          if (!this.stationary && this.isLifelikeTheme(theme)) {
            this.queueActor(actor, 500 + index * 260 + this.randomBetween(0, 900));
          }
        }, `sprite-create-${index}`);
      });

      settings.set('spritePositions', updatedPositions);
    }

    clearActorTimer(actor) {
      if (actor?.timer) {
        clearTimeout(actor.timer);
        actor.timer = null;
      }
    }

    queueActor(actor, delay) {
      this.clearActorTimer(actor);
      if (this.stationary) return;
      actor.timer = setTimeout(() => this.performNextAction(actor), Math.max(80, delay));
    }

    freezeActor(actor) {
      if (!actor?.wrapper?.isConnected) return;
      const rect = actor.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      actor.wrapper.style.transition = 'none';
      actor.wrapper.style.left = `${Math.round(rect.left)}px`;
      actor.wrapper.style.top = `${Math.round(rect.top)}px`;
      actor.wrapper.classList.remove('bf-companion-moving');
      void actor.wrapper.offsetWidth;
    }

    setFacing(actor, deltaX) {
      if (Math.abs(deltaX) < 5) return;
      const travellingRight = deltaX > 0;
      let face = travellingRight ? 1 : -1;
      if (actor.meta.nativeFacing === 'left') face *= -1;
      actor.motion.style.setProperty('--tfm-face', String(face));
    }

    getAvoidRects() {
      const selectors = [
        '#bf-menu',
        '#bf-pill',
        '#tfm-live-hud',
        '#tfm-stats-panel',
        '#tfm-settings-panel',
        '#tfm-coin-scene',
        '#tfm-event-toast-container'
      ];

      return selectors
        .map(selector => document.querySelector(selector))
        .filter(element => element && element.offsetParent !== null)
        .map(element => element.getBoundingClientRect());
    }

    isSafeTarget(x, y, width, height) {
      const padding = 18;
      const candidate = {
        left: x - padding,
        top: y - padding,
        right: x + width + padding,
        bottom: y + height + padding
      };

      return !this.getAvoidRects().some(rect => !(
        candidate.right < rect.left ||
        candidate.left > rect.right ||
        candidate.bottom < rect.top ||
        candidate.top > rect.bottom
      ));
    }

    chooseTarget(actor) {
      const width = Math.max(320, window.innerWidth || 1200);
      const height = Math.max(420, window.innerHeight || 800);
      const margin = 18;
      const maxX = Math.max(margin, width - actor.width - margin);
      const maxY = Math.max(margin, height - actor.height - margin);
      const minY = actor.meta.mode === 'walker'
        ? Math.min(maxY, Math.max(margin, height * .52))
        : margin;

      let target = { x: margin, y: minY };
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 18; attempt += 1) {
        target = {
          x: this.randomBetween(margin, maxX),
          y: this.randomBetween(minY, maxY)
        };
        if (this.isSafeTarget(target.x, target.y, actor.width, actor.height)) break;
      }

      return target;
    }

    performNextAction(actor) {
      if (!actor?.wrapper?.isConnected) return;
      if (this.stationary) {
        this.freezeActor(actor);
        return;
      }
      if (document.hidden) {
        this.queueActor(actor, 1400);
        return;
      }
      if (actor.wrapper.dataset.bfDragging === 'true') {
        this.queueActor(actor, 500);
        return;
      }
      if (Date.now() < actor.pausedUntil) {
        this.queueActor(actor, actor.pausedUntil - Date.now() + 40);
        return;
      }

      const action = Math.random();
      if (action < .18) {
        actor.wrapper.classList.remove('bf-companion-moving');
        if (Math.random() < .42) {
          const currentFace = Number(actor.motion.style.getPropertyValue('--tfm-face') || 1);
          actor.motion.style.setProperty('--tfm-face', String(currentFace * -1));
        }
        this.queueActor(actor, this.randomBetween(1100, 3600));
        return;
      }

      if (action < .31 && actor.meta.mode === 'walker') {
        actor.wrapper.classList.remove('bf-companion-moving');
        actor.wrapper.classList.add('bf-companion-hopping');
        setTimeout(() => actor.wrapper?.classList.remove('bf-companion-hopping'), 760);
        this.queueActor(actor, this.randomBetween(1200, 2600));
        return;
      }

      const rect = actor.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      const target = this.chooseTarget(actor);
      const distance = Math.hypot(target.x - rect.left, target.y - rect.top);
      const speed = actor.meta.mode === 'flyer'
        ? this.randomBetween(55, 92)
        : this.randomBetween(34, 62);
      const duration = this.clampPosition((distance / speed) * 1000, 1500, 8800);

      this.setFacing(actor, target.x - rect.left);
      actor.wrapper.style.transition = `left ${Math.round(duration)}ms linear, top ${Math.round(duration)}ms ease-in-out`;
      actor.wrapper.classList.add('bf-companion-moving');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (!actor.wrapper?.isConnected) return;
        actor.wrapper.style.left = `${Math.round(target.x)}px`;
        actor.wrapper.style.top = `${Math.round(target.y)}px`;
      });

      this.queueActor(actor, duration + this.randomBetween(500, 2300));
    }

    pauseAll(duration = 1200) {
      const resumeAt = Date.now() + duration;
      this.actors.forEach(actor => {
        this.freezeActor(actor);
        actor.pausedUntil = Math.max(actor.pausedUntil, resumeAt);
        if (!this.stationary) {
          this.queueActor(actor, duration + 60);
        }
      });
    }

    rushToElement(element, duration = 760) {
      if (this.stationary) return;
      if (!element || !this.actors.length) return;
      const targetRect = element.getBoundingClientRect?.();
      if (!targetRect || (!targetRect.width && !targetRect.height)) return;

      const centerX = targetRect.left + targetRect.width / 2;
      const centerY = targetRect.top + targetRect.height / 2;
      const actor = this.actors.reduce((nearest, candidate) => {
        if (!nearest) return candidate;
        const a = candidate.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
        const b = nearest.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
        const aDistance = Math.hypot(a.left - centerX, a.top - centerY);
        const bDistance = Math.hypot(b.left - centerX, b.top - centerY);
        return aDistance < bDistance ? candidate : nearest;
      }, null);

      if (!actor) return;
      this.freezeActor(actor);
      const current = actor.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      const placeLeft = centerX > window.innerWidth / 2;
      const x = placeLeft
        ? targetRect.left - actor.width * .78
        : targetRect.right - actor.width * .22;
      const y = centerY - actor.height * .56;
      const targetX = this.clampPosition(x, 8, Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - actor.width - 8));
      const targetY = this.clampPosition(y, 8, Math.max(8, window.innerHeight - actor.height - 8));

      this.setFacing(actor, targetX - current.left);
      actor.wrapper.style.transition = `left ${duration}ms cubic-bezier(.16,.8,.25,1), top ${duration}ms cubic-bezier(.16,.8,.25,1)`;
      actor.wrapper.classList.add('bf-companion-moving');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        actor.wrapper.style.left = `${Math.round(targetX)}px`;
        actor.wrapper.style.top = `${Math.round(targetY)}px`;
      });
    }

    destroyAll() {
      this.actors.forEach(actor => {
        this.clearActorTimer(actor);
        actor.wrapper?.removeEventListener('pointerdown', actor.onPointerDown);
        document.removeEventListener('pointerup', actor.onPointerUp);
        actor.dragInstance?.destroy?.();
        actor.wrapper?.remove();
      });
      this.actors = [];
      this.sprites = [];
      this.theme = null;
    }
  }

  const spriteManager = new SpriteManager();

  // ===== SNIPER =====
  class Sniper {
    constructor() {
      this.observer = null;
      this.isRunning = false;
      this._lastWinAt = 0;
      this._lastClicked = {};
      this.disposables = new Disposables();
      this.init();
    }

    init() {
      this.setupObserver();
    }

    setupObserver() {
      if (this.observer) {
        this.observer.disconnect();
      }

      const throttledCheck = throttle(() => {
        if (settings.get('sniperEnabled')) {
          this.checkForButton();
        }
      }, 100);

      this.observer =
        new MutationObserver(
          throttledCheck
        );

      this.observer.observe(
        (document.body || document.documentElement),
        {
          childList: true,
          subtree: true,
          attributes: true
        }
      );

      this.disposables.addObserver(
        this.observer
      );
    }

    checkForButton() {
      if (!settings.get('sniperEnabled')) {
        return;
      }

      const buttons =
        document.querySelectorAll(
          'button, [role="button"], div[role="button"]'
        );

      for (const button of buttons) {
        try {
          const text =
            (
              button.textContent ||
              ''
            ).toLowerCase();

          const parentText =
            (
              button.parentElement
                ?.textContent ||
              ''
            ).toLowerCase();

          const isRelevantRoom =
            parentText.includes('global') ||
            parentText.includes('vip');

          const isCoindropButton =
            text.includes('get coindrop') ||
            text.includes('coindrop') ||
            text.includes('get drop') ||
            text.includes('claim');

          if (
            isCoindropButton &&
            isRelevantRoom
          ) {
            const buttonId =
              button.textContent +
              (
                button.className ||
                ''
              );

            if (
              !this._lastClicked[
                buttonId
              ] ||
              Date.now() -
              this._lastClicked[
                buttonId
              ] >
              8000
            ) {
              this.triggerSnipe(
                button,
                buttonId
              );
            }

            break;
          }
        } catch (error) {}
      }
    }

    triggerSnipe(button, buttonId) {
      if (!settings.get('sniperEnabled')) {
        return;
      }

      const delay =
        800 +
        Math.random() *
        400;

      this._lastClicked[
        buttonId
      ] = Date.now();

      console.log(
        `🕒 CoinDrop (Global/VIP) detected - claiming in ${delay.toFixed(0)}ms...`
      );

      this.disposables.addTimeout(
        setTimeout(
          () =>
            this.performNaturalClick(
              button
            ),
          delay
        )
      );
    }

    performNaturalClick(button) {
      this.disposables.addTimeout(
        setTimeout(() => {
          try {
            HumanBehavior.createMouseEvent(
              button,
              'mousemove'
            );

            if (Math.random() < 0.35) {
              this.disposables.addTimeout(
                setTimeout(
                  () =>
                    HumanBehavior.createMouseEvent(
                      button,
                      'mousemove'
                    ),
                  60
                )
              );
            }

            this.disposables.addTimeout(
              setTimeout(() => {
                HumanBehavior.createMouseEvent(
                  button,
                  'mouseenter'
                );

                this.disposables.addTimeout(
                  setTimeout(() => {
                    button.click();

                    HumanBehavior.createMouseEvent(
                      button,
                      'mouseleave'
                    );

                    Effects.createPulse(
                      button
                    );

                    audioManager.play(
                      'drop'
                    );

                    AchievementManager
                      .addCoindropsSniped();

                    this.disposables
                      .addTimeout(
                        setTimeout(
                          () =>
                            this.checkForWin(),
                          600
                        )
                      );
                  }, 90)
                );
              }, 110)
            );
          } catch (error) {}
        }, 50)
      );
    }

    checkForWin() {
      const bodyText =
        document.body.innerText ||
        '';

      const success =
        bodyText.includes('You Win') ||
        bodyText.includes('YOU WIN') ||
        bodyText.includes('won');

      if (
        success &&
        Date.now() -
        this._lastWinAt >
        5000
      ) {
        this._lastWinAt =
          Date.now();

        AchievementManager
          .addCoinsWon();

        Effects.showFireworks();

        audioManager.play('ty');
      }
    }

    updateStatus() {
      if (settings.get('sniperEnabled')) {
        this.setupObserver();
      } else if (this.observer) {
        this.observer.disconnect();
      }

      if (pillButton) {
        pillButton.updateBadge();
      }
    }
  }

  const sniper = new Sniper();
// ===== AUTO CLAIM =====
  class AutoClaim {
    constructor() {
      this.isRunning = false;
      this._timeoutId = null;
      this._lockKey = 'bf_lastTabOpenedAt';
      this.COOLDOWN =
        90 * 60 * 1000;
      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();
    }

    start() {
      if (this.isRunning) {
        return;
      }

      this.isRunning = true;

      settings.set(
        'autoClaimRunning',
        true
      );

      console.log(
        '[AutoClaim] Started'
      );

      const initialDelay =
        HumanBehavior.randomIdle(
          3000,
          8000
        );

      this.disposables.addTimeout(
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.performClaim({
            force: true
          });
        }, initialDelay)
      );
    }

    stop() {
      this.isRunning = false;

      settings.set(
        'autoClaimRunning',
        false
      );

      if (this._timeoutId) {
        clearTimeout(
          this._timeoutId
        );

        this._timeoutId = null;
      }
    }

    performClaim({
      force = false
    } = {}) {
      const lastTab =
        Storage.get(
          this._lockKey,
          0
        );

      const now = Date.now();

      const timeSinceLastTab =
        now - lastTab;

      if (
        !force &&
        lastTab > 0 &&
        timeSinceLastTab <
          this.COOLDOWN
      ) {
        const remainingMins =
          Math.ceil(
            (
              this.COOLDOWN -
              timeSinceLastTab
            ) / 60000
          );

        console.log(
          '[AutoClaim] BLOCKED - Wait ' +
          remainingMins +
          'm'
        );

        if (this._timeoutId) {
          clearTimeout(
            this._timeoutId
          );
        }

        const retryDelay =
          this.COOLDOWN -
          timeSinceLastTab +
          HumanBehavior
            .gaussianDelay(
              5000,
              0.5
            );

        this._timeoutId =
          this.disposables
            .addTimeout(
              setTimeout(() => {
                if (
                  this.isRunning
                ) {
                  this.performClaim();
                }
              }, retryDelay)
            );

        return;
      }

      console.log(
        '[AutoClaim] OPENING TAB'
      );

      Storage.set(
        this._lockKey,
        now
      );

      const claimUrl =
        window.location.origin +
        '/boxes/all?autoClaim=true#tfmClaimTab=1';

      const openDelay =
        Math.random() < 0.2
          ? HumanBehavior
              .gaussianDelay(
                2000,
                0.6
              )
          : HumanBehavior
              .gaussianDelay(
                500,
                0.3
              );

      this.disposables.addTimeout(
        setTimeout(() => {
          safeRun(() => {
            if (
              typeof GM_openInTab ===
              'function'
            ) {
              GM_openInTab(
                claimUrl,
                {
                  active: true,
                  insert: true,
                  setParent: true
                }
              );
            } else {
              window.open(
                claimUrl,
                '_blank'
              );
            }
          }, 'open-tab');
        }, openDelay)
      );

      if (this._timeoutId) {
        clearTimeout(
          this._timeoutId
        );
      }

      const variation =
        this.COOLDOWN *
        (
          0.9 +
          Math.random() *
          0.2
        );

      this._timeoutId =
        this.disposables
          .addTimeout(
            setTimeout(() => {
              if (
                this.isRunning
              ) {
                this.performClaim();
              }
            }, variation)
          );

      settings.set(
        'nextClaimTime',
        now + variation
      );
    }
  }

  const autoClaim =
    new AutoClaim();

  // ===== PERSISTENT GLOBAL / VIP CHAT TAB SUPERVISOR =====
  class ChatTabSupervisor {
    constructor() {
      this.roles = [
        'global',
        'vip'
      ];

      this.role =
        TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
          .chatRole;

      this.generation =
        TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
          .chatGeneration;

      this.heartbeatEveryMs =
        45 * 1000;

      this.staleAfterMs =
        3 * 60 * 1000;

      this.startupGraceMs =
        90 * 1000;

      this.controllerStaleMs =
        2 * 60 * 1000;

      this.controllerCheckEveryMs =
        30 * 1000;

      this.softRefreshEveryMs =
        10 * 60 * 1000;

      this.started = false;
      this.isController = false;
      this.retiring = false;
      this.chatReady = false;
      this.lastChatAttemptAt = 0;
      this.openHandles = {};
      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      const idSessionKey =
        this.role &&
        this.generation
          ? 'tfmChatTabId:' +
            this.generation
          : 'tfmControllerTabId';

      this.tabId =
        readTabSession(
          idSessionKey
        ) ||
        this.createId(
          this.role ||
          'controller'
        );

      writeTabSession(
        idSessionKey,
        this.tabId
      );
    }

    createId(prefix) {
      let randomPart = '';

      try {
        const bytes =
          new Uint32Array(2);

        crypto.getRandomValues(
          bytes
        );

        randomPart =
          Array.from(bytes)
            .map(value =>
              value.toString(36)
            )
            .join('');
      } catch (error) {
        randomPart =
          Math.random()
            .toString(36)
            .slice(2);
      }

      return [
        'tfm',
        prefix,
        Date.now()
          .toString(36),
        randomPart
      ].join('-');
    }

    desiredKey(role) {
      return 'bf_tfm_chat_desired_' +
        role;
    }

    statusKey(role) {
      return 'bf_tfm_chat_status_' +
        role;
    }

    getDesired(role) {
      return Storage.get(
        this.desiredKey(role),
        null
      );
    }

    getStatus(role) {
      return Storage.get(
        this.statusKey(role),
        null
      );
    }

    start() {
      if (
        this.started ||
        TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
          .claimTab
      ) {
        return;
      }

      this.started = true;

      if (this.role) {
        this.startChatHelper();
      } else if (
        TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
          .controllerCandidate
      ) {
        this.startControllerCandidate();
      }
    }

    startControllerCandidate() {
      const wake = () => {
        this.tryAcquireController();

        if (this.isController) {
          this.renewControllerLease();
          this.ensureAllChatTabs();
        }
      };

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'pageshow',
          wake
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'online',
          wake
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'visibilitychange',
          () => {
            if (
              document
                .visibilityState ===
                'visible'
            ) {
              wake();
            }
          }
        );

      this.disposables
        .addTimeout(
          setTimeout(
            () =>
              this.tryAcquireController(),
            700 +
            Math.floor(
              Math.random() *
              500
            )
          )
        );

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(
            () =>
              this.tryAcquireController(),
            this.controllerCheckEveryMs
          )
        );
    }

    tryAcquireController() {
      if (this.isController) {
        this.renewControllerLease();
        return true;
      }

      const now = Date.now();
      const lease =
        Storage.get(
          'bf_tfm_chat_controller',
          null
        );

      const otherControllerHealthy =
        lease &&
        lease.tabId &&
        lease.tabId !==
          this.tabId &&
        now -
          Number(
            lease.heartbeat ||
            0
          ) <
          this.controllerStaleMs;

      if (otherControllerHealthy) {
        return false;
      }

      Storage.set(
        'bf_tfm_chat_controller',
        {
          tabId: this.tabId,
          heartbeat: now,
          claimedAt: now,
          url:
            window.location.href
        }
      );

      const confirmed =
        Storage.get(
          'bf_tfm_chat_controller',
          null
        );

      if (
        confirmed?.tabId ===
        this.tabId
      ) {
        this.becomeController();
        return true;
      }

      return false;
    }

    becomeController() {
      if (this.isController) {
        return;
      }

      this.isController = true;

      console.log(
        '[ChatSupervisor] This tab is the controller.'
      );

      this.controllerHeartbeatTimer =
        setInterval(
          () =>
            this.renewControllerLease(),
          this.heartbeatEveryMs
        );

      this.controllerCheckTimer =
        setInterval(
          () =>
            this.ensureAllChatTabs(),
          this.controllerCheckEveryMs
        );

      this.disposables
        .addTimeout(
          setTimeout(
            () => {
              if (
                this.ownsControllerLease()
              ) {
                this.ensureChatTab(
                  'global'
                );
              }
            },
            900
          )
        );

      this.disposables
        .addTimeout(
          setTimeout(
            () => {
              if (
                this.ownsControllerLease()
              ) {
                this.ensureChatTab(
                  'vip'
                );
              }
            },
            2400
          )
        );
    }

    ownsControllerLease() {
      const lease =
        Storage.get(
          'bf_tfm_chat_controller',
          null
        );

      return !!lease &&
        lease.tabId ===
          this.tabId;
    }

    renewControllerLease() {
      const now = Date.now();
      const lease =
        Storage.get(
          'bf_tfm_chat_controller',
          null
        );

      if (
        lease?.tabId &&
        lease.tabId !==
          this.tabId &&
        now -
          Number(
            lease.heartbeat ||
            0
          ) <
          this.controllerStaleMs
      ) {
        this.demoteController();
        return false;
      }

      Storage.set(
        'bf_tfm_chat_controller',
        {
          tabId: this.tabId,
          heartbeat: now,
          claimedAt:
            lease?.claimedAt ||
            now,
          url:
            window.location.href
        }
      );

      return true;
    }

    demoteController() {
      if (!this.isController) {
        return;
      }

      this.isController = false;

      clearInterval(
        this.controllerHeartbeatTimer
      );

      clearInterval(
        this.controllerCheckTimer
      );

      this.controllerHeartbeatTimer =
        null;

      this.controllerCheckTimer =
        null;

      console.warn(
        '[ChatSupervisor] A newer controller took over.'
      );
    }

    ensureAllChatTabs() {
      if (
        !this.isController ||
        !this.ownsControllerLease()
      ) {
        return;
      }

      this.roles.forEach(role =>
        this.ensureChatTab(role)
      );
    }

    isHealthyRole(
      role,
      desired,
      status
    ) {
      if (
        !desired ||
        !status ||
        status.role !== role ||
        status.generation !==
          desired.generation
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      const age =
        Date.now() -
        Number(
          status.heartbeat ||
          0
        );

      return age >= 0 &&
        age <
          this.staleAfterMs;
    }

    ensureChatTab(role) {
      if (
        !this.roles.includes(role) ||
        !this.isController ||
        !this.ownsControllerLease()
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const desired =
        this.getDesired(role);

      const status =
        this.getStatus(role);

      if (
        this.isHealthyRole(
          role,
          desired,
          status
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const openedRecently =
        desired?.generation &&
        Date.now() -
          Number(
            desired.openedAt ||
            0
          ) <
          this.startupGraceMs;

      if (openedRecently) {
        return;
      }

      this.replaceChatTab(
        role,
        desired
          ? 'missed-heartbeat'
          : 'initial-open'
      );
    }

    replaceChatTab(
      role,
      reason = 'replacement'
    ) {
      if (
        !this.isController ||
        !this.ownsControllerLease()
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const oldHandle =
        this.openHandles[role];

      if (
        oldHandle &&
        typeof oldHandle.close ===
          'function'
      ) {
        try {
          oldHandle.close();
        } catch (error) {}
      }

      delete this.openHandles[role];

      const generation =
        this.createId(role);

      const openedAt =
        Date.now();

      Storage.set(
        this.desiredKey(role),
        {
          role,
          generation,
          openedAt,
          reason,
          controllerId:
            this.tabId
        }
      );

      Storage.set(
        this.statusKey(role),
        {
          role,
          generation,
          tabId: null,
          heartbeat: 0,
          state: 'opening',
          chatReady: false,
          openedAt
        }
      );

      const helperUrl =
        window.location.origin +
        '/#tfmChatRole=' +
        encodeURIComponent(role) +
        '&tfmGeneration=' +
        encodeURIComponent(
          generation
        );

      console.log(
        '[ChatSupervisor] Opening ' +
        role.toUpperCase() +
        ' chat tab (' +
        reason +
        ').'
      );

      try {
        if (
          typeof GM_openInTab ===
          'function'
        ) {
          this.openHandles[role] =
            GM_openInTab(
              helperUrl,
              {
                active: false,
                insert: true,
                setParent: true
              }
            );
        } else {
          this.openHandles[role] =
            window.open(
              helperUrl,
              '_blank'
            );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        Storage.set(
          this.statusKey(role),
          {
            role,
            generation,
            tabId: null,
            heartbeat: 0,
            state: 'open-failed',
            chatReady: false,
            openedAt,
            error:
              String(
                error?.message ||
                error
              )
          }
        );

        console.error(
          '[ChatSupervisor] Could not open ' +
          role +
          ' chat tab.',
          error
        );
      }
    }

    startChatHelper() {
      if (
        !this.generation ||
        !this.isCurrentHelper()
      ) {
        this.retireSelf();
        return;
      }

      console.log(
        '[ChatSupervisor] ' +
        this.role.toUpperCase() +
        ' helper online.'
      );

      this.publishHeartbeat(
        'starting'
      );

      const wake = () => {
        if (
          !this.isCurrentHelper()
        ) {
          this.retireSelf();
          return;
        }

        this.publishHeartbeat(
          'awake'
        );

        this.ensureAssignedChat();
      };

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'pageshow',
          wake
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'online',
          wake
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'visibilitychange',
          wake
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'pagehide',
          () =>
            this.publishHeartbeat(
              'pagehide'
            )
        );

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(
            () =>
              this.publishHeartbeat(
                this.chatReady
                  ? 'healthy'
                  : 'opening-chat'
              ),
            this.heartbeatEveryMs
          )
        );

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(
            () =>
              this.ensureAssignedChat(),
            5000
          )
        );

      const chatObserver =
        new MutationObserver(
          throttle(
            () =>
              this.ensureAssignedChat(),
            1200
          )
        );

      chatObserver.observe(
        document.body ||
        document.documentElement,
        {
          childList: true,
          subtree: true,
          attributes: true
        }
      );

      this.disposables
        .addObserver(
          chatObserver
        );

      this.disposables
        .addTimeout(
          setTimeout(
            () =>
              this.ensureAssignedChat(),
            700
          )
        );

      this.scheduleSoftRefresh();
    }

    isCurrentHelper() {
      const desired =
        this.getDesired(
          this.role
        );

      return !!desired &&
        desired.generation ===
          this.generation;
    }

    publishHeartbeat(state) {
      if (
        this.retiring ||
        !this.isCurrentHelper()
      ) {
        if (!this.retiring) {
          this.retireSelf();
        }

        return false;
      }

      Storage.set(
        this.statusKey(
          this.role
        ),
        {
          role: this.role,
          generation:
            this.generation,
          tabId: this.tabId,
          heartbeat: Date.now(),
          state,
          chatReady:
            !!this.chatReady,
          lastChatAttemptAt:
            this.lastChatAttemptAt,
          url:
            window.location.href
        }
      );

      return true;
    }

    findChatInput() {
      const selectors = [
        'textarea[placeholder*="message" i]',
        'input[placeholder*="message" i]',
        'div[role="textbox"]',
        '[contenteditable="true"]'
      ];

      for (const selector of selectors) {
        const matches =
          document
            .querySelectorAll(
              selector
            );

        for (const element of matches) {
          if (
            isElementClickable(
              element
            )
          ) {
            return element;
          }
        }
      }

      return null;
    }

    findChatLauncher() {
      const selectors = [
        'button[aria-label*="chat" i]',
        '[role="button"][aria-label*="chat" i]',
        'button[title*="chat" i]',
        '[role="button"][title*="chat" i]',
        'button[class*="chat" i]',
        '[role="button"][class*="chat" i]',
        '[data-testid*="chat" i][role="button"]'
      ];

      for (const selector of selectors) {
        const matches =
          document
            .querySelectorAll(
              selector
            );

        for (const element of matches) {
          if (
            isElementClickable(
              element
            )
          ) {
            return element;
          }
        }
      }

      const textCandidates =
        document.querySelectorAll(
          'button, [role="button"]'
        );

      for (
        const element
        of textCandidates
      ) {
        const text =
          normalizeText(
            element.textContent ||
            element.getAttribute(
              'aria-label'
            )
          );

        if (
          isElementClickable(
            element
          ) &&
          (
            text === 'chat' ||
            text === 'open chat' ||
            text === 'live chat'
          )
        ) {
          return element;
        }
      }

      return null;
    }

    findRoleControl() {
      const wanted =
        this.role === 'vip'
          ? [
            'vip',
            'vip chat'
          ]
          : [
            'global',
            'global chat'
          ];

      const candidates =
        document.querySelectorAll(
          [
            'button',
            '[role="tab"]',
            '[role="button"]',
            'a',
            '[data-testid*="chat" i]'
          ].join(',')
        );

      let best = null;
      let bestScore = -1;

      for (const element of candidates) {
        if (
          !isElementClickable(
            element
          )
        ) {
          continue;
        }

        const text =
          normalizeText(
            element.textContent
          );

        const ariaText =
          normalizeText(
            element.getAttribute(
              'aria-label'
            ) ||
            element.getAttribute(
              'title'
            )
          );

        const label =
          wanted.includes(text)
            ? text
            : (
              wanted.includes(
                ariaText
              )
                ? ariaText
                : ''
            );

        if (!label) {
          continue;
        }

        let chatContext = null;

        try {
          chatContext =
            element.closest(
              [
                '[class*="chat" i]',
                '[id*="chat" i]',
                '[data-testid*="chat" i]',
                '[aria-label*="chat" i]'
              ].join(',')
            );
        } catch (error) {}

        const parentText =
          normalizeText(
            element.parentElement
              ?.textContent
          );

        const pairedRoomControls =
          parentText.length < 260 &&
          parentText.includes(
            'global'
          ) &&
          parentText.includes(
            'vip'
          );

        const explicitTab =
          element.getAttribute(
            'role'
          ) === 'tab';

        if (
          !chatContext &&
          !pairedRoomControls &&
          !explicitTab
        ) {
          continue;
        }

        let score = 10;

        if (chatContext) {
          score += 100;
        }

        if (pairedRoomControls) {
          score += 70;
        }

        if (explicitTab) {
          score += 40;
        }

        if (text === this.role) {
          score += 20;
        }

        if (score > bestScore) {
          best = element;
          bestScore = score;
        }
      }

      return best;
    }

    isSelectedControl(element) {
      if (!element) {
        return false;
      }

      const className =
        String(
          element.className ||
          ''
        ).toLowerCase();

      return (
        element.getAttribute(
          'aria-selected'
        ) === 'true' ||
        element.getAttribute(
          'aria-pressed'
        ) === 'true' ||
        element.getAttribute(
          'data-state'
        ) === 'active' ||
        /(^|\s)(active|selected|current)(\s|$)/
          .test(className)
      );
    }

    clickChatControl(element) {
      if (
        !element ||
        !isElementClickable(
          element
        )
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      try {
        element.scrollIntoView({
          block: 'nearest',
          inline: 'nearest'
        });

        element.click();
        return true;
      } catch (error) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    ensureAssignedChat() {
      if (
        this.retiring ||
        !this.isCurrentHelper()
      ) {
        this.retireSelf();
        return;
      }

      this.lastChatAttemptAt =
        Date.now();

      let input =
        this.findChatInput();

      let roleControl =
        this.findRoleControl();

      if (!input) {
        const launcher =
          this.findChatLauncher();

        if (launcher) {
          this.clickChatControl(
            launcher
          );

          this.chatReady = false;
          this.publishHeartbeat(
            'opening-chat-panel'
          );
          return;
        }
      }

      if (
        roleControl &&
        !this.isSelectedControl(
          roleControl
        )
      ) {
        this.clickChatControl(
          roleControl
        );

        this.chatReady = false;
        this.publishHeartbeat(
          'selecting-' +
          this.role
        );
        return;
      }

      input =
        input ||
        this.findChatInput();

      roleControl =
        roleControl ||
        this.findRoleControl();

      const roleConfirmed =
        roleControl
          ? this.isSelectedControl(
            roleControl
          )
          : this.role ===
            'global';

      this.chatReady =
        !!input &&
        roleConfirmed;

      this.publishHeartbeat(
        this.chatReady
          ? 'healthy'
          : 'waiting-for-' +
            this.role +
            '-chat'
      );
    }

    scheduleSoftRefresh() {
      const refreshKey =
        'tfmChatLastRefresh:' +
        this.role;

      let lastRefreshAt =
        Number(
          readTabSession(
            refreshKey,
            '0'
          )
        );

      if (!lastRefreshAt) {
        lastRefreshAt =
          Date.now();

        writeTabSession(
          refreshKey,
          lastRefreshAt
        );
      }

      // Stagger VIP by 30 seconds so both live chats are never reconnecting
      // simultaneously.
      const stagger =
        this.role === 'vip'
          ? 30 * 1000
          : 0;

      const refreshAfter =
        Math.max(
          30 * 1000,
          lastRefreshAt +
            this.softRefreshEveryMs +
            stagger -
            Date.now()
        );

      this.disposables
        .addTimeout(
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (
              !this.isCurrentHelper()
            ) {
              this.retireSelf();
              return;
            }

            this.publishHeartbeat(
              'refreshing'
            );

            writeTabSession(
              refreshKey,
              Date.now()
            );

            window.location.reload();
          }, refreshAfter)
        );
    }

    retireSelf() {
      if (this.retiring) {
        return;
      }

      this.retiring = true;
      this.disposables.clear();

      console.warn(
        '[ChatSupervisor] Closing superseded ' +
        String(this.role || 'unknown') +
        ' helper tab.'
      );

      setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          window.close();
        } catch (error) {}
      }, 250);
    }

    snapshot() {
      return {
        tabId: this.tabId,
        role: this.role,
        generation:
          this.generation,
        claimTab:
          TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
            .claimTab,
        isController:
          this.isController,
        global:
          this.getStatus(
            'global'
          ),
        vip:
          this.getStatus(
            'vip'
          )
      };
    }
  }

  const chatTabSupervisor =
    new ChatTabSupervisor();

  function fakeMouseMove(
    element
  ) {
    if (!element) {
      return;
    }

    const rect =
      element
        .getBoundingClientRect();

    const targetX =
      rect.left +
      rect.width / 2;

    const targetY =
      rect.top +
      rect.height / 2;

    const currentX =
      window.lastMouseX ||
      window.innerWidth / 2;

    const currentY =
      window.lastMouseY ||
      window.innerHeight / 2;

    const paths =
      HumanBehavior
        .curvedMousePath(
          currentX,
          currentY,
          targetX,
          targetY,
          300
        );

    paths.forEach(position => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          const event =
            new MouseEvent(
              'mousemove',
              {
                bubbles: true,
                cancelable: true,
                clientX:
                  position.x,
                clientY:
                  position.y
              }
            );

          element.dispatchEvent(
            event
          );

          window.lastMouseX =
            position.x;

          window.lastMouseY =
            position.y;
        } catch (error) {}
      }, position.delay);
    });
  }

  // ===== HORROR HUMAN =====
  class HorrorHuman {
    constructor() {
      if (
        TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
          .claimTab
      ) {
        const initialPause =
          HumanBehavior
            .randomIdle(
              4000,
              12000
            );

        setTimeout(
          () =>
            this
              .runHorrorHumanCycle(),
          initialPause
        );
      }
    }

    runHorrorHumanCycle() {
      console.log(
        '🧠 Starting horror human cycle...'
      );

      const readDelay =
        HumanBehavior
          .randomIdle(
            3000,
            7000
          );

      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(
          '🧠 Starting first withdraw click'
        );

        this
          .clickFirstWithdraw();
      }, readDelay);
    }

    clickFirstWithdraw() {
      const candidates =
        document
          .querySelectorAll(
            'button, [role="button"]'
          );

      for (
        const button
        of candidates
      ) {
        const text =
          (
            button.textContent ||
            ''
          )
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();

        if (
          text.includes(
            'withdraw'
          ) ||
          text.includes(
            'claim'
          ) ||
          text.includes(
            'get free'
          )
        ) {
          fakeMouseMove(
            button
          );

          const humanDelay =
            HumanBehavior
              .naturalDelay(
                1200,
                2800
              );

          setTimeout(() => {
            fakeMouseMove(
              button
            );

            if (
              Math.random() <
              0.15
            ) {
              setTimeout(
                () =>
                  fakeMouseMove(
                    button
                  ),
                150
              );
            }

            try {
              button.click();

              audioManager.play(
                'claim'
              );

              setTimeout(
                () =>
                  this
                    .clickSecondWithdraw(),
                HumanBehavior
                  .randomIdle(
                    3000,
                    6000
                  )
              );
            } catch (
              error
            ) {}
          }, humanDelay);

          return;
        }
      }

      setTimeout(
        () =>
          this
            .clickSecondWithdraw(),
        HumanBehavior
          .randomIdle(
            2000,
            5000
          )
      );
    }

    clickSecondWithdraw() {
      const candidates =
        document
          .querySelectorAll(
            'button, [role="button"]'
          );

      for (
        const button
        of candidates
      ) {
        const text =
          (
            button.textContent ||
            ''
          )
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();

        if (
          text.includes(
            'withdraw'
          ) ||
          text.includes(
            'confirm'
          )
        ) {
          fakeMouseMove(
            button
          );

          const humanDelay =
            HumanBehavior
              .naturalDelay(
                1300,
                2900
              );

          setTimeout(() => {
            fakeMouseMove(
              button
            );

            if (
              Math.random() <
              0.1
            ) {
              setTimeout(
                () =>
                  fakeMouseMove(
                    button
                  ),
                200
              );
            }

            try {
              button.click();

              Effects
                .showFireworks();

              AchievementManager
                .addBoxesClaimed();

              setTimeout(
                () =>
                  this.closeTab(),
                HumanBehavior
                  .randomIdle(
                    2000,
                    4000
                  )
              );
            } catch (
              error
            ) {}
          }, humanDelay);

          return;
        }
      }

      this.closeTab();
    }

    closeTab() {
      if (
        !TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
          .claimTab
      ) {
        return;
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          window.close();
        } catch (
          error
        ) {}
      },
      HumanBehavior
        .gaussianDelay(
          1500,
          0.4
        ));
    }
  }

  const horrorHuman =
    new HorrorHuman();

  window.BFHelper = {
    VERSION,
    settings,
    autoClaim,
    chatTabSupervisor,
    sniper,
    spriteManager,
    menuManager,
    horrorHuman,
    AchievementManager,
    HumanBehavior,
    Storage,
    Disposables
  };

  // ===== MAIN INITIALIZATION =====
  function initializeScript() {
    console.log(
      '[BetFury Helper] Initializing core components v' +
      VERSION
    );

    chatTabSupervisor.start();

    // Helper and claim tabs stay deliberately lean. They still run the
    // detector/claim engines, but do not duplicate the controller's pill,
    // menu observers or animated companions.
    if (
      TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
        .chatRole ||
      TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
        .claimTab
    ) {
      console.log(
        '[BetFury Helper] Minimal ' +
        (
          TFM_TAB_CONTEXT
            .chatRole ||
          'claim'
        ) +
        ' tab ready.'
      );

      return;
    }

    if (
      settings.get(
        'sniperEnabled'
      ) === undefined
    ) {
      settings.set(
        'sniperEnabled',
        true
      );
    }

    if (
      settings.get(
        'autoClaimRunning'
      ) === undefined
    ) {
      settings.set(
        'autoClaimRunning',
        false
      );
    }

    if (
      settings.get(
        'spritesEnabled'
      ) === undefined
    ) {
      settings.set(
        'spritesEnabled',
        true
      );
    }

    if (!pillButton) {
      pillButton =
        new PillButton();
    }

    spriteManager.refresh();

    const pillObserver =
      new MutationObserver(
        throttle(() => {
          if (
            !document
              .getElementById(
                'bf-pill'
              ) &&
            pillButton
          ) {
            pillButton
              .recreate();
          }
        }, 500)
      );

    pillObserver.observe(
      (document.body || document.documentElement),
      {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
      }
    );

    document.addEventListener(
      'keydown',
      event => {
        if (
          event.shiftKey &&
          event.key
            .toLowerCase() ===
            'm'
        ) {
          event.preventDefault();

          menuManager.toggle();
        }
      }
    );

    const timerInterval =
      setInterval(
        () =>
          menuManager
            .updateClaimTimer(),
        1000
      );

    console.log(
      '[BetFury Helper] ✓ Ready! v' +
      VERSION
    );

    console.log(
      '[BetFury Helper] ✨ Global + VIP Sniper • Human Behavior • Achievements • Sprites • Stats'
    );
  }

  if (
    document.readyState ===
    'loading'
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      'DOMContentLoaded',
      initializeScript
    );
  } else {
    initializeScript();
  }

})();

// ============================================================
// THEFRESHMAKER v4 UPGRADE EXTENSION
// Part 17
// Loads after the original v3.5.1 core.
// ============================================================

(function TheFreshMakerV4Extension() {
  'use strict';

  const EXTENSION_VERSION = '4.4.0';

  if (window.TFM_V4_EXTENSION_LOADED) {
    console.warn(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Extension already loaded.'
    );

    return;
  }

  window.TFM_V4_EXTENSION_LOADED = true;

  const core = window.BFHelper;

  if (!core) {
    console.error(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Original BFHelper core was not found.'
    );

    return;
  }

  window.TFM_V4_PART_17_LOADED = true;

  const {
    settings,
    Storage,
    Disposables,
    HumanBehavior,
    AchievementManager
  } = core;

  console.log(
    `[TheFreshMaker] Loading v${EXTENSION_VERSION} upgrade extension`
  );

  // ==========================================================
  // EVENT MANAGER
  // ==========================================================

  class EventManager {
    constructor() {
      this.events = new Map();
    }

    on(eventName, callback) {
      if (
        typeof eventName !== 'string' ||
        typeof callback !== 'function'
      ) {
        return () => {};
      }

      if (!this.events.has(eventName)) {
        this.events.set(
          eventName,
          new Set()
        );
      }

      const listeners =
        this.events.get(eventName);

      listeners.add(callback);

      return () => {
        this.off(
          eventName,
          callback
        );
      };
    }

    once(eventName, callback) {
      const unsubscribe =
        this.on(
          eventName,
          payload => {
            unsubscribe();
            callback(payload);
          }
        );

      return unsubscribe;
    }

    off(eventName, callback) {
      const listeners =
        this.events.get(eventName);

      if (!listeners) {
        return;
      }

      listeners.delete(callback);

      if (listeners.size === 0) {
        this.events.delete(
          eventName
        );
      }
    }

    emit(eventName, payload = {}) {
      const listeners =
        this.events.get(eventName);

      if (!listeners) {
        return;
      }

      [...listeners].forEach(
        callback => {
          try {
            callback(payload);
          } catch (error) {
            console.warn(
              '[TheFreshMaker Event Error]',
              eventName,
              error
            );
          }
        }
      );
    }

    clear(eventName = null) {
      if (eventName) {
        this.events.delete(
          eventName
        );

        return;
      }

      this.events.clear();
    }

    listenerCount(eventName) {
      return (
        this.events.get(eventName)
          ?.size || 0
      );
    }
  }

  const eventManager =
    new EventManager();

  // ==========================================================
  // DEBUG LOGGER
  // ==========================================================

  class DebugLogger {
    constructor(limit = 400) {
      this.limit = limit;
      this.entries = [];
    }

    add(
      type,
      message,
      data = null
    ) {
      const entry = {
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        isoTime:
          new Date().toISOString(),
        type,
        message,
        data
      };

      this.entries.push(entry);

      if (
        this.entries.length >
        this.limit
      ) {
        this.entries.splice(
          0,
          this.entries.length -
            this.limit
        );
      }

      if (
        settings.get(
          'debugMode'
        ) !== false
      ) {
        console.log(
          `[TheFreshMaker ${type}] ${message}`,
          data ?? ''
        );
      }

      return entry;
    }

    info(message, data = null) {
      return this.add(
        'INFO',
        message,
        data
      );
    }

    warn(message, data = null) {
      return this.add(
        'WARN',
        message,
        data
      );
    }

    error(message, data = null) {
      return this.add(
        'ERROR',
        message,
        data
      );
    }

    get(limit = this.limit) {
      return this.entries.slice(
        -Math.max(1, limit)
      );
    }

    clear() {
      this.entries.length = 0;
    }

    exportText() {
      return JSON.stringify(
        this.entries,
        null,
        2
      );
    }
  }

  const debugLogger =
    new DebugLogger();

  // ==========================================================

    debugMode: true,

    sniperEnabled: true,

    uiSettings: {
      showStatus: true,

    },

      enabled: true,

      particles: true,
      screenFlash: true,

    },

      coinsWon: 0,
      boxesClaimed: 0,
      coindropsSniped: 0,

      detectedDrops: 0,
      successfulClaims: 0,
      failedAttempts: 0,
      missedClaims: 0,
      retries: 0,

      fastestClaim: null,
      totalReactionTime: 0,
      averageReaction: 0,
      lastReaction: null,

      sessionClaims: 0,
      sessionFailures: 0,
      sessionStart: Date.now(),

      currentStreak: 0,
      longestStreak: 0,

      lastDetectedAt: null,
      lastSuccessAt: null,
      lastFailureAt: null,
      lastFailureReason: null,

      detectionMethods: {},
      daily: {}
    }
  };

  function cloneValue(value) {
    try {
      return structuredClone(value);
    } catch (error) {
      return JSON.parse(
        JSON.stringify(value)
      );
    }
  }

  function mergeObjects(
    base,
    incoming
  ) {
    const result = {
      ...(base || {})
    };

    Object.entries(
      incoming || {}
    ).forEach(
      ([key, value]) => {
        if (
          value &&
          typeof value === 'object' &&
          !Array.isArray(value)
        ) {
          result[key] =
            mergeObjects(
              result[key] || {},
              value
            );
        } else {
          result[key] = value;
        }
      }
    );

    return result;
  }

  function ensureV4Settings() {
    Object.entries(
      V4_DEFAULTS
    ).forEach(
      ([key, defaultValue]) => {
        const current =
          settings.get(key);

        if (
          current === undefined ||
          current === null
        ) {
          settings.set(
            key,
            cloneValue(
              defaultValue
            )
          );

          return;
        }

        if (
          defaultValue &&
          typeof defaultValue ===
            'object' &&
          !Array.isArray(
            defaultValue
          )
        ) {
          settings.set(
            key,
            mergeObjects(
              cloneValue(
                defaultValue
              ),
              current
            )
          );
        }
      }
    );

    Storage.set(
      'bf_v4ExtensionVersion',
      EXTENSION_VERSION
    );
  }

  ensureV4Settings();

  // ==========================================================
  // GENERAL UTILITIES
  // ==========================================================

  function randomDelay(
    minimum,
    maximum
  ) {
    const min =
      Math.ceil(
        Number(minimum) || 0
      );

    const max =
      Math.floor(
        Number(maximum) || min
      );

    return Math.floor(
      Math.random() *
      (
        Math.max(
          min,
          max
        ) -
        min +
        1
      )
    ) + min;
  }

  function wait(milliseconds) {
    return new Promise(
      resolve => {
        setTimeout(
          resolve,
          Math.max(
            0,
            milliseconds
          )
        );
      }
    );
  }

  function normalizeText(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
  }

  function safeQueryAll(selector) {
    try {
      return Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll(
          selector
        )
      );
    } catch (error) {
      return [];
    }
  }

  function isElementConnected(
    element
  ) {
    try {
      return Boolean(
        element &&
        element.isConnected &&
        document.contains(
          element
        )
      );
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function isElementVisible(
    element
  ) {
    if (
      !isElementConnected(
        element
      )
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      const rect =
        element
          .getBoundingClientRect();

      const style =
        getComputedStyle(
          element
        );

      return (
        rect.width > 0 &&
        rect.height > 0 &&
        style.display !==
          'none' &&
        style.visibility !==
          'hidden' &&
        Number(
          style.opacity || 1
        ) > 0
      );
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function isElementClickable(
    element
  ) {
    if (
      !isElementVisible(
        element
      )
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      const style =
        getComputedStyle(
          element
        );

      const ariaDisabled =
        normalizeText(
          element.getAttribute(
            'aria-disabled'
          )
        ) === 'true';

      return (
        !element.disabled &&
        !ariaDisabled &&
        style.pointerEvents !==
          'none'
      );
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function parseRgb(value) {
    const match =
      String(value || '')
        .match(
          /rgba?\(\s*(\d+)[,\s]+(\d+)[,\s]+(\d+)/i
        );

    if (!match) {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      r: Number(match[1]),
      g: Number(match[2]),
      b: Number(match[3])
    };
  }

  function isRedColour(
    colour
  ) {
    if (!colour) {
      return false;
    }

    const {
      r,
      g,
      b
    } = colour;

    return (
      r >= 125 &&
      r > g * 1.2 &&
      r > b * 1.2 &&
      r - Math.max(g, b) >= 30
    );
  }

  function isRedButton(
    element
  ) {
    if (!element) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      const style =
        getComputedStyle(
          element
        );

      const colours = [
        style.backgroundColor,
        style.borderTopColor,
        style.borderRightColor,
        style.borderBottomColor,
        style.borderLeftColor
      ]
        .map(parseRgb)
        .filter(Boolean);

      return colours.some(
        isRedColour
      );
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // COINDROP BUTTON MATCHING
  // ==========================================================

  const EXACT_COINDROP_TEXTS = [
    'get coindrop'
  ];

  const FALLBACK_COINDROP_TEXTS = [
    'claim coindrop',
    'collect coindrop',
    'receive coindrop',
    'get drop'
  ];

  function getButtonText(
    element
  ) {
    const directText =
      normalizeText(
        element?.innerText ||
        element?.textContent
      );

    const ariaLabel =
      normalizeText(
        element?.getAttribute?.(
          'aria-label'
        )
      );

    return directText ||
      ariaLabel;
  }

  function scoreCoindropButton(
    element
  ) {
    if (
      !isElementClickable(
        element
      )
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    const text =
      getButtonText(
        element
      );

    if (!text) {
      return null;
    }

    let score = 0;
    let detectionMethod =
      null;

    if (
      EXACT_COINDROP_TEXTS.includes(
        text
      )
    ) {
      score += 1000;

      detectionMethod =
        'exact-text';
    } else if (
      FALLBACK_COINDROP_TEXTS.includes(
        text
      )
    ) {
      score += 650;

      detectionMethod =
        'fallback-text';
    } else if (
      text.includes(
        'coindrop'
      ) &&
      /get|claim|collect|receive/.test(
        text
      )
    ) {
      score += 450;

      detectionMethod =
        'keyword-text';
    } else {
      return null;
    }

    if (
      element.tagName ===
      'BUTTON'
    ) {
      score += 100;
    }

    if (
      normalizeText(
        element.getAttribute(
          'role'
        )
      ) === 'button'
    ) {
      score += 50;
    }

    if (
      isRedButton(element)
    ) {
      score += 250;
    }

    const surroundingText =
      normalizeText(
        element.closest(
          '[role="dialog"], [class*="chat"], [class*="drop"], [class*="coin"]'
        )?.textContent ||
        element.parentElement
          ?.textContent
      );

    if (
      surroundingText.includes(
        'global'
      )
    ) {
      score += 40;
    }

    if (
      surroundingText.includes(
        'vip'
      )
    ) {
      score += 40;
    }

    return {
      element,
      text,
      score,
      detectionMethod,
      red:
        isRedButton(
          element
        )
    };
  }

  function findBestCoindropButton() {
    const candidates =
      safeQueryAll(
        [
          'button',
          '[role="button"]',
          'div[role="button"]',
          'a[role="button"]',
          'input[type="button"]',
          'input[type="submit"]'
        ].join(',')
      );

    const matches =
      candidates
        .map(
          scoreCoindropButton
        )
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort(
          (first, second) =>
            second.score -
            first.score
        );

    return matches[0] ||
      null;
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // SUCCESS DETECTION
  // ==========================================================

  const SUCCESS_WORDS = [
    'you win',
    'you won',
    'congratulations',
    'successfully claimed',
    'claimed successfully',
    'reward received',
    'reward added',
    'coindrop claimed',
    'coins received'
  ];

  function collectSuccessMessages() {
    const messages =
      new Set();

    safeQueryAll(
      [
        '[role="alert"]',
        '[role="status"]',
        '[aria-live]',
        'div',
        'span',
        'p',
        'strong',
        'b',
        'h1',
        'h2',
        'h3'
      ].join(',')
    ).forEach(
      element => {
        const text =
          normalizeText(
            element.textContent
          );

        if (
          !text ||
          text.length > 240
        ) {
          return;
        }

        if (
          SUCCESS_WORDS.some(
            word =>
              text.includes(word)
          )
        ) {
          messages.add(text);
        }
      }
    );

    return messages;
  }

  function hasNewSuccessMessage(
    baseline
  ) {
    const current =
      collectSuccessMessages();

    return [...current].some(
      message =>
        !baseline.has(
          message
        )
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // CLAIM VERIFIER
  // ==========================================================

  class ClaimVerifier {
    constructor(button) {
      this.button = button;

      this.baseline =
        collectSuccessMessages();

      this.initialText =
        getButtonText(button);

      this.initialDisabled =
        Boolean(
          button?.disabled
        );
    }

    inspect() {
      if (
        hasNewSuccessMessage(
          this.baseline
        )
      ) {
        return {
          success: true,
          signal:
            'success-message'
        };
      }

      if (
        !isElementConnected(
          this.button
        )
      ) {
        return {
          success: true,
          signal:
            'button-removed'
        };
      }

      if (
        !this.initialDisabled &&
        this.button.disabled
      ) {
        return {
          success: true,
          signal:
            'button-disabled'
        };
      }

      const ariaDisabled =
        normalizeText(
          this.button
            .getAttribute(
              'aria-disabled'
            )
        );

      if (
        ariaDisabled ===
        'true'
      ) {
        return {
          success: true,
          signal:
            'aria-disabled'
        };
      }

      const currentText =
        getButtonText(
          this.button
        );

      if (
        this.initialText &&
        currentText &&
        currentText !==
          this.initialText &&
        !currentText.includes(
          'coindrop'
        )
      ) {
        return {
          success: true,
          signal:
            'button-text-changed'
        };
      }

      return {
        success: false,
        signal:
          'unconfirmed'
      };
    }

    async waitForResult(
      timeoutMs = 2600,
      intervalMs = 100
    ) {
      const startedAt =
        performance.now();

      while (
        performance.now() -
          startedAt <
        timeoutMs
      ) {
        const result =
          this.inspect();

        if (result.success) {
          return result;
        }

        await wait(
          intervalMs
        );
      }

      return this.inspect();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // STATS MANAGER
  // ==========================================================

  class V4StatsManager {
    getStats() {
      return mergeObjects(
        cloneValue(
          V4_DEFAULTS.stats
        ),
        settings.get('stats') ||
          {}
      );
    }

    save(stats) {
      settings.set(
        'stats',
        stats
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'STATS_UPDATED',
        {
          stats:
            cloneValue(stats)
        }
      );
    }

    getTodayKey() {
      return new Date()
        .toISOString()
        .slice(0, 10);
    }

    ensureDaily(stats) {
      const key =
        this.getTodayKey();

      stats.daily =
        stats.daily || {};

      stats.daily[key] =
        mergeObjects(
          {
            detected: 0,
            successful: 0,
            failed: 0,
            reactionTotal: 0
          },
          stats.daily[key] ||
            {}
        );

      return {
        key,
        record:
          stats.daily[key]
      };
    }

    recordDetection(
      method
    ) {
      const stats =
        this.getStats();

      stats.detectedDrops += 1;

      stats.lastDetectedAt =
        Date.now();

      stats.detectionMethods =
        stats.detectionMethods ||
        {};

      stats.detectionMethods[
        method
      ] =
        (
          stats
            .detectionMethods[
              method
            ] || 0
        ) + 1;

      const daily =
        this.ensureDaily(stats);

      daily.record.detected += 1;

      this.save(stats);
    }

    recordRetry() {
      const stats =
        this.getStats();

      stats.retries += 1;

      this.save(stats);
    }

    recordSuccess(
      reactionTime
    ) {
      const stats =
        this.getStats();

      const reaction =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Math.round(
            reactionTime
          )
        );

      stats.coindropsSniped += 1;
      stats.successfulClaims += 1;
      stats.sessionClaims += 1;
      stats.lastReaction = reaction;
      stats.lastSuccessAt =
        Date.now();

      stats.totalReactionTime +=
        reaction;

      stats.averageReaction =
        Math.round(
          stats.totalReactionTime /
          Math.max(
            1,
            stats.successfulClaims
          )
        );

      if (
        stats.fastestClaim ===
          null ||
        reaction <
          stats.fastestClaim
      ) {
        stats.fastestClaim =
          reaction;
      }

      stats.currentStreak += 1;

      stats.longestStreak =
        Math.max(
          stats.longestStreak,
          stats.currentStreak
        );

      stats.lastFailureReason =
        null;

      const daily =
        this.ensureDaily(stats);

      daily.record.successful += 1;

      daily.record.reactionTotal +=
        reaction;

      this.save(stats);

      AchievementManager
        .addCoinsWon(1);
    }

    recordFailure(reason) {
      const stats =
        this.getStats();

      stats.failedAttempts += 1;
      stats.missedClaims += 1;
      stats.sessionFailures += 1;
      stats.currentStreak = 0;

      stats.lastFailureAt =
        Date.now();

      stats.lastFailureReason =
        String(
          reason ||
          'unknown'
        );

      const daily =
        this.ensureDaily(stats);

      daily.record.failed += 1;

      this.save(stats);
    }
  }

  const v4Stats =
    new V4StatsManager();

  // ==========================================================
  // CLEAN UP ORIGINAL SNIPER OBSERVER
  // ==========================================================

  function disableOriginalSniper() {
    try {
      if (
        core.sniper?.observer
      ) {
        core.sniper
          .observer
          .disconnect();
      }

      if (
        core.sniper
          ?.disposables
          ?.clear
      ) {
        core.sniper
          .disposables
          .clear();
      }

      debugLogger.info(
        'Original v3 sniper observer disabled.'
      );
    } catch (error) {
      debugLogger.warn(
        'Could not fully disable the original sniper.',
        error
      );
    }
  }

  disableOriginalSniper();

  // ==========================================================
  // EXPORT PART 17 SERVICES
  // ==========================================================

  window.TheFreshMakerV4 = {
    version:
      EXTENSION_VERSION,

    eventManager,

    debugLogger,

    statsManager:
      v4Stats,

    utilities: {
      randomDelay,

      isElementClickable,
      isRedButton
    },

    detection: {
      scoreCoindropButton,
      findBestCoindropButton,
      collectSuccessMessages
    },

    ClaimVerifier
  };

  core.eventManager =
    eventManager;

  core.debugLogger =
    debugLogger;

  core.v4Stats =
    v4Stats;

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 17 loaded successfully.',
    {
      version:
        EXTENSION_VERSION
    }
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_PART_17_READY',
    {
      version:
        EXTENSION_VERSION
    }
  );
})();

(function TheFreshMakerV4Part18() {
  'use strict';

  if (
    window.TFM_V4_PART_18_LOADED
  ) {
    console.warn(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 18 already loaded.'
    );

    return;
  }

  window.TFM_V4_PART_18_LOADED =
    true;

    eventManager,

    statsManager,

  } = extension;

    HumanBehavior,

  } = core;

  const {
    randomDelay,
    wait,
    normalizeText,
    isElementConnected,
