  } = utilities;

  // ==========================================================
  // SPEED PROFILES
  // ==========================================================

  const SPEED_PROFILES = {
    aggressive: {
      name: 'Aggressive',
      minimum: 200,
      maximum: 1000,
      pointerDuration: {
        minimum: 80,
        maximum: 150
      },
      clickHold: {
        minimum: 35,
        maximum: 80
      },
      verifyTimeout: 2300
    },

    normal: {
      name: 'Normal',
      minimum: 700,
      maximum: 1200,
      pointerDuration: {
        minimum: 100,
        maximum: 190
      },
      clickHold: {
        minimum: 45,
        maximum: 100
      },
      verifyTimeout: 2600
    },

    lazy: {
      name: 'Lazy',
      minimum: 1000,
      maximum: 2000,
      pointerDuration: {
        minimum: 140,
        maximum: 260
      },
      clickHold: {
        minimum: 60,
        maximum: 130
      },
      verifyTimeout: 3000
    }
  };

  function getCurrentProfile() {
    const key =
      settings.get('profile') ||
      'normal';

    return {
      key,
      ...(
        SPEED_PROFILES[key] ||
        SPEED_PROFILES.normal
      )
    };
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // CLICK FINGERPRINTING
  // ==========================================================

  function getElementFingerprint(
    element
  ) {
    if (!element) {
      return 'missing';
    }

    const text =
      normalizeText(
        element.innerText ||
        element.textContent ||
        element.getAttribute(
          'aria-label'
        )
      );

    const className =
      typeof element.className ===
        'string'
        ? element.className
        : '';

    const rect =
      element.getBoundingClientRect();

    return [
      text,
      className,
      Math.round(rect.left),
      Math.round(rect.top),
      Math.round(rect.width),
      Math.round(rect.height)
    ].join('|');
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // NATURAL POINTER ENGINE
  // ==========================================================

  function dispatchMouseEvent(
    target,
    type,
    x,
    y,
    buttons = 0
  ) {
    const event =
      new MouseEvent(
        type,
        {
          bubbles: true,
          cancelable: true,
          composed: true,
          view: window,
          clientX: x,
          clientY: y,
          screenX: x,
          screenY: y,
          button: 0,
          buttons
        }
      );

    target.dispatchEvent(event);

    return event;
  }

  function dispatchPointerEvent(
    target,
    type,
    x,
    y,
    buttons = 0
  ) {
    if (!window.PointerEvent) {
      return null;
    }

    const event =
      new PointerEvent(
        type,
        {
          bubbles: true,
          cancelable: true,
          composed: true,
          pointerId: 1,
          pointerType: 'mouse',
          isPrimary: true,
          clientX: x,
          clientY: y,
          screenX: x,
          screenY: y,
          button: 0,
          buttons
        }
      );

    target.dispatchEvent(event);

    return event;
  }

  async function movePointerNaturally(
    element,
    profile
  ) {
    if (
      !isElementClickable(
        element
      )
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    const rect =
      element.getBoundingClientRect();

    const target =
      HumanBehavior.mouseJitter(
        rect.left +
          rect.width / 2,
        rect.top +
          rect.height / 2,
        Math.min(
          10,
          Math.max(
            2,
            rect.width / 6
          )
        )
      );

    const previousX =
      Number(
        window.TFM_LAST_POINTER_X
      );

    const previousY =
      Number(
        window.TFM_LAST_POINTER_Y
      );

    const startX =
      Number.isFinite(previousX)
        ? previousX
        : Math.max(
            0,
            target.x +
              randomDelay(
                -140,
                140
              )
          );

    const startY =
      Number.isFinite(previousY)
        ? previousY
        : Math.max(
            0,
            target.y +
              randomDelay(
                -100,
                100
              )
          );

    const duration =
      randomDelay(
        profile
          .pointerDuration
          .minimum,
        profile
          .pointerDuration
          .maximum
      );

    const path =
      HumanBehavior
        .curvedMousePath(
          startX,
          startY,
          target.x,
          target.y,
          duration
        );

    const usefulPoints =
      path.length > 14
        ? path.slice(-14)
        : path;

    for (
      const point
      of usefulPoints
    ) {
      dispatchMouseEvent(
        document,
        'mousemove',
        point.x,
        point.y,
        0
      );

      await wait(
        randomDelay(
          4,
          12
        )
      );
    }

    window.TFM_LAST_POINTER_X =
      target.x;

    window.TFM_LAST_POINTER_Y =
      target.y;

    return {
      x: target.x,
      y: target.y
    };
  }

  async function performNaturalClick(
    element,
    profile
  ) {
    if (
      !isElementClickable(
        element
      )
    ) {
      return {
        clicked: false,
        reason:
          'element-not-clickable'
      };
    }

    const pointer =
      await movePointerNaturally(
        element,
        profile
      );

    if (!pointer) {
      return {
        clicked: false,
        reason:
          'pointer-move-failed'
      };
    }

    const {
      x,
      y
    } = pointer;

    dispatchPointerEvent(
      element,
      'pointerover',
      x,
      y,
      0
    );

    dispatchPointerEvent(
      element,
      'pointerenter',
      x,
      y,
      0
    );

    dispatchMouseEvent(
      element,
      'mouseover',
      x,
      y,
      0
    );

    dispatchMouseEvent(
      element,
      'mouseenter',
      x,
      y,
      0
    );

    await wait(
      randomDelay(
        15,
        55
      )
    );

    dispatchPointerEvent(
      element,
      'pointerdown',
      x,
      y,
      1
    );

    dispatchMouseEvent(
      element,
      'mousedown',
      x,
      y,
      1
    );

    await wait(
      randomDelay(
        profile
          .clickHold
          .minimum,
        profile
          .clickHold
          .maximum
      )
    );

    dispatchMouseEvent(
      element,
      'mouseup',
      x,
      y,
      0
    );

    dispatchPointerEvent(
      element,
      'pointerup',
      x,
      y,
      0
    );

    try {
      element.click();
    } catch (error) {
      debugLogger.warn(
        'Native element.click() failed.',
        error
      );

      return {
        clicked: false,
        reason:
          'native-click-failed'
      };
    }

    dispatchPointerEvent(
      element,
      'pointerleave',
      x,
      y,
      0
    );

    dispatchMouseEvent(
      element,
      'mouseleave',
      x,
      y,
      0
    );

    return {
      clicked: true,
      reason: 'clicked'
    };
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // THANK-YOU MESSAGE ENGINE
  // ==========================================================

  const THANK_YOU_SELECTORS = [
    'textarea[placeholder*="message" i]',
    'input[placeholder*="message" i]',
    'div[role="textbox"]',
    '[contenteditable="true"]'
  ];

  function findThankYouInput() {
    for (
      const selector
      of THANK_YOU_SELECTORS
    ) {
      const matches =
        document
          .querySelectorAll(
            selector
          );

      for (
        const element
        of matches
      ) {
        if (
          isElementClickable(
            element
          )
        ) {
          return element;
        }
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  function setInputValue(
    element,
    value
  ) {
    if (
      element.isContentEditable
    ) {
      element.textContent =
        value;

      return;
    }

    const prototype =
      element.tagName ===
        'TEXTAREA'
        ? HTMLTextAreaElement
            .prototype
        : HTMLInputElement
            .prototype;

    const descriptor =
      Object
        .getOwnPropertyDescriptor(
          prototype,
          'value'
        );

    if (
      descriptor?.set
    ) {
      descriptor.set.call(
        element,
        value
      );
    } else {
      element.value =
        value;
    }
  }

  function emitInputEvent(
    element,
    character = null,
    inputType =
      'insertText'
  ) {
    try {
      element.dispatchEvent(
        new InputEvent(
          'input',
          {
            bubbles: true,
            composed: true,
            inputType,
            data: character
          }
        )
      );
    } catch (error) {
      element.dispatchEvent(
        new Event(
          'input',
          {
            bubbles: true
          }
        )
      );
    }
  }

  async function sendThankYouMessage() {
    const mode =
      settings.get(
        'thankYouMode'
      ) || 'random';

    if (
      mode === 'off' ||
      mode === false
    ) {
      eventManager.emit(
        'THANK_YOU_SKIPPED',
        {
          reason: 'disabled'
        }
      );

      return false;
    }

    const input =
      findThankYouInput();

    if (!input) {
      eventManager.emit(
        'THANK_YOU_SKIPPED',
        {
          reason:
            'input-not-found'
        }
      );

      return false;
    }

    const messages =
      settings.get(
        'thankYouMessages'
      ) || [
        'Ty❤️',
        'thank you!',
        'thanks man',
        'yay ty',
        'legend 🔥'
      ];

    if (
      !Array.isArray(
        messages
      ) ||
      messages.length === 0
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    const message =
      mode === 'short'
        ? 'ty'
        : messages[
            Math.floor(
              Math.random() *
              messages.length
            )
          ];

    await wait(
      randomDelay(
        900,
        1600
      )
    );

    if (
      !isElementConnected(
        input
      )
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    input.focus();

    setInputValue(
      input,
      ''
    );

    emitInputEvent(
      input,
      null,
      'deleteContentBackward'
    );

    let currentValue =
      '';

    for (
      const character
      of message
    ) {
      if (
        !isElementConnected(
          input
        )
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      currentValue +=
        character;

      setInputValue(
        input,
        currentValue
      );

      emitInputEvent(
        input,
        character,
        'insertText'
      );

      await wait(
        randomDelay(
          55,
          135
        )
      );
    }

    await wait(
      randomDelay(
        500,
        1050
      )
    );

    input.dispatchEvent(
      new KeyboardEvent(
        'keydown',
        {
          key: 'Enter',
          code: 'Enter',
          bubbles: true,
          cancelable: true
        }
      )
    );

    input.dispatchEvent(
      new KeyboardEvent(
        'keypress',
        {
          key: 'Enter',
          code: 'Enter',
          bubbles: true,
          cancelable: true
        }
      )
    );

    input.dispatchEvent(
      new KeyboardEvent(
        'keyup',
        {
          key: 'Enter',
          code: 'Enter',
          bubbles: true,
          cancelable: true
        }
      )
    );

    eventManager.emit(
      'THANK_YOU_SENT',
      {
        message
      }
    );

    return true;
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // EVENT-DRIVEN SNIPER
  // ==========================================================

  class EventDrivenSniper {
    constructor() {
      this.state =
        'BOOTING';

      this.observer =
        null;

      this.pollInterval =
        null;

      this.watchdogInterval =
        null;

      this.scanTimeout =
        null;

      this.currentButton =
        null;

      this.currentMatch =
        null;

      this.currentVerifier =
        null;

      this.cycleStartedAt =
        0;

      this.detectedAt =
        0;

      this.lastClaimAt =
        0;

      this.lastFingerprint =
        null;

      this.lastFingerprintAt =
        0;

      this.retryUsed =
        false;

      this.processing =
        false;

      this.destroyed =
        false;

      this.warmupComplete =
        false;

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.initialize();
    }

    transition(
      nextState,
      payload = {}
    ) {
      const previousState =
        this.state;

      this.state =
        nextState;

      debugLogger.info(
        `Sniper state: ${previousState} → ${nextState}`,
        payload
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'SNIPER_STATE_CHANGED',
        {
          previousState,
          state: nextState,
          ...payload
        }
      );
    }

    initialize() {
      this.transition(
        'WARMING_UP'
      );

      this.disposables
        .addTimeout(
          setTimeout(() => {
            this.warmupComplete =
              true;

            this.transition(
              settings.get(
                'sniperEnabled'
              )
                ? 'WATCHING'
                : 'DISABLED'
            );

            eventManager.emit(
              'SNIPER_ARMED'
            );

            this.scheduleScan(
              0
            );
          }, 1200)
        );

      this.setupObserver();

      this.pollInterval =
        this.disposables
          .addInterval(
            setInterval(() => {
              if (
                settings.get(
                  'sniperEnabled'
                )
              ) {
                this.scan();
              }
            }, 240)
          );

      this.watchdogInterval =
        this.disposables
          .addInterval(
            setInterval(() => {
              this.runWatchdog();
            }, 1500)
          );
    }

    setupObserver() {
      if (
        this.observer
      ) {
        this.observer
          .disconnect();
      }

      this.observer =
        new MutationObserver(
          mutations => {
            if (
              !settings.get(
                'sniperEnabled'
              ) ||
              !this.warmupComplete ||
              this.destroyed
            ) {
              return;
            }

            const meaningful =
              mutations.some(
                mutation =>
                  mutation.type ===
                    'childList' ||
                  mutation.type ===
                    'characterData' ||
                  (
                    mutation.type ===
                      'attributes' &&
                    [
                      'class',
                      'style',
                      'disabled',
                      'aria-disabled'
                    ].includes(
                      mutation
                        .attributeName
                    )
                  )
              );

            if (meaningful) {
              this.scheduleScan(
                25
              );
            }
          }
        );

      this.observer.observe(
        document.documentElement,
        {
          childList: true,
          subtree: true,
          characterData: true,
          attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: [
            'class',
            'style',
            'disabled',
            'aria-disabled'
          ]
        }
      );

      this.disposables
        .addObserver(
          this.observer
        );
    }

    scheduleScan(
      delay = 30
    ) {
      if (
        this.scanTimeout
      ) {
        clearTimeout(
          this.scanTimeout
        );
      }

      this.scanTimeout =
        setTimeout(
          () => {
            this.scanTimeout =
              null;

            this.scan();
          },
          delay
        );
    }

    scan() {
      if (
        this.destroyed ||
        this.processing ||
        !this.warmupComplete ||
        !settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const now =
        performance.now();

      const cooldown =
        Number(
          settings.get(
            'claimCooldownMs'
          ) || 800
        );

      if (
        now -
          this.lastClaimAt <
        cooldown
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const match =
        detection
          .findBestCoindropButton();

      if (!match) {
        if (
          this.state !==
          'WATCHING'
        ) {
          this.transition(
            'WATCHING'
          );
        }

        return;
      }

      const fingerprint =
        getElementFingerprint(
          match.element
        );

      if (
        fingerprint ===
          this.lastFingerprint &&
        Date.now() -
          this.lastFingerprintAt <
          7000
      ) {
        return;
      }

      this.lastFingerprint =
        fingerprint;

      this.lastFingerprintAt =
        Date.now();

      this.beginClaimCycle(
        match
      );
    }

    async beginClaimCycle(
      match
    ) {
      if (
        this.processing
      ) {
        return;
      }

      this.processing =
        true;

      this.retryUsed =
        false;

      this.currentMatch =
        match;

      this.currentButton =
        match.element;

      this.cycleStartedAt =
        performance.now();

      this.detectedAt =
        performance.now();

      this.transition(
        'DROP_FOUND',
        {
          detectionMethod:
            match.detectionMethod,
          score:
            match.score,
          red:
            match.red
        }
      );

      statsManager
        .recordDetection(
          match.detectionMethod
        );

      eventManager.emit(
        'DROP_FOUND',
        {
          button:
            match.element,
          text:
            match.text,
          score:
            match.score,
          detectionMethod:
            match.detectionMethod,
          red:
            match.red,
          detectedAt:
            this.detectedAt
        }
      );

      const profile =
        getCurrentProfile();

      const delay =
        randomDelay(
          profile.minimum,
          profile.maximum
        );

      eventManager.emit(
        'CLAIM_SCHEDULED',
        {
          delay,
          profile:
            profile.key
        }
      );

      this.transition(
        'WAITING_TO_CLAIM',
        {
          delay,
          profile:
            profile.key
        }
      );

      await wait(delay);

      if (
        !settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        )
      ) {
        this.finishCycle(
          'disabled'
        );

        return;
      }

      await this.attemptClaim(
        false
      );
    }

    async attemptClaim(
      isRetry
    ) {
      const profile =
        getCurrentProfile();

      let button =
        this.currentButton;

      if (
        !isElementClickable(
          button
        )
      ) {
        const freshMatch =
          detection
            .findBestCoindropButton();

        if (freshMatch) {
          button =
            freshMatch.element;

          this.currentMatch =
            freshMatch;

          this.currentButton =
            button;
        }
      }

      if (
        !isElementClickable(
          button
        )
      ) {
        await this.handleFailure(
          'button-not-clickable'
        );

        return;
      }

      this.currentVerifier =
        new ClaimVerifier(
          button
        );

      this.transition(
        isRetry
          ? 'RETRYING'
          : 'CLAIMING',
        {
          retry: isRetry
        }
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        isRetry
          ? 'CLAIM_RETRY'
          : 'CLAIM_START',
        {
          button,
          retry: isRetry,
          profile:
            profile.key
        }
      );

      if (isRetry) {
        statsManager
          .recordRetry();
      }

      const clickResult =
        await performNaturalClick(
          button,
          profile
        );

      if (
        !clickResult.clicked
      ) {
        await this.handleFailure(
          clickResult.reason
        );

        return;
      }

      this.lastClaimAt =
        performance.now();

      eventManager.emit(
        'CLICK_DISPATCHED',
        {
          button,
          retry: isRetry
        }
      );

      this.transition(
        'VERIFYING'
      );

      const verification =
        await this
          .currentVerifier
          .waitForResult(
            profile.verifyTimeout,
            100
          );

      if (
        verification.success
      ) {
        await this.handleSuccess(
          verification.signal
        );

        return;
      }

      if (
        !this.retryUsed
      ) {
        this.retryUsed =
          true;

        await wait(
          randomDelay(
            140,
            360
          )
        );

        await this.attemptClaim(
          true
        );

        return;
      }

      await this.handleFailure(
        verification.signal ||
        'unconfirmed'
      );
    }

    async handleSuccess(
      signal
    ) {
      const reactionTime =
        performance.now() -
        this.detectedAt;

      statsManager
        .recordSuccess(
          reactionTime
        );

      this.transition(
        'SUCCESS',
        {
          signal,
          reactionTime:
            Math.round(
              reactionTime
            )
        }
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
        {
          signal,
          reaction:
            Math.round(
              reactionTime
            ),
          retryUsed:
            this.retryUsed
        }
      );

      try {
        await sendThankYouMessage();
      } catch (error) {
        debugLogger.warn(
          'Thank-you message failed.',
          error
        );
      }

      await wait(
        Number(
          settings.get(
            'claimCooldownMs'
          ) || 800
        )
      );

      this.finishCycle(
        'success'
      );
    }

    async handleFailure(
      reason
    ) {
      statsManager
        .recordFailure(
          reason
        );

      this.transition(
        'FAILED',
        {
          reason
        }
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'CLAIM_FAIL',
        {
          reason,
          retryUsed:
            this.retryUsed
        }
      );

      await wait(
        Number(
          settings.get(
            'claimCooldownMs'
          ) || 800
        )
      );

      this.finishCycle(
        reason
      );
    }

    finishCycle(
      result
    ) {
      this.processing =
        false;

      this.retryUsed =
        false;

      this.currentButton =
        null;

      this.currentMatch =
        null;

      this.currentVerifier =
        null;

      this.cycleStartedAt =
        0;

      this.detectedAt =
        0;

      this.transition(
        settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        )
          ? 'WATCHING'
          : 'DISABLED',
        {
          result
        }
      );

      this.scheduleScan(
        80
      );
    }

    runWatchdog() {
      if (
        !this.processing ||
        !this.cycleStartedAt
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const elapsed =
        performance.now() -
        this.cycleStartedAt;

      if (
        elapsed < 10000
      ) {
        return;
      }

      debugLogger.warn(
        'Sniper watchdog reset triggered.',
        {
          elapsed:
            Math.round(
              elapsed
            ),
          state:
            this.state
        }
      );

      statsManager
        .recordFailure(
          'watchdog-timeout'
        );

      eventManager.emit(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        {
          elapsed:
            Math.round(
              elapsed
            ),
          state:
            this.state
        }
      );

      this.processing =
        false;

      this.currentButton =
        null;

      this.currentMatch =
        null;

      this.currentVerifier =
        null;

      this.retryUsed =
        false;

      this.cycleStartedAt =
        0;

      this.detectedAt =
        0;

      this.transition(
        settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        )
          ? 'WATCHING'
          : 'DISABLED'
      );

      this.setupObserver();

      this.scheduleScan(
        150
      );
    }

    setEnabled(
      enabled
    ) {
      settings.set(
        'sniperEnabled',
        Boolean(enabled)
      );

      if (enabled) {
        this.setupObserver();

        this.transition(
          'WATCHING'
        );

        this.scheduleScan(
          0
        );
      } else {
        this.processing =
          false;

        this.currentButton =
          null;

        this.currentMatch =
          null;

        this.currentVerifier =
          null;

        this.retryUsed =
          false;

        this.transition(
          'DISABLED'
        );
      }

      eventManager.emit(
        'SNIPER_TOGGLED',
        {
          enabled:
            Boolean(enabled)
        }
      );

      core.pillButton
        ?.updateBadge?.();
    }

    health() {
      return {
        state:
          this.state,

        processing:
          this.processing,

        warmupComplete:
          this.warmupComplete,

        observerAttached:
          Boolean(
            this.observer
          ),

        currentButtonConnected:
          isElementConnected(
            this.currentButton
          ),

        retryUsed:
          this.retryUsed,

        lastClaimAt:
          this.lastClaimAt,

        lastFingerprint:
          this.lastFingerprint
      };
    }

    recover() {
      this.processing =
        false;

      this.retryUsed =
        false;

      this.currentButton =
        null;

      this.currentMatch =
        null;

      this.currentVerifier =
        null;

      this.cycleStartedAt =
        0;

      this.detectedAt =
        0;

      this.setupObserver();

      this.transition(
        settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        )
          ? 'WATCHING'
          : 'DISABLED'
      );

      this.scheduleScan(
        50
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'SNIPER_RECOVERED'
      );
    }

    destroy() {
      this.destroyed =
        true;

      this.processing =
        false;

      if (
        this.scanTimeout
      ) {
        clearTimeout(
          this.scanTimeout
        );
      }

      this.disposables.clear();

      if (
        this.observer
      ) {
        this.observer
          .disconnect();
      }

      this.transition(
        'DESTROYED'
      );
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // START V4 SNIPER
  // ==========================================================

  const v4Sniper =
    new EventDrivenSniper();

  core.v4Sniper =
    v4Sniper;

  core.sniper =
    v4Sniper;

  extension.sniper =
    v4Sniper;

  extension.speedProfiles =
    SPEED_PROFILES;

  extension.sendThankYouMessage =
    sendThankYouMessage;

  extension.performNaturalClick =
    performNaturalClick;

  // ==========================================================
  // PROFILE EVENTS
  // ==========================================================

  let lastProfile =
    settings.get(
      'profile'
    ) || 'normal';

  const profileWatcher =
    setInterval(() => {
      const profile =
        settings.get(
          'profile'
        ) || 'normal';

      if (
        profile !==
        lastProfile
      ) {
        const previous =
          lastProfile;

        lastProfile =
          profile;

        eventManager.emit(
          'PROFILE_CHANGED',
          {
            previous,
            profile
          }
        );

        debugLogger.info(
          `Profile changed: ${previous} → ${profile}`
        );
      }
    }, 500);

  extension.profileWatcher =
    profileWatcher;

  // ==========================================================
  // PUBLIC DEBUG HELPERS
  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    scan() {
      return v4Sniper.scan();
    },

    health() {
      return v4Sniper.health();
    },

    recover() {
      return v4Sniper.recover();
    },

    enable() {
      return v4Sniper
        .setEnabled(true);
    },

    disable() {
      return v4Sniper
        .setEnabled(false);
    },

    findButton() {
      return detection
        .findBestCoindropButton();
    },

    logs(limit = 50) {
      return debugLogger.get(
        limit
      );
    },

    stats() {
      return statsManager
        .getStats();
    },

    sendThanks() {
      return sendThankYouMessage();
    }
  };

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 18 loaded successfully.',
    {
      profile:
        getCurrentProfile()
          .key
    }
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_PART_18_READY',
    {
      sniper:
        v4Sniper,
      profile:
        getCurrentProfile()
          .key
    }
  );
})();

  // ==========================================================
  // LIVE HUD
  // ==========================================================

  class LiveHUD {
    constructor() {
      this.element = null;
      this.statusElement = null;
      this.metaElement = null;
      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      if (window.TFM_PILL_ONLY_MODE) return;

      this.create();
      this.bind();
    }

    create() {
      const existing =
        document.getElementById(
          'tfm-live-hud'
        );

      if (existing) {
        existing.remove();
      }

      const hud =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      hud.id =
        'tfm-live-hud';

      hud.innerHTML = `
        <div id="tfm-live-hud-header">
          <span id="tfm-live-hud-title">
            TheFreshMaker
          </span>

          <span style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">
            <span id="tfm-live-hud-version">
              v${extension.version}
            </span>

            <button
              id="tfm-live-hud-minimize"
              class="tfm-panel-minimize"
              type="button"
              aria-label="Minimize runtime log"
            >−</button>
          </span>
        </div>

        <div id="tfm-live-hud-status">
          🟡 Initialising
        </div>

        <div id="tfm-live-hud-meta">
          profile: ${
            settings.get('profile') ||
            'normal'
          }
        </div>
      `;

      document.body
        .appendChild(hud);

      this.element =
        hud;

      this.statusElement =
        hud.querySelector(
          '#tfm-live-hud-status'
        );

      this.metaElement =
        hud.querySelector(
          '#tfm-live-hud-meta'
        );

      hud.querySelector(
        '#tfm-live-hud-minimize'
      )?.addEventListener(
        'click',
        event => {
          event.stopPropagation();
          this.toggleMinimized();
        }
      );

      this.applyMinimizedState();

      this.updateVisibility();

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            this.refreshMeta();
          }, 1000)
        );
    }

    applyMinimizedState() {
      if (!this.element) {
        return;
      }

      const ui =
        settings.get(
          'uiSettings'
        ) || {};

      const minimized =
        ui.liveHudMinimized ===
        true;

      this.element.classList.toggle(
        'tfm-minimized',
        minimized
      );

      const button =
        this.element.querySelector(
          '#tfm-live-hud-minimize'
        );

      if (button) {
        button.textContent =
          minimized ? '+' : '−';

        button.setAttribute(
          'aria-label',
          minimized
            ? 'Restore runtime log'
            : 'Minimize runtime log'
        );
      }
    }

    toggleMinimized() {
      const ui =
        settings.get(
          'uiSettings'
        ) || {};

      settings.set(
        'uiSettings',
        {
          ...ui,
          liveHudMinimized:
            !ui.liveHudMinimized
        }
      );

      this.applyMinimizedState();
    }

    updateVisibility() {
      if (!this.element) {
        return;
      }

      const ui =
        settings.get(
          'uiSettings'
        ) || {};

      this.element
        .classList
        .toggle(
          'tfm-hidden',
          ui.showStatus === false
        );
    }

    setStatus(
      text,
      type = 'default'
    ) {
      if (
        !this.statusElement
      ) {
        return;
      }

      this.statusElement
        .textContent =
        text;

      const colours = {
        default: '#ffffff',
        success: '#a9ffd2',
        warning: '#ffe4a8',
        error: '#ffc4c4',
        info: '#c8f7ff'
      };

      this.statusElement
        .style.color =
        colours[type] ||
        colours.default;
    }

    refreshMeta() {
      if (
        !this.metaElement
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const stats =
        statsManager
          .getStats();

      const profile =
        settings.get(
          'profile'
        ) || 'normal';

      const health =
        extension.sniper
          ?.health?.() || {};

      const reaction =
        stats.lastReaction ===
          null
          ? '-'
          : stats.lastReaction +
            'ms';

      this.metaElement
        .textContent =
        `profile: ${profile} • state: ${
          health.state ||
          'unknown'
        } • last: ${reaction}`;

      this.updateVisibility();
    }

    bind() {
      eventManager.on(
        'SNIPER_ARMED',
        () => {
          this.setStatus(
            '🟢 Sniper armed',
            'success'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'DROP_FOUND',
        event => {
          this.setStatus(
            `🎯 Drop found • ${event.detectionMethod}`,
            'info'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_SCHEDULED',
        event => {
          this.setStatus(
            `⏳ Claiming in ${event.delay}ms`,
            'warning'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_START',
        () => {
          this.setStatus(
            '⚔️ Claiming drop',
            'info'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_RETRY',
        () => {
          this.setStatus(
            '🔄 Retrying claim',
            'warning'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
        event => {
          this.setStatus(
            `🏆 Claimed in ${event.reaction}ms`,
            'success'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_FAIL',
        event => {
          this.setStatus(
            `❌ Claim failed • ${event.reason}`,
            'error'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        () => {
          this.setStatus(
            '⚠️ Watchdog recovered',
            'warning'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'PROFILE_CHANGED',
        event => {
          this.setStatus(
            `⚙️ Profile: ${event.profile}`,
            'info'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'SNIPER_TOGGLED',
        event => {
          this.setStatus(
            event.enabled
              ? '🟢 Sniper enabled'
              : '🔴 Sniper disabled',
            event.enabled
              ? 'success'
              : 'error'
          );
        }
      );
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables.clear();

      if (
        this.element &&
        this.element.parentNode
      ) {
        this.element.remove();
      }

      this.element = null;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // EVENT TOASTS
  // ==========================================================

  class EventToastManager {
    constructor() {
      this.container = null;
      this.active =
        new Set();

      if (window.TFM_PILL_ONLY_MODE) return;

      this.createContainer();
      this.bind();
    }

    createContainer() {
      const existing =
        document.getElementById(
          'tfm-event-toast-container'
        );

      if (existing) {
        this.container =
          existing;

        return;
      }

      const container =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      container.id =
        'tfm-event-toast-container';

      container.style.display =
        'none';

      document.body
        .appendChild(container);

      this.container =
        container;
    }

    show(
      message,
      duration = 1400,
      type = 'info'
    ) {
      if (window.TFM_PILL_ONLY_MODE) return;

      if (!this.container) {
        this.createContainer();
      }

      const toast =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      toast.className =
        `tfm-event-toast tfm-${type}`;

      toast.textContent =
        message;

      this.container
        .appendChild(toast);

      this.active.add(toast);

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        toast.classList
          .add(
            'tfm-visible'
          );
      });

      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList
          .remove(
            'tfm-visible'
          );

        setTimeout(() => {
          this.active.delete(
            toast
          );

          if (
            toast.parentNode
          ) {
            toast.remove();
          }
        }, 250);
      }, duration);

      return toast;
    }

    bind() {
      eventManager.on(
        'DROP_FOUND',
        event => {
          this.show(
            `🎯 COINDROP DETECTED • ${event.detectionMethod}`,
            1200,
            'info'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_RETRY',
        () => {
          this.show(
            '🔄 SECOND SHOT',
            900,
            'warning'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
        event => {
          this.show(
            `🏆 CLAIMED IN ${event.reaction}ms`,
            1800,
            'success'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_FAIL',
        event => {
          this.show(
            `❌ MISSED • ${event.reason}`,
            1400,
            'error'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        () => {
          this.show(
            '⚠️ SNIPER RECOVERED',
            1300,
            'warning'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'THANK_YOU_SENT',
        event => {
          this.show(
            `💬 ${event.message}`,
            1200,
            'info'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'PROFILE_CHANGED',
        event => {
          this.show(
            `⚙️ PROFILE: ${String(
              event.profile
            ).toUpperCase()}`,
            900,
            'info'
          );
        }
      );
    }

    clear() {
      this.active
        .forEach(toast => {
          if (
            toast.parentNode
          ) {
            toast.remove();
          }
        });

      this.active.clear();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // STATS DASHBOARD
  // ==========================================================

  class StatsDashboard {
    constructor() {
      this.element = null;
      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      if (window.TFM_PILL_ONLY_MODE) return;

      this.create();
      this.bind();
    }

    create() {
      const existing =
        document.getElementById(
          'tfm-stats-panel'
        );

      if (existing) {
        existing.remove();
      }

      const panel =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      panel.id =
        'tfm-stats-panel';

      panel.innerHTML = `
        <div id="tfm-stats-title">
          <span>LIVE STATS</span>

          <button
            id="tfm-stats-minimize"
            class="tfm-panel-minimize"
            type="button"
            aria-label="Minimize live stats"
          >−</button>
        </div>

        <div id="tfm-stats-grid"></div>
      `;

      document.body
        .appendChild(panel);

      this.element =
        panel;

      panel.querySelector(
        '#tfm-stats-minimize'
      )?.addEventListener(
        'click',
        event => {
          event.stopPropagation();
          this.toggleMinimized();
        }
      );

      this.applyMinimizedState();

      this.render();

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            this.render();
          }, 1500)
        );
    }

    applyMinimizedState() {
      if (!this.element) {
        return;
      }

      const ui =
        settings.get(
          'uiSettings'
        ) || {};

      const minimized =
        ui.statsMinimized ===
        true;

      this.element.classList.toggle(
        'tfm-minimized',
        minimized
      );

      const button =
        this.element.querySelector(
          '#tfm-stats-minimize'
        );

      if (button) {
        button.textContent =
          minimized ? '+' : '−';

        button.setAttribute(
          'aria-label',
          minimized
            ? 'Restore live stats'
            : 'Minimize live stats'
        );
      }
    }

    toggleMinimized() {
      const ui =
        settings.get(
          'uiSettings'
        ) || {};

      settings.set(
        'uiSettings',
        {
          ...ui,
          statsMinimized:
            !ui.statsMinimized
        }
      );

      this.applyMinimizedState();
    }

    formatValue(
      value,
      suffix = ''
    ) {
      if (
        value === null ||
        value === undefined
      ) {
        return '-';
      }

      return String(value) +
        suffix;
    }

    render() {
      if (!this.element) {
        return;
      }

      const ui =
        settings.get(
          'uiSettings'
        ) || {};

      this.element
        .classList
        .toggle(
          'tfm-hidden',
          ui.showStats === false
        );

      const grid =
        this.element
          .querySelector(
            '#tfm-stats-grid'
          );

      if (!grid) {
        return;
      }

      const stats =
        statsManager
          .getStats();

      const sessionMinutes =
        Math.floor(
          (
            Date.now() -
            stats.sessionStart
          ) /
          60000
        );

      const items = [
        [
          stats.successfulClaims,
          'Claims'
        ],
        [
          stats.failedAttempts,
          'Failed'
        ],
        [
          this.formatValue(
            stats.fastestClaim,
            stats.fastestClaim ===
              null
              ? ''
              : 'ms'
          ),
          'Fastest'
        ],
        [
          this.formatValue(
            stats.averageReaction,
            stats.averageReaction
              ? 'ms'
              : ''
          ),
          'Average'
        ],
        [
          stats.currentStreak,
          'Streak'
        ],
        [
          sessionMinutes + 'm',
          'Session'
        ]
      ];

      grid.innerHTML =
        '';

      items.forEach(
        ([value, label]) => {
          const card =
            document.createElement(
              'div'
            );

          card.className =
            'tfm-stat-card';

          card.innerHTML = `
            <span class="tfm-stat-number">
              ${value}
            </span>

            <span class="tfm-stat-label">
              ${label}
            </span>
          `;

          grid.appendChild(
            card
          );
        }
      );
    }

    bind() {
      eventManager.on(
        'STATS_UPDATED',
        () => {
          this.render();
        }
      );
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables.clear();

      if (
        this.element &&
        this.element.parentNode
      ) {
        this.element.remove();
      }

      this.element = null;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // COIN SCENE
  // ==========================================================

  class CoinSceneManager {
    constructor() {
      this.element = null;
      this.label = null;
      this.hideTimer = null;

      this.create();
    }

    create() {
      const existing =
        document.getElementById(
          'tfm-coin-scene'
        );

      if (existing) {
        existing.remove();
      }

      const scene =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      scene.id =
        'tfm-coin-scene';

      scene.innerHTML = `
        <div id="tfm-coin-scene-ring"></div>

        <div id="tfm-coin-scene-coin">
          🪙
        </div>

        <div id="tfm-coin-scene-label">
          COINDROP
        </div>
      `;

      document.body
        .appendChild(scene);

      this.element =
        scene;

      this.label =
        scene.querySelector(
          '#tfm-coin-scene-label'
        );
    }

    shouldShow() {
      const visuals =
        settings.get(
          'visuals'
        ) || {};

      return (
        visuals.enabled !==
          false &&
        visuals.coinScene !==
          false
      );
    }

    show(
      label = 'COINDROP'
    ) {
      if (
        !this.shouldShow()
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        !this.element ||
        !isElementConnected(
          this.element
        )
      ) {
        this.create();
      }

      if (this.label) {
        this.label.textContent =
          label;
      }

      this.element
        .classList
        .add(
          'tfm-visible'
        );

      if (this.hideTimer) {
        clearTimeout(
          this.hideTimer
        );
      }
    }

    hide(
      delay = 450
    ) {
      if (this.hideTimer) {
        clearTimeout(
          this.hideTimer
        );
      }

      this.hideTimer =
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.element
            ?.classList
            .remove(
              'tfm-visible'
            );
        }, delay);
    }

    found() {
      this.show(
        'DROP FOUND'
      );
    }

    grab() {
      this.show(
        'CLAIMING'
      );
    }

    win() {
      this.show(
        'CLAIMED!'
      );

      this.hide(
        1100
      );
    }

    fail() {
      this.show(
        'MISSED'
      );

      this.hide(
        800
      );
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // SPRITE REACTIONS
  // ==========================================================

  class SpriteReactionManager {
    constructor() {
      this.lastReactionAt =
        0;
    }

    getSprites() {
      return Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll(
          'img[data-sprite-key]'
        )
      );
    }

    shouldReact() {
      // User-selected stationary mode keeps the GIF's own frames playing,
      // but disables scripted hops, attacks and position reactions.
      return false;
    }

    clearReactionClasses(
      sprite
    ) {
      [
        'tfm-sprite-alert',
        'tfm-sprite-attack',
        'tfm-sprite-victory',
        'tfm-sprite-fail',
        'tfm-sprite-rival'
      ].forEach(
        className => {
          sprite.classList
            .remove(
              className
            );
        }
      );
    }

    react(
      reaction
    ) {
      if (
        !this.shouldReact()
      ) {
        return;
      }

      core.spriteManager?.pauseAll?.(1350);

      const sprites =
        this.getSprites();

      if (
        sprites.length === 0
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const classMap = {
        alert:
          'tfm-sprite-alert',
        attack:
          'tfm-sprite-attack',
        victory:
          'tfm-sprite-victory',
        fail:
          'tfm-sprite-fail',
        rival:
          'tfm-sprite-rival'
      };

      const className =
        classMap[reaction];

      if (!className) {
        return;
      }

      sprites.forEach(
        (sprite, index) => {
          this.clearReactionClasses(
            sprite
          );

          setTimeout(() => {
            void sprite.offsetWidth;

            sprite.classList
              .add(
                className
              );

            setTimeout(() => {
              sprite.classList
                .remove(
                  className
                );
            }, 1100);
          }, index * 55);
        }
      );

      this.lastReactionAt =
        Date.now();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // SCREEN FLASH
  // ==========================================================

  function flashScreen() {
    const visuals =
      settings.get(
        'visuals'
      ) || {};

    if (
      visuals.enabled ===
        false ||
      visuals.screenFlash ===
        false
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const root =
      document.documentElement;

    root.classList
      .remove(
        'tfm-screen-flash'
      );

    void root.offsetWidth;

    root.classList
      .add(
        'tfm-screen-flash'
      );

    setTimeout(() => {
      root.classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-screen-flash'
        );
    }, 380);
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // REACTION MANAGER
  // ==========================================================

  class ReactionManager {
    constructor(
      liveHUD,
      toastManager,
      statsDashboard,
      coinScene,
      spriteReactions
    ) {
      this.liveHUD =
        liveHUD;

      this.toastManager =
        toastManager;

      this.statsDashboard =
        statsDashboard;

      this.coinScene =
        coinScene;

      this.spriteReactions =
        spriteReactions;

      this.bind();
    }

    bind() {
      eventManager.on(
        'DROP_FOUND',
        event => {
          this.coinScene
            .found();

          this.spriteReactions
            .react(
              'alert'
            );

          flashScreen();

          debugLogger.info(
            'Visual DROP_FOUND reaction.',
            event
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_START',
        event => {
          this.coinScene
            .grab();

          this.spriteReactions
            .react(
              'attack'
            );

          core.spriteManager
            ?.rushToElement?.(
              event?.button,
              760
            );

          core.audioManager
            ?.play?.(
              'drop'
            );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_RETRY',
        () => {
          this.spriteReactions
            .react(
              'rival'
            );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
        () => {
          this.coinScene
            .win();

          this.spriteReactions
            .react(
              'victory'
            );

          const visuals =
            settings.get(
              'visuals'
            ) || {};

          if (
            visuals.enabled !==
              false &&
            visuals.particles !==
              false
          ) {
            core.Effects
              ?.showFireworks?.();
          }

          core.audioManager
            ?.play?.(
              'ty'
            );

          flashScreen();
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_FAIL',
        () => {
          this.coinScene
            .fail();

          this.spriteReactions
            .react(
              'fail'
            );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        () => {
          this.coinScene
            .hide(
              200
            );

          this.spriteReactions
            .react(
              'fail'
            );
        }
      );
    }
  }

// THEFRESHMAKER v4 UPGRADE EXTENSION
// Part 20
// Settings panel integration, diagnostics, backup/import/export,
// health monitor, recovery controls and menu upgrades.
// ============================================================

(function TheFreshMakerV4Part20() {
  'use strict';

  const extension =
    window.TheFreshMakerV4;

  const core =
    window.BFHelper;

  if (!extension || !core) {
    console.error(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 20 requires Parts 17–19.'
    );

    return;
  }

  if (
    window.TFM_V4_PART_20_LOADED
  ) {
    console.warn(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 20 already loaded.'
    );

    return;
  }

  window.TFM_V4_PART_20_LOADED =
    true;

  const {
    eventManager,
    debugLogger,
    statsManager,
    utilities,
    sniper,
    liveHUD,
    eventToast,
    statsDashboard
  } = extension;

  const {
    settings,
    Storage,
    Disposables
  } = core;

  const {
    normalizeText
  } = utilities;

  // ==========================================================
  // SETTINGS BACKUP MANAGER
  // ==========================================================

  class SettingsBackupManager {
    static buildPayload() {
      return {
        application:
          'TheFreshMaker',

        version:
          extension.version,

        exportedAt:
          new Date()
            .toISOString(),

        settings: {
          ...(settings.data || {})
        }
      };
    }

    static snapshot() {
      const payload =
        this.buildPayload();

      Storage.set(
        'bf_backup_latest',
        payload
      );

      return payload;
    }

    static exportText() {
      return JSON.stringify(
        this.snapshot(),
        null,
        2
      );
    }

    static validatePayload(
      payload
    ) {
      if (
        !payload ||
        typeof payload !==
          'object'
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          'Backup is not a valid object.'
        );
      }

      if (
        !payload.settings ||
        typeof payload.settings !==
          'object'
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          'Backup does not contain settings.'
        );
      }

      return true;
    }

    static importPayload(
      payload
    ) {
      this.validatePayload(
        payload
      );

      Object.entries(
        payload.settings
      ).forEach(
        ([key, value]) => {
          settings.set(
            key,
            value
          );
        }
      );

      this.snapshot();

      eventManager.emit(
        'SETTINGS_IMPORTED',
        {
          version:
            payload.version ||
            'unknown'
        }
      );

      return true;
    }

    static importText(
      text
    ) {
      const payload =
        JSON.parse(text);

      return this.importPayload(
        payload
      );
    }

    static recoverLatest() {
      const payload =
        Storage.get(
          'bf_backup_latest',
          null
        );

      if (!payload) {
        return false;
      }

      this.importPayload(
        payload
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'SETTINGS_RECOVERED'
      );

      return true;
    }

    static download() {
      const text =
        this.exportText();

      const blob =
        new Blob(
          [text],
          {
            type:
              'application/json'
          }
        );

      const url =
        URL.createObjectURL(
          blob
        );

      const anchor =
        document.createElement(
          'a'
        );

      anchor.href = url;

      anchor.download =
        'TheFreshMaker-' +
        extension.version +
        '-settings.json';

      document.body
        .appendChild(anchor);

      anchor.click();

      anchor.remove();

      setTimeout(() => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(
          url
        );
      }, 1000);
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // HEALTH MONITOR
  // ==========================================================

  class HealthMonitor {
    constructor() {
      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.lastHealth =
        null;

      this.failureCount =
        0;

      this.start();
    }

    inspect() {
      const sniperHealth =
        sniper?.health?.() ||
        {};

      const pillExists =
        Boolean(
          document.getElementById(
            'bf-pill'
          )
        );

      const hudExists =
        Boolean(
          document.getElementById(
            'tfm-live-hud'
          )
        );

      const bodyReady =
        Boolean(
          document.body
        );

      const healthy =
        bodyReady &&
        sniperHealth
          .observerAttached !==
          false;

      return {
        healthy,

        timestamp:
          Date.now(),

        bodyReady,

        pillExists,

        hudExists,

        sniper:
          sniperHealth,

        profile:
          settings.get(
            'profile'
          ),

        sniperEnabled:
          settings.get(
            'sniperEnabled'
          ),

        autoClaimRunning:
          settings.get(
            'autoClaimRunning'
          )
      };
    }

    start() {
      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            const health =
              this.inspect();

            this.lastHealth =
              health;

            if (!health.healthy) {
              this.failureCount += 1;

              debugLogger.warn(
                'Health monitor detected an unhealthy state.',
                health
              );

              eventManager.emit(
                'HEALTH_WARNING',
                health
              );

              if (
                this.failureCount >=
                2
              ) {
                this.recover(
                  health
                );
              }
            } else {
              this.failureCount =
                0;
            }
          }, 5000)
        );
    }

    recover(
      health = null
    ) {
      const report =
        health ||
        this.inspect();

      try {
        sniper?.recover?.();

        if (
          !document
            .getElementById(
              'bf-pill'
            )
        ) {
          core.pillButton
            ?.recreate?.();
        }

        if (
          !document
            .getElementById(
              'tfm-live-hud'
            )
        ) {
          extension.liveHUD
            ?.create?.();
        }

        if (
          !document
            .getElementById(
              'tfm-stats-panel'
            )
        ) {
          extension
            .statsDashboard
            ?.create?.();
        }

        this.failureCount =
          0;

        eventManager.emit(
          'HEALTH_RECOVERED',
          {
            report
          }
        );

        debugLogger.info(
          'Health recovery completed.',
          report
        );

        return true;
      } catch (error) {
        debugLogger.error(
          'Health recovery failed.',
          error
        );

        return false;
      }
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables.clear();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // PANEL STYLES
  // ==========================================================

  function injectSettingsPanelStyles() {
    if (
      document.getElementById(
        'tfm-settings-styles'
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const style =
      document.createElement(
        'style'
      );

    style.id =
      'tfm-settings-styles';

    style.textContent = `
      #tfm-settings-panel {
        position: fixed;
        right: 14px;
