  injectSettingsPanelStyles();

  // ==========================================================
  // SETTINGS PANEL
  // ==========================================================

  class V4SettingsPanel {
    constructor() {
      this.element = null;
      this.visible = false;
      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.create();
      this.bindKeyboard();
    }

    createCheckbox(
      labelText,
      checked,
      onChange
    ) {
      const row =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      row.className =
        'tfm-settings-row';

      const label =
        document.createElement(
          'label'
        );

      label.textContent =
        labelText;

      const input =
        document.createElement(
          'input'
        );

      input.type =
        'checkbox';

      input.checked =
        Boolean(checked);

      input.addEventListener(
        'change',
        () => {
          onChange(
            input.checked
          );
        }
      );

      row.appendChild(label);
      row.appendChild(input);

      return row;
    }

    createSelect(
      labelText,
      value,
      options,
      onChange
    ) {
      const row =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      row.className =
        'tfm-settings-row';

      const label =
        document.createElement(
          'label'
        );

      label.textContent =
        labelText;

      const select =
        document.createElement(
          'select'
        );

      options.forEach(
        optionData => {
          const option =
            document.createElement(
              'option'
            );

          option.value =
            optionData.value;

          option.textContent =
            optionData.label;

          select.appendChild(
            option
          );
        }
      );

      select.value =
        value;

      select.addEventListener(
        'change',
        () => {
          onChange(
            select.value
          );
        }
      );

      row.appendChild(label);
      row.appendChild(select);

      return row;
    }

    createNumber(
      labelText,
      value,
      minimum,
      maximum,
      step,
      onChange
    ) {
      const row =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      row.className =
        'tfm-settings-row';

      const label =
        document.createElement(
          'label'
        );

      label.textContent =
        labelText;

      const input =
        document.createElement(
          'input'
        );

      input.type =
        'number';

      input.min =
        String(minimum);

      input.max =
        String(maximum);

      input.step =
        String(step);

      input.value =
        String(value);

      input.addEventListener(
        'change',
        () => {
          const number =
            Math.max(
              minimum,
              Math.min(
                maximum,
                Number(
                  input.value
                ) || minimum
              )
            );

          input.value =
            String(number);

          onChange(number);
        }
      );

      row.appendChild(label);
      row.appendChild(input);

      return row;
    }

    createSection(
      title
    ) {
      const section =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      section.className =
        'tfm-settings-section';

      const heading =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      heading.className =
        'tfm-settings-section-title';

      heading.textContent =
        title;

      section.appendChild(
        heading
      );

      return section;
    }

    createButton(
      text,
      className,
      handler
    ) {
      const button =
        document.createElement(
          'button'
        );

      button.className =
        'tfm-settings-button ' +
        (
          className || ''
        );

      button.textContent =
        text;

      button.addEventListener(
        'click',
        handler
      );

      return button;
    }

    create() {
      const existing =
        document.getElementById(
          'tfm-settings-panel'
        );

      if (existing) {
        existing.remove();
      }

      const panel =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      panel.id =
        'tfm-settings-panel';

      panel.classList.add(
        'tfm-hidden'
      );

      const header =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      header.id =
        'tfm-settings-header';

      header.innerHTML = `
        <div id="tfm-settings-title">
          ⚙️ v4 Control Centre
        </div>
      `;

      const close =
        document.createElement(
          'button'
        );

      close.id =
        'tfm-settings-close';

      close.textContent =
        '✕';

      close.addEventListener(
        'click',
        () => this.hide()
      );

      header.appendChild(
        close
      );

      panel.appendChild(
        header
      );

      // SNIPER SECTION
      const sniperSection =
        this.createSection(
          'Sniper'
        );

      sniperSection.appendChild(
        this.createCheckbox(
          'Enabled',
          settings.get(
            'sniperEnabled'
          ),
          enabled => {
            sniper.setEnabled(
              enabled
            );
          }
        )
      );

      sniperSection.appendChild(
        this.createSelect(
          'Speed profile',
          settings.get(
            'profile'
          ) || 'normal',
          [
            {
              value:
                'aggressive',
              label:
                'Aggressive'
            },
            {
              value:
                'normal',
              label:
                'Normal'
            },
            {
              value:
                'lazy',
              label:
                'Lazy'
            }
          ],
          profile => {
            settings.set(
              'profile',
              profile
            );
          }
        )
      );

      sniperSection.appendChild(
        this.createSelect(
          'Detection mode',
          settings.get(
            'detectionMode'
          ) || 'smart',
          [
            {
              value:
                'smart',
              label:
                'Smart'
            },
            {
              value:
                'exact',
              label:
                'Exact text only'
            },
            {
              value:
                'fallback',
              label:
                'Allow fallback'
            }
          ],
          mode => {
            settings.set(
              'detectionMode',
              mode
            );
          }
        )
      );

      sniperSection.appendChild(
        this.createNumber(
          'Cooldown (ms)',
          Number(
            settings.get(
              'claimCooldownMs'
            ) || 800
          ),
          250,
          5000,
          50,
          value => {
            settings.set(
              'claimCooldownMs',
              value
            );
          }
        )
      );

      sniperSection.appendChild(
        this.createSelect(
          'Thank-you mode',
          settings.get(
            'thankYouMode'
          ) || 'random',
          [
            {
              value:
                'random',
              label:
                'Random'
            },
            {
              value:
                'short',
              label:
                'Short “ty”'
            },
            {
              value:
                'off',
              label:
                'Off'
            }
          ],
          mode => {
            settings.set(
              'thankYouMode',
              mode
            );
          }
        )
      );

      panel.appendChild(
        sniperSection
      );

      // DISPLAY SECTION
      const displaySection =
        this.createSection(
          'Display'
        );

      const uiSettings =
        settings.get(
          'uiSettings'
        ) || {};

      displaySection.appendChild(
        this.createCheckbox(
          'Show live HUD',
          uiSettings
            .showStatus !==
            false,
          enabled => {
            const current =
              settings.get(
                'uiSettings'
              ) || {};

            settings.set(
              'uiSettings',
              {
                ...current,
                showStatus:
                  enabled
              }
            );

            liveHUD
              ?.updateVisibility?.();
          }
        )
      );

      displaySection.appendChild(
        this.createCheckbox(
          'Show stats',
          uiSettings
            .showStats !==
            false,
          enabled => {
            const current =
              settings.get(
                'uiSettings'
              ) || {};

            settings.set(
              'uiSettings',
              {
                ...current,
                showStats:
                  enabled
              }
            );

            statsDashboard
              ?.render?.();
          }
        )
      );

      panel.appendChild(
        displaySection
      );

      // VISUALS SECTION
      const visualsSection =
        this.createSection(
          'Visual effects'
        );

      const visuals =
        settings.get(
          'visuals'
        ) || {};

      [
        [
          'Animations',
          'animations'
        ],
        [
          'Particles',
          'particles'
        ],
        [
          'Screen flash',
          'screenFlash'
        ],
        [
          'Coin scene',
          'coinScene'
        ],
        [
          'Sprite reactions',
          'spriteReactions'
        ]
      ].forEach(
        ([label, key]) => {
          visualsSection
            .appendChild(
              this.createCheckbox(
                label,
                visuals[key] !==
                  false,
                enabled => {
                  const current =
                    settings.get(
                      'visuals'
                    ) || {};

                  settings.set(
                    'visuals',
                    {
                      ...current,
                      [key]:
                        enabled
                    }
                  );
                }
              )
            );
        }
      );

      panel.appendChild(
        visualsSection
      );

      // DIAGNOSTICS SECTION
      const diagnosticSection =
        this.createSection(
          'Diagnostics'
        );

      diagnosticSection
        .appendChild(
          this.createCheckbox(
            'Debug logging',
            settings.get(
              'debugMode'
            ) !== false,
            enabled => {
              settings.set(
                'debugMode',
                enabled
              );
            }
          )
        );

      const healthBox =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      healthBox.id =
        'tfm-settings-health';

      healthBox.textContent =
        'Health data loading…';

      diagnosticSection
        .appendChild(
          healthBox
        );

      diagnosticSection
        .appendChild(
          this.createButton(
            'Run recovery',
            'tfm-warning',
            () => {
              const result =
                healthMonitor
                  .recover();

              eventToast?.show(
                result
                  ? '✓ Recovery completed'
                  : 'Recovery failed',
                1500,
                result
                  ? 'success'
                  : 'error'
              );
            }
          )
        );

      diagnosticSection
        .appendChild(
          this.createButton(
            'Copy diagnostic log',
            'tfm-secondary',
            async () => {
              const text =
                debugLogger
                  .exportText();

              try {
                await navigator
                  .clipboard
                  .writeText(
                    text
                  );

                eventToast?.show(
                  '✓ Diagnostic log copied',
                  1200,
                  'success'
                );
              } catch (error) {
                console.log(
                  text
                );

                eventToast?.show(
                  'Log printed to console',
                  1200,
                  'warning'
                );
              }
            }
          )
        );

      diagnosticSection
        .appendChild(
          this.createButton(
            'Clear diagnostic log',
            'tfm-danger',
            () => {
              debugLogger.clear();

              eventToast?.show(
                'Diagnostic log cleared',
                1000,
                'info'
              );
            }
          )
        );

      panel.appendChild(
        diagnosticSection
      );

      // BACKUP SECTION
      const backupSection =
        this.createSection(
          'Backup'
        );

      backupSection.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Download settings backup',
          '',
          () => {
            SettingsBackupManager
              .download();

            eventToast?.show(
              'Settings backup created',
              1200,
              'success'
            );
          }
        )
      );

      backupSection.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Import settings backup',
          'tfm-secondary',
          () => {
            const input =
              document.createElement(
                'input'
              );

            input.type =
              'file';

            input.accept =
              'application/json,.json';

            input.addEventListener(
              'change',
              async () => {
                const file =
                  input.files?.[0];

                if (!file) {
                  return;
                }

                try {
                  const text =
                    await file.text();

                  SettingsBackupManager
                    .importText(
                      text
                    );

                  eventToast?.show(
                    'Settings imported',
                    1400,
                    'success'
                  );

                  this.recreate();

                  sniper.recover();
                } catch (error) {
                  debugLogger.error(
                    'Settings import failed.',
                    error
                  );

                  eventToast?.show(
                    'Invalid settings backup',
                    1600,
                    'error'
                  );
                }
              }
            );

            input.click();
          }
        )
      );

      backupSection.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Recover latest snapshot',
          'tfm-warning',
          () => {
            const recovered =
              SettingsBackupManager
                .recoverLatest();

            eventToast?.show(
              recovered
                ? 'Latest snapshot restored'
                : 'No snapshot found',
              1400,
              recovered
                ? 'success'
                : 'warning'
            );

            if (recovered) {
              this.recreate();
              sniper.recover();
            }
          }
        )
      );

      panel.appendChild(
        backupSection
      );

      // STATS SECTION
      const statsSection =
        this.createSection(
          'Statistics'
        );

      statsSection.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Reset session stats',
          'tfm-warning',
          () => {
            const stats =
              statsManager
                .getStats();

            stats.sessionStart =
              Date.now();

            stats.sessionClaims =
              0;

            stats.sessionFailures =
              0;

            statsManager.save(
              stats
            );

            eventToast?.show(
              'Session stats reset',
              1200,
              'success'
            );
          }
        )
      );

      statsSection.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Reset all claim stats',
          'tfm-danger',
          () => {
            if (
              !confirm(
                'Reset all coindrop statistics?'
              )
            ) {
              return;
            }

            const defaults =
              {
                ...statsManager
                  .getStats(),

                detectedDrops: 0,
                successfulClaims: 0,
                failedAttempts: 0,
                missedClaims: 0,
                retries: 0,
                fastestClaim: null,
                totalReactionTime: 0,
                averageReaction: 0,
                lastReaction: null,
                sessionClaims: 0,
                sessionFailures: 0,
                sessionStart:
                  Date.now(),
                currentStreak: 0,
                longestStreak: 0,
                lastDetectedAt: null,
                lastSuccessAt: null,
                lastFailureAt: null,
                lastFailureReason: null,
                detectionMethods: {},
                daily: {}
              };

            statsManager.save(
              defaults
            );

            eventToast?.show(
              'Claim stats reset',
              1200,
              'success'
            );
          }
        )
      );

      panel.appendChild(
        statsSection
      );

      document.body
        .appendChild(panel);

      this.element =
        panel;

      this.startHealthDisplay();
    }

    startHealthDisplay() {
      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            const box =
              this.element
                ?.querySelector(
                  '#tfm-settings-health'
                );

            if (!box) {
              return;
            }

            const health =
              healthMonitor
                .inspect();

            const sniperHealth =
              health.sniper ||
              {};

            box.textContent =
              [
                'healthy: ' +
                  health.healthy,
                'state: ' +
                  (
                    sniperHealth.state ||
                    'unknown'
                  ),
                'observer: ' +
                  Boolean(
                    sniperHealth
                      .observerAttached
                  ),
                'processing: ' +
                  Boolean(
                    sniperHealth
                      .processing
                  ),
                'profile: ' +
                  health.profile,
                'pill: ' +
                  health.pillExists,
                'hud: ' +
                  health.hudExists
              ].join(' • ');
          }, 1500)
        );
    }

    bindKeyboard() {
      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'keydown',
          event => {
            if (
              event.shiftKey &&
              event.key
                .toLowerCase() ===
                'v'
            ) {
              event.preventDefault();
              this.toggle();
            }
          }
        );
    }

    show() {
      if (!this.element) {
        this.create();
      }

      this.visible = true;

      this.element
        .classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-hidden'
        );
    }

    hide() {
      if (!this.element) {
        return;
      }

      this.visible = false;

      this.element
        .classList
        .add(
          'tfm-hidden'
        );
    }

    toggle() {
      if (this.visible) {
        this.hide();
      } else {
        this.show();
      }
    }

    recreate() {
      const wasVisible =
        this.visible;

      this.disposables.clear();

      if (
        this.element &&
        this.element.parentNode
      ) {
        this.element.remove();
      }

      this.element =
        null;

      this.create();
      this.bindKeyboard();

      if (wasVisible) {
        this.show();
      }
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables.clear();

      if (
        this.element &&
        this.element.parentNode
      ) {
        this.element.remove();
      }

      this.element =
        null;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // ORIGINAL MENU PATCH
  // ==========================================================

  function patchOriginalMenu() {
    const menuManager =
      core.menuManager;

    if (
      !menuManager ||
      menuManager
        .__tfmV4Patched
    ) {
      return;
    }

    menuManager
      .__tfmV4Patched =
      true;

    const originalCreate =
      menuManager.create
        ?.bind(
          menuManager
        );

    if (!originalCreate) {
      return;
    }

    menuManager.create =
      function patchedCreate() {
        const result =
          originalCreate();

        setTimeout(() => {
          const menu =
            document.getElementById(
              'bf-menu'
            );

          if (!menu) {
            return;
          }

          if (
            menu.querySelector(
              '#tfm-open-v4-settings'
            )
          ) {
            return;
          }

          const content =
            menu.children[1] ||
            menu;

          const button =
            document.createElement(
              'button'
            );

          button.id =
            'tfm-open-v4-settings';

          button.textContent =
            '⚙️ Open v4 Control Centre';

          button.style.cssText =
            'width:100%;' +
            'padding:10px;' +
            'border:none;' +
            'border-radius:8px;' +
            'background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00bfa5,#7c4dff);' +
            'color:white;' +
            'font-weight:900;' +
            'cursor:pointer;';

          button.addEventListener(
            'click',
            () => {
              settingsPanel
                .show();
            }
          );

          content.appendChild(
            button
          );
        }, 50);

        return result;
      };

    debugLogger.info(
      'Original menu patched with v4 settings button.'
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // INITIALISATION
  // ==========================================================

  const healthMonitor =
    new HealthMonitor();

  const settingsPanel =
    new V4SettingsPanel();

  patchOriginalMenu();

  extension
    .SettingsBackupManager =
    SettingsBackupManager;

  extension.healthMonitor =
    healthMonitor;

  extension.settingsPanel =
    settingsPanel;

  core.SettingsBackupManager =
    SettingsBackupManager;

  core.healthMonitor =
    healthMonitor;

  core.settingsPanel =
    settingsPanel;

  // Create initial snapshot after loading.
  SettingsBackupManager
    .snapshot();

  // ==========================================================
  // EVENT RESPONSES
  // ==========================================================

  eventManager.on(
    'HEALTH_WARNING',
    health => {
      liveHUD?.setStatus(
        '⚠️ Health warning',
        'warning'
      );

      debugLogger.warn(
        'Health warning event.',
        health
      );
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'HEALTH_RECOVERED',
    () => {
      liveHUD?.setStatus(
        '🛠️ System recovered',
        'success'
      );

      eventToast?.show(
        '🛠️ SYSTEM RECOVERED',
        1300,
        'success'
      );
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'SETTINGS_IMPORTED',
    () => {
      liveHUD?.setStatus(
        '⚙️ Settings imported',
        'success'
      );
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'SETTINGS_RECOVERED',
    () => {
      liveHUD?.setStatus(
        '♻️ Settings restored',
        'success'
      );
    }
  );

  // ==========================================================

  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    settingsPanel() {
      settingsPanel.toggle();
    },

    backup() {
      return SettingsBackupManager
        .snapshot();
    },

    exportSettings() {
      return SettingsBackupManager
        .exportText();
    },

    importSettings(
      text
    ) {
      return SettingsBackupManager
        .importText(
          text
        );
    },

    recoverSettings() {
      return SettingsBackupManager
        .recoverLatest();
    },

    systemHealth() {
      return healthMonitor
        .inspect();
    },

    recoverSystem() {
      return healthMonitor
        .recover();
    },

    clearLogs() {
      debugLogger.clear();
    },

    exportLogs() {
      return debugLogger
        .exportText();
    }
  };

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 20 loaded successfully.'
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_PART_20_READY',
    {
      settingsPanel,
      healthMonitor,
      SettingsBackupManager
    }
  );
})();

  // ==========================================================
  // STORAGE VALIDATOR
  // ==========================================================

  class StorageValidator {
    static number(
      value,
      fallback = 0,
      minimum = null,
      maximum = null
    ) {
      let result =
        Number(value);

      if (
        !Number.isFinite(
          result
        )
      ) {
        result = fallback;
      }

      if (
        minimum !== null
      ) {
        result =
          Math.max(
            minimum,
            result
          );
      }

      if (
        maximum !== null
      ) {
        result =
          Math.min(
            maximum,
            result
          );
      }

      return result;
    }

    static boolean(
      value,
      fallback = false
    ) {
      if (
        typeof value ===
        'boolean'
      ) {
        return value;
      }

      if (
        value === 'true' ||
        value === 1 ||
        value === '1'
      ) {
        return true;
      }

      if (
        value === 'false' ||
        value === 0 ||
        value === '0'
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      return fallback;
    }

    static object(
      value,
      fallback = {}
    ) {
      if (
        value &&
        typeof value ===
          'object' &&
        !Array.isArray(value)
      ) {
        return value;
      }

      return {
        ...fallback
      };
    }

    static array(
      value,
      fallback = []
    ) {
      if (
        Array.isArray(value)
      ) {
        return value;
      }

      return [
        ...fallback
      ];
    }

    static string(
      value,
      fallback = ''
    ) {
      if (
        typeof value ===
        'string'
      ) {
        return value;
      }

      if (
        value === null ||
        value === undefined
      ) {
        return fallback;
      }

      return String(value);
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // SETTINGS REPAIR
  // ==========================================================

  class SettingsRepair {
    static run() {
      const report = {
        repaired: [],
        timestamp:
          Date.now()
      };

      const validProfiles = [
        'aggressive',
        'normal',
        'lazy'
      ];

      const profile =
        StorageValidator.string(
          settings.get(
            'profile'
          ),
          'normal'
        );

      if (
        !validProfiles.includes(
          profile
        )
      ) {
        settings.set(
          'profile',
          'normal'
        );

        report.repaired.push(
          'profile'
        );
      }

      const validModes = [
        'smart',
        'exact',
        'fallback'
      ];

      const detectionMode =
        StorageValidator.string(
          settings.get(
            'detectionMode'
          ),
          'smart'
        );

      if (
        !validModes.includes(
          detectionMode
        )
      ) {
        settings.set(
          'detectionMode',
          'smart'
        );

        report.repaired.push(
          'detectionMode'
        );
      }

      const validThankYouModes = [
        'random',
        'short',
        'off'
      ];

      const thankYouMode =
        StorageValidator.string(
          settings.get(
            'thankYouMode'
          ),
          'random'
        );

      if (
        !validThankYouModes.includes(
          thankYouMode
        )
      ) {
        settings.set(
          'thankYouMode',
          'random'
        );

        report.repaired.push(
          'thankYouMode'
        );
      }

      const cooldown =
        StorageValidator.number(
          settings.get(
            'claimCooldownMs'
          ),
          800,
          250,
          5000
        );

      if (
        cooldown !==
        settings.get(
          'claimCooldownMs'
        )
      ) {
        settings.set(
          'claimCooldownMs',
          cooldown
        );

        report.repaired.push(
          'claimCooldownMs'
        );
      }

      const volume =
        StorageValidator.number(
          settings.get(
            'volume'
          ),
          0.7,
          0,
          1
        );

      if (
        volume !==
        settings.get(
          'volume'
        )
      ) {
        settings.set(
          'volume',
          volume
        );

        report.repaired.push(
          'volume'
        );
      }

      const spriteSize =
        StorageValidator.number(
          settings.get(
            'spriteSize'
          ),
          140,
          60,
          320
        );

      if (
        spriteSize !==
        settings.get(
          'spriteSize'
        )
      ) {
        settings.set(
          'spriteSize',
          spriteSize
        );

        report.repaired.push(
          'spriteSize'
        );
      }

      const sniperEnabled =
        StorageValidator.boolean(
          settings.get(
            'sniperEnabled'
          ),
          true
        );

      if (
        sniperEnabled !==
        settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        )
      ) {
        settings.set(
          'sniperEnabled',
          sniperEnabled
        );

        report.repaired.push(
          'sniperEnabled'
        );
      }

      const messages =
        StorageValidator.array(
          settings.get(
            'thankYouMessages'
          ),
          [
            'Ty❤️',
            'thank you!',
            'thanks man',
            'yay ty',
            'legend 🔥'
          ]
        )
          .map(message =>
            StorageValidator
              .string(
                message,
                ''
              )
              .trim()
          )
          .filter(Boolean);

      if (
        messages.length === 0
      ) {
        settings.set(
          'thankYouMessages',
          [
            'Ty❤️',
            'thank you!',
            'thanks man',
            'yay ty',
            'legend 🔥'
          ]
        );

        report.repaired.push(
          'thankYouMessages'
        );
      }

      const uiSettings =
        StorageValidator.object(
          settings.get(
            'uiSettings'
          ),
          {}
        );

      settings.set(
        'uiSettings',
        {
          showStatus:
            StorageValidator
              .boolean(
                uiSettings
                  .showStatus,
                true
              ),

          showStats:
            StorageValidator
              .boolean(
                uiSettings
                  .showStats,
                true
              ),

          showPanel:
            StorageValidator
              .boolean(
                uiSettings
                  .showPanel,
                true
              ),

          compactMode:
            StorageValidator
              .boolean(
                uiSettings
                  .compactMode,
                false
              )
        }
      );

      const visuals =
        StorageValidator.object(
          settings.get(
            'visuals'
          ),
          {}
        );

      settings.set(
        'visuals',
        {
          enabled:
            StorageValidator
              .boolean(
                visuals.enabled,
                true
              ),

          animations:
            StorageValidator
              .boolean(
                visuals.animations,
                true
              ),

          particles:
            StorageValidator
              .boolean(
                visuals.particles,
                true
              ),

          screenFlash:
            StorageValidator
              .boolean(
                visuals.screenFlash,
                true
              ),

          coinScene:
            StorageValidator
              .boolean(
                visuals.coinScene,
                true
              ),

          spriteReactions:
            StorageValidator
              .boolean(
                visuals
                  .spriteReactions,
                true
              )
        }
      );

      const stats =
        statsManager
          .getStats();

      stats.sessionStart =
        StorageValidator.number(
          stats.sessionStart,
          Date.now(),
          0
        );

      stats.detectedDrops =
        StorageValidator.number(
          stats.detectedDrops,
          0,
          0
        );

      stats.successfulClaims =
        StorageValidator.number(
          stats.successfulClaims,
          0,
          0
        );

      stats.failedAttempts =
        StorageValidator.number(
          stats.failedAttempts,
          0,
          0
        );

      stats.retries =
        StorageValidator.number(
          stats.retries,
          0,
          0
        );

      stats.totalReactionTime =
        StorageValidator.number(
          stats.totalReactionTime,
          0,
          0
        );

      stats.averageReaction =
        StorageValidator.number(
          stats.averageReaction,
          0,
          0
        );

      stats.currentStreak =
        StorageValidator.number(
          stats.currentStreak,
          0,
          0
        );

      stats.longestStreak =
        StorageValidator.number(
          stats.longestStreak,
          0,
          0
        );

      stats.detectionMethods =
        StorageValidator.object(
          stats.detectionMethods,
          {}
        );

      stats.daily =
        StorageValidator.object(
          stats.daily,
          {}
        );

      statsManager.save(
        stats
      );

      Storage.set(
        'bf_v4RepairReport',
        report
      );

      return report;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // EVENT HISTORY
  // ==========================================================

  class EventHistory {
    constructor(
      limit = 250
    ) {
      this.limit = limit;
      this.records = [];
      this.unsubscribers = [];

      this.watchEvents = [
        'SNIPER_ARMED',
        'SNIPER_STATE_CHANGED',
        'SNIPER_TOGGLED',
        'DROP_FOUND',
        'CLAIM_SCHEDULED',
        'CLAIM_START',
        'CLAIM_RETRY',
        'CLICK_DISPATCHED',
        'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
        'CLAIM_FAIL',
        'THANK_YOU_SENT',
        'THANK_YOU_SKIPPED',
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        'HEALTH_WARNING',
        'HEALTH_RECOVERED',
        'PROFILE_CHANGED',
        'SETTINGS_IMPORTED',
        'SETTINGS_RECOVERED',
        'STATS_UPDATED'
      ];

      this.bind();
    }

    bind() {
      this.watchEvents
        .forEach(
          eventName => {
            const unsubscribe =
              eventManager.on(
                eventName,
                payload => {
                  this.add(
                    eventName,
                    payload
                  );
                }
              );

            this.unsubscribers
              .push(
                unsubscribe
              );
          }
        );
    }

    add(
      eventName,
      payload = {}
    ) {
      this.records.push({
        timestamp:
          Date.now(),

        isoTime:
          new Date()
            .toISOString(),

        event:
          eventName,

        payload
      });

      if (
        this.records.length >
        this.limit
      ) {
        this.records.splice(
          0,
          this.records.length -
            this.limit
        );
      }
    }

    get(
      limit = 50
    ) {
      return this.records
        .slice(
          -Math.max(
            1,
            limit
          )
        );
    }

    clear() {
      this.records.length =
        0;
    }

    exportText() {
      return JSON.stringify(
        this.records,
        null,
        2
      );
    }

    destroy() {
      this.unsubscribers
        .forEach(
          unsubscribe => {
            try {
              unsubscribe();
            } catch (
              error
            ) {}
          }
        );

      this.unsubscribers =
        [];

      this.records =
        [];
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // DUPLICATE UI CLEANER
  // ==========================================================

  class DuplicateCleaner {
    static removeDuplicates(
      selector,
      keep = 'last'
    ) {
      const elements =
        Array.from(
          document.querySelectorAll(
            selector
          )
        );

      if (
        elements.length <= 1
      ) {
        return 0;
      }

      const keeper =
        keep === 'first'
          ? elements[0]
          : elements[
              elements.length - 1
            ];

      let removed = 0;

      elements.forEach(
        element => {
          if (
            element !== keeper
          ) {
            element.remove();
            removed += 1;
          }
        }
      );

      return removed;
    }

    static run() {
      const report = {
        pill:
          this.removeDuplicates(
            '#bf-pill',
            'last'
          ),

        menu:
          this.removeDuplicates(
            '#bf-menu',
            'last'
          ),

        hud:
          this.removeDuplicates(
            '#tfm-live-hud',
            'last'
          ),

        stats:
          this.removeDuplicates(
            '#tfm-stats-panel',
            'last'
          ),

        settings:
          this.removeDuplicates(
            '#tfm-settings-panel',
            'last'
          ),

        coinScene:
          this.removeDuplicates(
            '#tfm-coin-scene',
            'last'
          ),

        toastContainer:
          this.removeDuplicates(
            '#tfm-event-toast-container',
            'last'
          )
      };

      return report;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // RUNTIME COORDINATOR
  // ==========================================================

  class RuntimeCoordinator {
    constructor() {
      this.started = false;
      this.destroyed = false;
      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.lastRepairAt =
        0;

      this.lastCleanupAt =
        0;

      this.start();
    }

    start() {
      if (
        this.started &&
        !this.destroyed
      ) {
        return;
      }

      this.started = true;
      this.destroyed = false;

      const repairReport =
        SettingsRepair.run();

      debugLogger.info(
        'Settings validation completed.',
        repairReport
      );

      const duplicateReport =
        DuplicateCleaner.run();

      debugLogger.info(
        'Duplicate UI cleanup completed.',
        duplicateReport
      );

      this.lastRepairAt =
        Date.now();

      this.lastCleanupAt =
        Date.now();

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            this.maintenance();
          }, 10000)
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'focus',
          () => {
            sniper
              ?.scan?.();
          }
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'visibilitychange',
          () => {
            eventManager.emit(
              'PAGE_VISIBILITY_CHANGED',
              {
                hidden:
                  document.hidden,
                visibilityState:
                  document
                    .visibilityState
              }
            );

            if (
              !document.hidden
            ) {
              sniper
                ?.scan?.();
            }
          }
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'online',
          () => {
            liveHUD?.setStatus(
              '🌐 Connection restored',
              'success'
            );

            sniper
              ?.recover?.();
          }
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'offline',
          () => {
            liveHUD?.setStatus(
              '📴 Connection offline',
              'warning'
            );
          }
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'beforeunload',
          () => {
            try {
              SettingsBackupManager
                ?.snapshot?.();

              Storage.set(
                'bf_v4LastUnloadAt',
                Date.now()
              );
            } catch (
              error
            ) {}
          }
        );

      eventManager.emit(
        'RUNTIME_STARTED',
        {
          version:
            extension.version
        }
      );

      liveHUD?.setStatus(
        settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        )
          ? '🟢 Sniper armed'
          : '🔴 Sniper disabled',
        settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        )
          ? 'success'
          : 'error'
      );

      eventToast?.show(
        `TheFreshMaker v${extension.version} ready`,
        1600,
        'success'
      );
    }

    maintenance() {
      if (
        this.destroyed
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const now =
        Date.now();

      if (
        now -
          this.lastCleanupAt >
        30000
      ) {
        const report =
          DuplicateCleaner.run();

        const removed =
          Object.values(
            report
          ).reduce(
            (
              total,
              value
            ) =>
              total +
              Number(value || 0),
            0
          );

        if (removed > 0) {
          debugLogger.warn(
            'Duplicate runtime elements removed.',
            report
          );
        }

        this.lastCleanupAt =
          now;
      }

      if (
        now -
          this.lastRepairAt >
        60000
      ) {
        SettingsRepair.run();

        this.lastRepairAt =
          now;
      }

      if (
        settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        ) &&
        sniper?.state ===
          'DISABLED'
      ) {
        sniper.setEnabled(
          true
        );
      }

      if (
        !settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        ) &&
        sniper?.state !==
          'DISABLED'
      ) {
        sniper.setEnabled(
          false
        );
      }

      if (
        !document
          .getElementById(
            'tfm-live-hud'
          )
      ) {
        liveHUD
          ?.create?.();
      }

      if (
        !document
          .getElementById(
            'tfm-stats-panel'
          )
      ) {
        statsDashboard
          ?.create?.();
      }

      if (
        !document
          .getElementById(
            'bf-pill'
          )
      ) {
        core.pillButton
          ?.recreate?.();
      }
    }

    restart() {
      debugLogger.warn(
        'Runtime restart requested.'
      );

      sniper?.recover?.();

      healthMonitor
        ?.recover?.();

      SettingsRepair.run();

      DuplicateCleaner.run();

      liveHUD?.setStatus(
        '♻️ Runtime restarted',
        'success'
      );

      eventToast?.show(
        '♻️ RUNTIME RESTARTED',
        1300,
        'success'
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'RUNTIME_RESTARTED'
      );
    }

    destroy() {
      if (
        this.destroyed
      ) {
        return;
      }

      this.destroyed =
        true;

      this.disposables
        .clear();

      eventManager.emit(
        'RUNTIME_STOPPED'
      );

      debugLogger.warn(
        'Runtime coordinator stopped.'
      );
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // GLOBAL ERROR BRIDGE
  // ==========================================================

  class GlobalErrorBridge {
    constructor() {
      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.bind();
    }

    bind() {
      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'error',
          event => {
            const message =
              event.message ||
              'Unknown window error';

            debugLogger.error(
              message,
              {
                filename:
                  event.filename,
                line:
                  event.lineno,
                column:
                  event.colno
              }
            );

            eventManager.emit(
              'GLOBAL_ERROR',
              {
                message,
                filename:
                  event.filename,
                line:
                  event.lineno,
                column:
                  event.colno
              }
            );
          }
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'unhandledrejection',
          event => {
            const reason =
              event.reason;

            debugLogger.error(
              'Unhandled promise rejection.',
              reason
            );

            eventManager.emit(
              'UNHANDLED_REJECTION',
              {
                reason:
                  String(
                    reason?.message ||
                    reason ||
                    'unknown'
                  )
              }
            );
          }
        );
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables
        .clear();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // EVENT BRIDGES
  // ==========================================================

  function installEventBridges() {
    eventManager.on(
      'GLOBAL_ERROR',
      event => {
        liveHUD?.setStatus(
          '⚠️ Runtime error',
          'warning'
        );

        if (
          settings.get(
            'debugMode'
          )
        ) {
          eventToast?.show(
            `Runtime error: ${event.message}`,
            1800,
            'error'
          );
        }
      }
    );

    eventManager.on(
      'UNHANDLED_REJECTION',
      event => {
        if (
          settings.get(
            'debugMode'
          )
        ) {
          eventToast?.show(
            `Promise error: ${event.reason}`,
            1800,
            'error'
          );
        }
      }
    );

    eventManager.on(
      'PAGE_VISIBILITY_CHANGED',
      event => {
        debugLogger.info(
          'Page visibility changed.',
          event
        );
      }
    );

    eventManager.on(
      'RUNTIME_RESTARTED',
      () => {
        statsDashboard
          ?.render?.();

        liveHUD
          ?.refreshMeta?.();
      }
    );

    eventManager.on(
      'SNIPER_STATE_CHANGED',
      event => {
        Storage.set(
          'bf_v4LastSniperState',
          {
            state:
              event.state,
            previousState:
              event.previousState,
            timestamp:
              Date.now()
          }
        );
      }
    );

    eventManager.on(
      'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
      event => {
        Storage.set(
          'bf_v4LastSuccessfulClaim',
          {
            timestamp:
              Date.now(),
            reaction:
              event.reaction,
            signal:
              event.signal,
            retryUsed:
              event.retryUsed
          }
        );
      }
    );

    eventManager.on(
      'CLAIM_FAIL',
      event => {
        Storage.set(
          'bf_v4LastFailedClaim',
          {
            timestamp:
              Date.now(),
            reason:
              event.reason,
            retryUsed:
              event.retryUsed
          }
        );
      }
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // START FINAL RUNTIME SERVICES
  // ==========================================================

  const eventHistory =
    new EventHistory();

  const globalErrorBridge =
    new GlobalErrorBridge();

  installEventBridges();

  const runtimeCoordinator =
    new RuntimeCoordinator();

  extension.eventHistory =
    eventHistory;

  extension.globalErrorBridge =
    globalErrorBridge;

  extension.runtimeCoordinator =
    runtimeCoordinator;

  extension.StorageValidator =
    StorageValidator;

  extension.SettingsRepair =
    SettingsRepair;

  extension.DuplicateCleaner =
    DuplicateCleaner;

  core.eventHistory =
    eventHistory;

  core.runtimeCoordinator =
    runtimeCoordinator;

  // ==========================================================
  // FINAL PUBLIC API
  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    version:
      extension.version,

    restart() {
      return runtimeCoordinator
        .restart();
    },

    stopRuntime() {
      return runtimeCoordinator
        .destroy();
    },

    repairSettings() {
      return SettingsRepair
        .run();
    },

    cleanDuplicates() {
      return DuplicateCleaner
        .run();
    },

    eventHistory(
      limit = 50
    ) {
      return eventHistory
        .get(limit);
    },

    exportEventHistory() {
      return eventHistory
        .exportText();
    },

    clearEventHistory() {
      return eventHistory
        .clear();
    },

    snapshot() {
      return {
        version:
          extension.version,

        timestamp:
          Date.now(),

        health:
          healthMonitor
            ?.inspect?.(),

        sniper:
          sniper
            ?.health?.(),

        stats:
          statsManager
            ?.getStats?.(),

        settings:
          {
            ...(settings.data ||
              {})
          },

        recentEvents:
          eventHistory
            .get(25),

        recentLogs:
          debugLogger
            .get(25)
      };
    },

    openControlCentre() {
      return settingsPanel
        ?.show?.();
    },

    closeControlCentre() {
      return settingsPanel
        ?.hide?.();
    },

    toggleControlCentre() {
      return settingsPanel
        ?.toggle?.();
    },

    refreshUI() {
      liveHUD
        ?.refreshMeta?.();

      statsDashboard
        ?.render?.();

      core.spriteManager
        ?.refresh?.();

      DuplicateCleaner
        .run();

      return true;
    },

    fullRecovery() {
      const repair =
        SettingsRepair.run();

      const duplicates =
        DuplicateCleaner.run();

      const health =
        healthMonitor
          ?.recover?.();

      sniper
        ?.recover?.();

      this.refreshUI();

      return {
        repair,
        duplicates,
        health
      };
    },

    destroyV4() {
      runtimeCoordinator
        ?.destroy?.();

      globalErrorBridge
        ?.destroy?.();

      eventHistory
        ?.destroy?.();

      sniper
        ?.destroy?.();

      healthMonitor
        ?.destroy?.();

      settingsPanel
        ?.destroy?.();

      liveHUD
        ?.destroy?.();

      statsDashboard
        ?.destroy?.();

      eventToast
        ?.clear?.();

      coinSceneManager
        ?.hide?.(0);

      eventManager.emit(
        'V4_DESTROYED'
      );

      return true;
    }
  };

  // ==========================================================
  // FINAL EXPORT
  // ==========================================================

  window.BFHelper = {
    ...window.BFHelper,

    VERSION:
      extension.version,

    TheFreshMakerV4:
      extension,

    eventManager,

    debugLogger,

    statsManager,

    sniper,

    settingsPanel,

    healthMonitor,

    eventHistory,

    runtimeCoordinator
  };

  Storage.set(
    'bf_v4LoadedAt',
    Date.now()
  );

  Storage.set(
    'bf_v4Version',
    extension.version
  );

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 21 loaded successfully.'
  );

  debugLogger.info(
    `TheFreshMaker v${extension.version} is fully operational.`
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_READY',
    {
      version:
        extension.version,

      loadedAt:
        Date.now(),

      health:
        healthMonitor
          ?.inspect?.()
    }
  );
})();

  // ==========================================================
  // UTILITIES
  // ==========================================================

  function wait(
    milliseconds
  ) {
    return new Promise(
      resolve => {
        setTimeout(
          resolve,
          Math.max(
            0,
            milliseconds
          )
        );
      }
    );
  }

  function scaledTime(
    milliseconds
  ) {
    const multiplier =
      Number(
        dbzSettings
          .durationMultiplier
      ) || 1;

    return Math.max(
      50,
      Math.round(
        milliseconds *
        multiplier
      )
    );
  }

  function randomItem(
    items
  ) {
    return items[
      Math.floor(
        Math.random() *
        items.length
      )
    ];
  }

  function restartAnimation(
    element,
    className
  ) {
    if (!element) {
      return;
    }

    element.classList
      .remove(className);

    void element.offsetWidth;

    element.classList
      .add(className);
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // DBZ SCENE MANAGER
  // ==========================================================

  class DBZSceneManager {
    constructor() {
      this.stage = null;
      this.goku = null;
      this.frieza = null;
      this.broly = null;
      this.coin = null;
      this.energyBall = null;
      this.impact = null;
      this.dialogue = null;
      this.aura = null;
      this.speedLines = null;

      this.running = false;
      this.sequenceId = 0;
      this.lastOutcome = null;

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.create();
      this.bindEvents();
    }

    createCharacter(
      id,
      source
    ) {
      const image =
        document.createElement(
          'img'
        );

      image.id = id;

      image.className =
        'tfm-dbz-character';

      image.src =
        source || '';

      image.alt = '';

      image.draggable =
        false;

      image.onerror =
        () => {
          image.style.display =
            'none';

          debugLogger.warn(
            `DBZ image failed: ${id}`,
            {
              source
            }
          );
        };

      return image;
    }

    create() {
      const existing =
        document.getElementById(
          'tfm-dbz-stage'
        );

      if (existing) {
        existing.remove();
      }

      dbzSettings =
        mergeDbzSettings();

      const stage =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      stage.id =
        'tfm-dbz-stage';

      const speedLines =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      speedLines.id =
        'tfm-dbz-speed-lines';

      const aura =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      aura.id =
        'tfm-dbz-aura';

      const coin =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      coin.id =
        'tfm-dbz-coin';

      if (
        dbzSettings.coinImage
      ) {
        coin.innerHTML =
          `<img
            src="${dbzSettings.coinImage}"
            alt=""
            style="
              width:100%;
              height:100%;
              object-fit:contain;
              border-radius:50%;
            "
          >`;
      } else {
        coin.textContent =
          '🪙';
      }

      const goku =
        this.createCharacter(
          'tfm-dbz-goku',
          dbzSettings.gokuImage
        );

      const frieza =
        this.createCharacter(
          'tfm-dbz-frieza',
          dbzSettings.friezaImage
        );

      const broly =
        this.createCharacter(
          'tfm-dbz-broly',
          dbzSettings.brolyImage
        );

      const energyBall =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      energyBall.id =
        'tfm-dbz-energy-ball';

      const impact =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      impact.id =
        'tfm-dbz-impact';

      const dialogue =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      dialogue.id =
        'tfm-dbz-dialogue';

      stage.appendChild(
        speedLines
      );

      stage.appendChild(
        aura
      );

      stage.appendChild(
        coin
      );

      stage.appendChild(
        goku
      );

      stage.appendChild(
        frieza
      );

      stage.appendChild(
        broly
      );

      stage.appendChild(
        energyBall
      );

      stage.appendChild(
        impact
      );

      stage.appendChild(
        dialogue
      );

      document.body
        .appendChild(stage);

      this.stage =
        stage;

      this.goku =
        goku;

      this.frieza =
        frieza;

      this.broly =
        broly;

      this.coin =
        coin;

      this.energyBall =
        energyBall;

      this.impact =
        impact;

      this.dialogue =
        dialogue;

      this.aura =
        aura;

      this.speedLines =
        speedLines;

      this.reset();
    }

    isEnabled() {
      dbzSettings =
        mergeDbzSettings();

      const visuals =
        settings.get(
          'visuals'
        ) || {};

      return (
        dbzSettings.enabled !==
          false &&
        visuals.enabled !==
          false &&
        visuals.animations !==
          false &&
        settings.get(
          'theme'
        ) === 'dbz'
      );
    }

    clearClasses() {
      [
        this.goku,
        this.frieza,
        this.broly,
        this.coin,
        this.energyBall,
        this.impact,
        this.aura
      ].forEach(
        element => {
          if (!element) {
            return;
          }

          element.className =
            element.className
              .split(' ')
              .filter(
                className =>
                  !className
                    .startsWith(
                      'tfm-dbz-'
                    ) ||
                  className ===
                    'tfm-dbz-character'
              )
              .join(' ');

          if (
            element ===
              this.goku ||
            element ===
              this.frieza ||
            element ===
              this.broly
          ) {
            element.classList
              .add(
                'tfm-dbz-character'
              );
          }
        }
      );
    }

    reset() {
      this.running =
        false;

      this.clearClasses();

      this.stage
        ?.classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-dbz-active',
          'tfm-dbz-powered',
          'tfm-dbz-speeding'
        );

      if (this.goku) {
        this.goku.style.cssText =
          '';
      }

      if (this.frieza) {
        this.frieza.style.cssText =
          '';
      }

      if (this.broly) {
        this.broly.style.cssText =
          '';
      }

      if (this.coin) {
        this.coin.style.cssText =
          '';
      }

      if (this.energyBall) {
        this.energyBall.style.cssText =
          '';
      }

      if (this.impact) {
        this.impact.style.cssText =
          '';
      }

      if (this.aura) {
        this.aura.style.cssText =
          '';
      }

      this.hideDialogue();
    }

    cancel() {
      this.sequenceId += 1;
      this.reset();
    }

    async showDialogue(
      text,
      duration = 800
    ) {
      if (
        !dbzSettings
          .showDialogue ||
        !this.dialogue
      ) {
        await wait(
          scaledTime(
            Math.min(
              duration,
              250
            )
          )
        );

        return;
      }

      this.dialogue.textContent =
        text;

      this.dialogue
        .classList
        .add(
          'tfm-dbz-dialogue-visible'
        );

      await wait(
        scaledTime(duration)
      );

      this.hideDialogue();
    }

    hideDialogue() {
      this.dialogue
        ?.classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-dbz-dialogue-visible'
        );
    }

    showStage() {
      this.stage
        ?.classList
        .add(
          'tfm-dbz-active'
        );
    }

    hideStage(
      delay = 0
    ) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.stage
          ?.classList
          .remove(
            'tfm-dbz-active',
            'tfm-dbz-powered',
            'tfm-dbz-speeding'
          );
      }, scaledTime(delay));
    }

    showCoin() {
      restartAnimation(
        this.coin,
        'tfm-dbz-coin-appear'
      );
    }

    claimCoin() {
      restartAnimation(
        this.coin,
        'tfm-dbz-coin-claimed'
      );
    }

    async playDropFound() {
      if (
        !this.isEnabled()
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      this.cancel();

      this.running =
        true;

      const id =
        ++this.sequenceId;

      this.showStage();

      this.stage.classList
        .add(
          'tfm-dbz-speeding'
        );

      this.showCoin();

      restartAnimation(
        this.goku,
        'tfm-dbz-goku-enter'
      );

      this.showDialogue(
        randomItem([
          'Goku: I’ve got this one!',
          'Goku: A coindrop!',
          'Goku: Time to move!',
          'Goku: Nobody beats me to it!'
        ]),
        700
      );

      await wait(
        scaledTime(760)
      );

      if (
        id !==
        this.sequenceId
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      this.stage.classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-dbz-speeding'
        );

      return true;
    }

    async playClaimStart() {
      if (
        !this.isEnabled()
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      const id =
        this.sequenceId;

      this.showStage();

      this.stage.classList
        .add(
          'tfm-dbz-powered'
        );

      restartAnimation(
        this.goku,
        'tfm-dbz-goku-grab'
      );

      restartAnimation(
        this.aura,
        'tfm-dbz-aura-active'
      );

      await wait(
        scaledTime(560)
      );

      if (
        id !==
        this.sequenceId
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    }

    shouldInterrupt() {
      return (
        Math.random() <
        Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(
            1,
            Number(
              dbzSettings
                .interruptionChance
            ) || 0
          )
        )
      );
    }

    async playFriezaInterruption() {
      if (
        !this.isEnabled() ||
        !dbzSettings
          .showEnergyEffects
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      const id =
        this.sequenceId;

      restartAnimation(
        this.frieza,
        'tfm-dbz-frieza-enter'
      );

      await this.showDialogue(
        randomItem([
          'Frieza: That drop belongs to me.',
          'Frieza: Too slow, monkey.',
          'Frieza: I’ll be taking that.',
          'Frieza: How delightfully predictable.'
        ]),
        700
      );

      if (
        id !==
        this.sequenceId
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      restartAnimation(
        this.energyBall,
        'tfm-dbz-energy-fire'
      );

      await wait(
        scaledTime(410)
      );

      if (
        dbzSettings
          .showImpactEffects
      ) {
        restartAnimation(
          this.impact,
          'tfm-dbz-impact-active'
        );
      }

      restartAnimation(
        this.goku,
        'tfm-dbz-goku-hit'
      );

      await wait(
        scaledTime(560)
      );

      if (
        id !==
        this.sequenceId
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      this.claimCoin();

      restartAnimation(
        this.frieza,
        'tfm-dbz-frieza-win'
      );

      await this.showDialogue(
        randomItem([
          'Frieza claimed the drop!',
          'Frieza wins this round.',
          'Frieza stole the coindrop!',
          'Frieza: Mine.'
        ]),
        850
      );

      this.lastOutcome =
        'frieza';

      this.hideStage(
        500
      );

      this.running =
        false;

      return true;
    }

    async playGokuVictory() {
      if (
        !this.isEnabled()
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      const id =
        this.sequenceId;

      this.claimCoin();

      restartAnimation(
        this.goku,
        'tfm-dbz-goku-win'
      );

      restartAnimation(
        this.aura,
        'tfm-dbz-aura-active'
      );

      await this.showDialogue(
        randomItem([
          'Goku claimed the coindrop!',
          'Goku: Got it!',
          'Goku wins the drop!',
          'Goku: That was close!'
        ]),
        900
      );

      if (
        id !==
        this.sequenceId
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      this.lastOutcome =
        'goku';

      this.hideStage(
        500
      );

      this.running =
        false;

      return true;
    }

    async playBrolyFailure() {
      if (
        !this.isEnabled()
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      const id =
        this.sequenceId;

      restartAnimation(
        this.broly,
        'tfm-dbz-broly-enter'
      );

      restartAnimation(
        this.impact,
        'tfm-dbz-impact-active'
      );

      await this.showDialogue(
        randomItem([
          'Broly: KAKAROT!',
          'Broly smashed the claim!',
          'Broly scared the coindrop away!',
          'Broly: RAAAAAAAGH!'
        ]),
        900
      );

      if (
        id !==
        this.sequenceId
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      this.lastOutcome =
        'broly';

      this.hideStage(
        450
      );

      this.running =
        false;

      return true;
    }

    async handleSuccess(
      event
    ) {
      if (
        !this.isEnabled()
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        this.shouldInterrupt()
      ) {
        await this
          .playFriezaInterruption();

        return;
      }

      await this
        .playGokuVictory();

      debugLogger.info(
        'DBZ success scene completed.',
        {
          outcome:
            this.lastOutcome,
          reaction:
            event?.reaction
        }
      );
    }

    async handleFailure(
      event
    ) {
      if (
        !this.isEnabled()
      ) {
        return;
      }

      await this
        .playBrolyFailure();

      debugLogger.info(
        'DBZ failure scene completed.',
        {
          reason:
            event?.reason
        }
      );
    }

    bindEvents() {
      eventManager.on(
        'DROP_FOUND',
        () => {
          this.playDropFound()
            .catch(
              error => {
                debugLogger.warn(
                  'DBZ drop-found scene failed.',
                  error
                );
              }
            );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_START',
        () => {
          this.playClaimStart()
            .catch(
              error => {
                debugLogger.warn(
                  'DBZ claim-start scene failed.',
                  error
                );
              }
            );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
        event => {
          this.handleSuccess(
            event
          ).catch(
            error => {
              debugLogger.warn(
                'DBZ success scene failed.',
                error
              );
            }
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_FAIL',
        event => {
          this.handleFailure(
            event
          ).catch(
            error => {
              debugLogger.warn(
                'DBZ failure scene failed.',
                error
              );
            }
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        () => {
          this.cancel();
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'SNIPER_TOGGLED',
        event => {
          if (
            !event.enabled
          ) {
            this.cancel();
          }
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'PROFILE_CHANGED',
        () => {
          dbzSettings =
            mergeDbzSettings();
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'V4_DESTROYED',
        () => {
          this.destroy();
        }
      );
    }

    updateSettings(
      updates
    ) {
      dbzSettings = {
        ...mergeDbzSettings(),
        ...(updates || {})
      };

      settings.set(
        'dbzScene',
        dbzSettings
      );

      if (
        updates?.gokuImage ||
        updates?.friezaImage ||
        updates?.brolyImage ||
        updates?.coinImage
      ) {
        this.create();
      }

      return {
        ...dbzSettings
      };
    }

    test(
      mode = 'goku'
    ) {
      this.playDropFound();

      setTimeout(() => {
        this.playClaimStart();
      }, scaledTime(800));

      setTimeout(() => {
        if (
          mode === 'frieza'
        ) {
          this.playFriezaInterruption();
        } else if (
          mode === 'broly'
        ) {
          this.playBrolyFailure();
        } else {
          this.playGokuVictory();
        }
      }, scaledTime(1500));
    }

    destroy() {
      this.cancel();
      this.disposables.clear();

      if (
        this.stage &&
        this.stage.parentNode
      ) {
        this.stage.remove();
      }

      this.stage =
        null;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // INITIALISE DBZ SCENE
  // ==========================================================

  const dbzSceneManager =
    new DBZSceneManager();

  extension.dbzSceneManager =
    dbzSceneManager;

  core.dbzSceneManager =
    dbzSceneManager;

  // ==========================================================
  // PUBLIC COMMANDS
  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    dbz: {
      enable() {
        return dbzSceneManager
          .updateSettings({
            enabled: true
          });
      },

      disable() {
        dbzSceneManager
          .cancel();

        return dbzSceneManager
          .updateSettings({
            enabled: false
          });
      },

      settings() {
        return {
          ...mergeDbzSettings()
        };
      },

      update(
        updates
      ) {
        return dbzSceneManager
          .updateSettings(
            updates
          );
      },

      testGoku() {
        return dbzSceneManager
          .test('goku');
      },

      testFrieza() {
        return dbzSceneManager
          .test('frieza');
      },

      testBroly() {
        return dbzSceneManager
          .test('broly');
      },

      cancel() {
        return dbzSceneManager
          .cancel();
      }
    }
  };

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 22 loaded successfully.',
    {
      enabled:
        dbzSettings.enabled,
      theme:
        settings.get(
          'theme'
        ),
      interruptionChance:
        dbzSettings
          .interruptionChance
    }
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_PART_22_READY',
    {
      dbzSceneManager,
      settings: {
        ...dbzSettings
      }
    }
  );
})();
// ============================================================

  if (

    window.TFM_V4_PART_23_LOADED

      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 23 already loaded.'

  } = core;

  // ==========================================================
