      }

    `;

    document.documentElement

      .appendChild(style);

  }

  injectDbzControlStyles();

  // ==========================================================

  // PANEL

  // ==========================================================

  class DBZControlPanel {

    constructor() {

      this.element = null;

      this.visible = false;

      this.disposables =

        new Disposables();

      this.create();

      this.bindKeyboard();

    }

    getSettings() {

      return {

        ...(

          settings.get(

            'dbzScene'

          ) || {}

        )

      };

    }

    updateSetting(

      key,

      value

    ) {

      const current =

        this.getSettings();

      const updated = {

        ...current,

        [key]: value

      };

      dbzSceneManager

        .updateSettings(

          updated

        );

      eventManager.emit(

        'DBZ_SETTINGS_CHANGED',

        {

          key,

          value,

          settings:

            updated

        }

      );

      return updated;

    }

    createSection(

      title

    ) {

      const section =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      section.className =

        'tfm-dbz-control-section';

      const heading =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      heading.className =

        'tfm-dbz-control-heading';

      heading.textContent =

        title;

      section.appendChild(

        heading

      );

      return section;

    }

    createCheckbox(

      labelText,

      checked,

      onChange

    ) {

      const row =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      row.className =

        'tfm-dbz-control-row';

      const label =

        document.createElement(

          'label'

        );

      label.textContent =

        labelText;

      const input =

        document.createElement(

          'input'

        );

      input.type =

        'checkbox';

      input.checked =

        Boolean(checked);

      input.addEventListener(

        'change',

        () => {

          onChange(

            input.checked

          );

        }

      );

      row.appendChild(label);

      row.appendChild(input);

      return row;

    }

    createRange(

      labelText,

      value,

      minimum,

      maximum,

      step,

      formatter,

      onChange

    ) {

      const row =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      row.className =

        'tfm-dbz-control-row';

      const label =

        document.createElement(

          'label'

        );

      label.textContent =

        labelText;

      const controlWrap =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      controlWrap.style.cssText =

        'display:flex;' +

        'align-items:center;' +

        'gap:6px;';

      const input =

        document.createElement(

          'input'

        );

      input.type =

        'range';

      input.min =

        String(minimum);

      input.max =

        String(maximum);

      input.step =

        String(step);

      input.value =

        String(value);

      const display =

        document.createElement(

          'span'

        );

      display.className =

        'tfm-dbz-control-value';

      const updateDisplay =

        rawValue => {

          display.textContent =

            formatter(

              Number(rawValue)

            );

        };

      updateDisplay(

        input.value

      );

      input.addEventListener(

        'input',

        () => {

          const number =

            Number(

              input.value

            );

          updateDisplay(number);

          onChange(number);

        }

      );

      controlWrap.appendChild(

        input

      );

      controlWrap.appendChild(

        display

      );

      row.appendChild(label);

      row.appendChild(

        controlWrap

      );

      return row;

    }

    createUrlInput(

      labelText,

      value,

      onChange

    ) {

      const wrapper =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      wrapper.style.cssText =

        'margin:8px 0;';

      const row =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      row.className =

        'tfm-dbz-control-row';

      const label =

        document.createElement(

          'label'

        );

      label.textContent =

        labelText;

      const input =

        document.createElement(

          'input'

        );

      input.type =

        'url';

      input.value =

        value || '';

      input.placeholder =

        'https://...';

      const preview =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      preview.className =

        'tfm-dbz-preview';

      const image =

        document.createElement(

          'img'

        );

      image.alt = '';

      const previewText =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      previewText.className =

        'tfm-dbz-preview-text';

      const updatePreview =

        url => {

          image.src =

            url || '';

          previewText.textContent =

            url ||

            'No image URL set';

          preview.style.display =

            url

              ? 'flex'

              : 'none';

        };

      updatePreview(

        input.value

      );

      input.addEventListener(

        'change',

        () => {

          const url =

            input.value.trim();

          updatePreview(url);

          onChange(url);

        }

      );

      image.onerror =

        () => {

          previewText.textContent =

            'Image failed to load';

        };

      row.appendChild(label);

      row.appendChild(input);

      preview.appendChild(image);

      preview.appendChild(

        previewText

      );

      wrapper.appendChild(row);

      wrapper.appendChild(preview);

      return wrapper;

    }

    createButton(

      text,

      className,

      handler

    ) {

      const button =

        document.createElement(

          'button'

        );

      button.className =

        'tfm-dbz-control-button ' +

        (

          className || ''

        );

      button.textContent =

        text;

      button.addEventListener(

        'click',

        handler

      );

      return button;

    }

    create() {

      const existing =

        document.getElementById(

          'tfm-dbz-control-panel'

        );

      if (existing) {

        existing.remove();

      }

      const sceneSettings =

        this.getSettings();

      const panel =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      panel.id =

        'tfm-dbz-control-panel';

      panel.classList.add(

        'tfm-hidden'

      );

      const header =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      header.id =

        'tfm-dbz-control-header';

      const title =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      title.id =

        'tfm-dbz-control-title';

      title.textContent =

        '🐉 DBZ Scene Control';

      const close =

        document.createElement(

          'button'

        );

      close.id =

        'tfm-dbz-control-close';

      close.textContent =

        '✕';

      close.addEventListener(

        'click',

        () => {

          this.hide();

        }

      );

      header.appendChild(title);

      header.appendChild(close);

      panel.appendChild(header);

      // GENERAL

      const generalSection =

        this.createSection(

          'General'

        );

      generalSection.appendChild(

        this.createCheckbox(

          'Enable DBZ scenes',

          sceneSettings.enabled !==

            false,

          enabled => {

            this.updateSetting(

              'enabled',

              enabled

            );

            if (!enabled) {

              dbzSceneManager.cancel();

            }

          }

        )

      );

      generalSection.appendChild(

        this.createCheckbox(

          'Show dialogue',

          sceneSettings

            .showDialogue !==

            false,

          enabled => {

            this.updateSetting(

              'showDialogue',

              enabled

            );

          }

        )

      );

      generalSection.appendChild(

        this.createCheckbox(

          'Energy effects',

          sceneSettings

            .showEnergyEffects !==

            false,

          enabled => {

            this.updateSetting(

              'showEnergyEffects',

              enabled

            );

          }

        )

      );

      generalSection.appendChild(

        this.createCheckbox(

          'Impact effects',

          sceneSettings

            .showImpactEffects !==

            false,

          enabled => {

            this.updateSetting(

              'showImpactEffects',

              enabled

            );

          }

        )

      );

      generalSection.appendChild(

        this.createRange(

          'Frieza chance',

          Number(

            sceneSettings

              .interruptionChance

          ) || 0,

          0,

          1,

          0.05,

          value =>

            Math.round(

              value * 100

            ) + '%',

          value => {

            this.updateSetting(

              'interruptionChance',

              value

            );

          }

        )

      );

      generalSection.appendChild(

        this.createRange(

          'Scene speed',

          Number(

            sceneSettings

              .durationMultiplier

          ) || 1,

          0.5,

          2,

          0.1,

          value =>

            value.toFixed(1) +

            '×',

          value => {

            this.updateSetting(

              'durationMultiplier',

              value

            );

          }

        )

      );

      panel.appendChild(

        generalSection

      );

      // IMAGES

      const imageSection =

        this.createSection(

          'Character images'

        );

      imageSection.appendChild(

        this.createUrlInput(

          'Goku',

          sceneSettings.gokuImage,

          url => {

            this.updateSetting(

              'gokuImage',

              url

            );

          }

        )

      );

      imageSection.appendChild(

        this.createUrlInput(

          'Frieza',

          sceneSettings.friezaImage,

          url => {

            this.updateSetting(

              'friezaImage',

              url

            );

          }

        )

      );

      imageSection.appendChild(

        this.createUrlInput(

          'Broly',

          sceneSettings.brolyImage,

          url => {

            this.updateSetting(

              'brolyImage',

              url

            );

          }

        )

      );

      imageSection.appendChild(

        this.createUrlInput(

          'Coin image',

          sceneSettings.coinImage,

          url => {

            this.updateSetting(

              'coinImage',

              url

            );

          }

        )

      );

      imageSection.appendChild(

        this.createButton(

          'Reload scene images',

          '',

          () => {

            dbzSceneManager.create();

            eventToast?.show(

              'DBZ images reloaded',

              1100,

              'success'

            );

          }

        )

      );

      panel.appendChild(

        imageSection

      );

      // TESTING

      const testingSection =

        this.createSection(

          'Scene testing'

        );

      const testGrid =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      testGrid.className =

        'tfm-dbz-control-grid';

      testGrid.appendChild(

        this.createButton(

          'Goku wins',

          'tfm-blue',

          () => {

            dbzSceneManager

              .test('goku');

          }

        )

      );

      testGrid.appendChild(

        this.createButton(

          'Frieza steals',

          '',

          () => {

            dbzSceneManager

              .test('frieza');

          }

        )

      );

      testGrid.appendChild(

        this.createButton(

          'Broly fails',

          'tfm-green',

          () => {

            dbzSceneManager

              .test('broly');

          }

        )

      );

      testGrid.appendChild(

        this.createButton(

          'Cancel scene',

          'tfm-red',

          () => {

            dbzSceneManager

              .cancel();

          }

        )

      );

      testingSection.appendChild(

        testGrid

      );

      testingSection.appendChild(

        this.createButton(

          'Run random outcome',

          'tfm-gold',

          () => {

            const modes = [

              'goku',

              'frieza',

              'broly'

            ];

            dbzSceneManager.test(

              modes[

                Math.floor(

                  Math.random() *

                  modes.length

                )

              ]

            );

          }

        )

      );

      panel.appendChild(

        testingSection

      );

      // RUNTIME

      const runtimeSection =

        this.createSection(

          'Runtime'

        );

      const status =

        document.createElement(

          'div'

        );

      status.id =

        'tfm-dbz-runtime-status';

      runtimeSection.appendChild(

        status

      );

      runtimeSection.appendChild(

        this.createButton(

          'Switch theme to DBZ',

          'tfm-blue',

          () => {

            settings.set(

              'theme',

              'dbz'

            );

            core.spriteManager

              ?.refresh?.();

            eventToast?.show(

              'DBZ theme enabled',

              1100,

              'success'

            );

            this.refreshStatus();

          }

        )

      );

      runtimeSection.appendChild(

        this.createButton(

          'Reset DBZ settings',

          'tfm-red',

          () => {

            if (

              !confirm(

                'Reset DBZ scene settings?'

              )

            ) {

              return;

            }

            settings.set(

              'dbzScene',

              {}

            );

            dbzSceneManager.create();

            this.recreate();

            eventToast?.show(

              'DBZ settings reset',

              1200,

              'success'

            );

          }

        )

      );

      panel.appendChild(

        runtimeSection

      );

      document.body

        .appendChild(panel);

      this.element =

        panel;

      this.refreshStatus();

      this.disposables

        .addInterval(

          setInterval(() => {

            this.refreshStatus();

          }, 1000)

        );

    }

    refreshStatus() {

      const status =

        this.element

          ?.querySelector(

            '#tfm-dbz-runtime-status'

          );

      if (!status) {

        return;

      }

      const sceneSettings =

        this.getSettings();

      status.textContent =

        [

          'theme: ' +

            settings.get(

              'theme'

            ),

          'enabled: ' +

            (

              sceneSettings.enabled !==

              false

            ),

          'running: ' +

            dbzSceneManager.running,

          'outcome: ' +

            (

              dbzSceneManager

                .lastOutcome ||

              '-'

            ),

          'frieza: ' +

            Math.round(

              (

                Number(

                  sceneSettings

                    .interruptionChance

                ) || 0

              ) * 100

            ) +

            '%',

          'speed: ' +

            (

              Number(

                sceneSettings

                  .durationMultiplier

              ) || 1

            ).toFixed(1) +

            '×'

        ].join(' • ');

    }

    bindKeyboard() {

      this.disposables

        .addEventListener(

          document,

          'keydown',

          event => {

            if (

              event.shiftKey &&

              event.key

                .toLowerCase() ===

                'd'

            ) {

              event.preventDefault();

              this.toggle();

            }

          }

        );

    }

    show() {

      if (!this.element) {

        this.create();

      }

      this.visible = true;

      this.element

        .classList

        .remove(

          'tfm-hidden'

        );

      this.refreshStatus();

    }

    hide() {

      if (!this.element) {

        return;

      }

      this.visible = false;

      this.element

        .classList

        .add(

          'tfm-hidden'

        );

    }

    toggle() {

      if (this.visible) {

        this.hide();

      } else {

        this.show();

      }

    }

    recreate() {

      const wasVisible =

        this.visible;

      this.disposables.clear();

      if (

        this.element &&

        this.element.parentNode

      ) {

        this.element.remove();

      }

      this.element = null;

      this.create();

      this.bindKeyboard();

      if (wasVisible) {

        this.show();

      }

    }

    destroy() {

      this.disposables.clear();

      if (

        this.element &&

        this.element.parentNode

      ) {

        this.element.remove();

      }

      this.element = null;

    }

  }

  // ==========================================================

  // SETTINGS PANEL PATCH

  // ==========================================================

  function patchV4SettingsPanel() {

    if (

      !settingsPanel ||

      settingsPanel

        .__dbzPatched

    ) {

      return;

    }

    settingsPanel

      .__dbzPatched =

      true;

    const originalCreate =

      settingsPanel.create

        ?.bind(

          settingsPanel

        );

    if (!originalCreate) {

      return;

    }

    settingsPanel.create =

      function patchedCreate() {

        const result =

          originalCreate();

        setTimeout(() => {

          const panel =

            document.getElementById(

              'tfm-settings-panel'

            );

          if (

            !panel ||

            panel.querySelector(

              '#tfm-open-dbz-controls'

            )

          ) {

            return;

          }

          const section =

            document.createElement(

              'div'

            );

          section.className =

            'tfm-settings-section';

          const heading =

            document.createElement(

              'div'

            );

          heading.className =

            'tfm-settings-section-title';

          heading.textContent =

            'Dragon Ball Z';

          const button =

            document.createElement(

              'button'

            );

          button.id =

            'tfm-open-dbz-controls';

          button.className =

            'tfm-settings-button tfm-secondary';

          button.textContent =

            '🐉 Open DBZ Scene Control';

          button.addEventListener(

            'click',

            () => {

              dbzControlPanel.show();

            }

          );

          section.appendChild(

            heading

          );

          section.appendChild(

            button

          );

          panel.appendChild(

            section

          );

        }, 40);

        return result;

      };

    debugLogger.info(

      'v4 settings panel patched with DBZ controls.'

    );

  }

  // ==========================================================

  // ORIGINAL MENU PATCH

  // ==========================================================

  function patchOriginalMenuForDbz() {

    const menuManager =

      core.menuManager;

    if (

      !menuManager ||

      menuManager

        .__dbzControlPatched

    ) {

      return;

    }

    menuManager

      .__dbzControlPatched =

      true;

    const originalCreate =

      menuManager.create

        ?.bind(

          menuManager

        );

    if (!originalCreate) {

      return;

    }

    menuManager.create =

      function patchedMenuCreate() {

        const result =

          originalCreate();

        setTimeout(() => {

          const menu =

            document.getElementById(

              'bf-menu'

            );

          if (

            !menu ||

            menu.querySelector(

              '#tfm-open-dbz-panel'

            )

          ) {

            return;

          }

          const content =

            menu.children[1] ||

            menu;

          const button =

            document.createElement(

              'button'

            );

          button.id =

            'tfm-open-dbz-panel';

          button.textContent =

            '🐉 DBZ Scene Controls';

          button.style.cssText =

            'width:100%;' +

            'padding:10px;' +

            'margin-top:7px;' +

            'border:none;' +

            'border-radius:8px;' +

            'background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7b2cbf,#ff8f00);' +

            'color:white;' +

            'font-weight:900;' +

            'cursor:pointer;';

          button.addEventListener(

            'click',

            () => {

              dbzControlPanel.show();

            }

          );

          content.appendChild(

            button

          );

        }, 60);

        return result;

      };

    debugLogger.info(

      'Original menu patched with DBZ control button.'

    );

  }

  // ==========================================================

  // INITIALISE

  // ==========================================================

  const dbzControlPanel =

    new DBZControlPanel();

  patchV4SettingsPanel();

  patchOriginalMenuForDbz();

  extension.dbzControlPanel =

    dbzControlPanel;

  core.dbzControlPanel =

    dbzControlPanel;

  // ==========================================================

  // EVENT CONNECTIONS

  // ==========================================================

  eventManager.on(

    'DBZ_SETTINGS_CHANGED',

    event => {

      debugLogger.info(

        `DBZ setting changed: ${event.key}`,

        {

          value:

            event.value

        }

      );

    }

  );

  eventManager.on(

    'V4_DESTROYED',

    () => {

      dbzControlPanel

        .destroy();

    }

  );

  eventManager.on(

    'CLAIM_SUCCESS',

    () => {

      dbzControlPanel

        .refreshStatus();

    }

  );

  eventManager.on(

    'CLAIM_FAIL',

    () => {

      dbzControlPanel

        .refreshStatus();

    }

  );

  // ==========================================================

  // PUBLIC COMMANDS

  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {

    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    openDbzControls() {

      return dbzControlPanel

        .show();

    },

    closeDbzControls() {

      return dbzControlPanel

        .hide();

    },

    toggleDbzControls() {

      return dbzControlPanel

        .toggle();

    },

    dbzStatus() {

      return {

        settings:

          dbzControlPanel

            .getSettings(),

        running:

          dbzSceneManager

            .running,

        outcome:

          dbzSceneManager

            .lastOutcome,

        theme:

          settings.get(

            'theme'

          )

      };

    }

  };

  debugLogger.info(

    'Part 23 loaded successfully.',

    {

      shortcut:

        'Shift+D'

    }

  );

  eventManager.emit(

    'V4_PART_23_READY',

    {

      dbzControlPanel

    }

  );

})();

(function TheFreshMakerV4Part24() {
  'use strict';

  const extension =
    window.TheFreshMakerV4;

  const core =
    window.BFHelper;

  if (!extension || !core) {
    console.error(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 24 requires Parts 17–23.'
    );

    return;
  }

  if (
    window.TFM_V4_PART_24_LOADED
  ) {
    console.warn(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 24 already loaded.'
    );

    return;
  }

  window.TFM_V4_PART_24_LOADED =
    true;

  const {
    eventManager,
    debugLogger,
    dbzSceneManager
  } = extension;

  const {
    settings,
    Disposables
  } = core;

  if (!dbzSceneManager) {
    console.error(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] DBZ scene manager was not found.'
    );

    return;
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // DEFAULTS
  // ==========================================================

  const DBZ_EFFECT_DEFAULTS = {
    cameraShake: true,

    impactFlash: true,

    energyParticles: true,

    auraParticles: true,

    sceneSounds: true,

    reducedMotion: false,

    shakeStrength: 1,

    particleAmount: 22,

    sounds: {
      detect:
        '',

      charge:
        '',

      blast:
        '',

      victory:
        '',

      failure:
        ''
    }
  };

  function mergeEffectsSettings() {
    const current =
      settings.get(
        'dbzEffects'
      ) || {};

    const merged = {
      ...DBZ_EFFECT_DEFAULTS,
      ...current,

      sounds: {
        ...DBZ_EFFECT_DEFAULTS.sounds,
        ...(
          current.sounds ||
          {}
        )
      }
    };

    settings.set(
      'dbzEffects',
      merged
    );

    return merged;
  }

  let effectSettings =
    mergeEffectsSettings();

  // ==========================================================
  // STYLE INJECTION
  // ==========================================================

  function injectEffectStyles() {
    if (
      document.getElementById(
        'tfm-dbz-effect-styles'
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const style =
      document.createElement(
        'style'
      );

    style.id =
      'tfm-dbz-effect-styles';

    style.textContent = `
      #tfm-dbz-effect-layer {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 2147483645;
      }

      #tfm-dbz-impact-flash {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background:
          radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(255,255,255,0.98) 0%,
            rgba(255,235,59,0.74) 14%,
            rgba(255,152,0,0.34) 35%,
            transparent 68%
          );
        opacity: 0;
        mix-blend-mode: screen;
      }

      #tfm-dbz-impact-flash.tfm-active {
        animation:
          tfm-dbz-impact-flash
          430ms ease-out;
      }

      .tfm-dbz-particle {
        position: absolute;
        width: 9px;
        height: 9px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        pointer-events: none;
        opacity: 0;
        background:
          radial-gradient(
            circle,
            #fff 0%,

  injectEffectStyles();

  // ==========================================================
  // EFFECT LAYER
  // ==========================================================

  class DBZEffectLayer {
    constructor() {
      this.element = null;
      this.flashElement = null;
      this.particles =
        new Set();

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.audioCache =
        new Map();

      this.create();
      this.bindEvents();
    }

    create() {
      const existing =
        document.getElementById(
          'tfm-dbz-effect-layer'
        );

      if (existing) {
        existing.remove();
      }

      const layer =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      layer.id =
        'tfm-dbz-effect-layer';

      const flash =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      flash.id =
        'tfm-dbz-impact-flash';

      layer.appendChild(
        flash
      );

      document.body
        .appendChild(layer);

      this.element =
        layer;

      this.flashElement =
        flash;
    }

    getSettings() {
      effectSettings =
        mergeEffectsSettings();

      return effectSettings;
    }

    effectsAllowed() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const visuals =
        settings.get(
          'visuals'
        ) || {};

      const dbzScene =
        settings.get(
          'dbzScene'
        ) || {};

      return (
        dbzScene.enabled !==
          false &&
        visuals.enabled !==
          false &&
        visuals.animations !==
          false &&
        settings.get(
          'theme'
        ) === 'dbz' &&
        !config.reducedMotion
      );
    }

    cameraShake(
      strength = 1,
      heavy = false,
      duration = 500
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        !this.effectsAllowed() ||
        config.cameraShake ===
          false
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const root =
        document.documentElement;

      root.classList.remove(
        'tfm-dbz-camera-shake',
        'tfm-dbz-heavy-shake'
      );

      root.style.setProperty(
        '--tfm-shake-strength',
        String(
          Math.max(
            0.1,
            Number(
              config.shakeStrength
            ) *
            Number(strength)
          )
        )
      );

      root.style.setProperty(
        '--tfm-shake-duration',
        Math.max(
          100,
          duration
        ) + 'ms'
      );

      void root.offsetWidth;

      root.classList.add(
        heavy
          ? 'tfm-dbz-heavy-shake'
          : 'tfm-dbz-camera-shake'
      );

      this.disposables
        .addTimeout(
          setTimeout(() => {
            root.classList.remove(
              'tfm-dbz-camera-shake',
              'tfm-dbz-heavy-shake'
            );
          }, duration + 80)
        );
    }

    impactFlash() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        !this.effectsAllowed() ||
        config.impactFlash ===
          false ||
        !this.flashElement
      ) {
        return;
      }

      this.flashElement
        .classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-active'
        );

      void this.flashElement
        .offsetWidth;

      this.flashElement
        .classList
        .add(
          'tfm-active'
        );

      this.disposables
        .addTimeout(
          setTimeout(() => {
            this.flashElement
              ?.classList
              .remove(
                'tfm-active'
              );
          }, 480)
        );
    }

    createParticle(
      x,
      y,
      options = {}
    ) {
      if (!this.element) {
        this.create();
      }

      const particle =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      particle.className =
        options.aura
          ? 'tfm-dbz-aura-particle'
          : 'tfm-dbz-particle';

      particle.style.left =
        x + 'px';

      particle.style.top =
        y + 'px';

      particle.style.setProperty(
        '--tfm-x',
        (
          options.x ||
          0
        ) + 'px'
      );

      particle.style.setProperty(
        '--tfm-y',
        (
          options.y ||
          0
        ) + 'px'
      );

      particle.style.setProperty(
        '--tfm-duration',
        (
          options.duration ||
          800
        ) + 'ms'
      );

      if (
        options.size
      ) {
        particle.style.width =
          options.size +
          'px';

        particle.style.height =
          options.aura
            ? options.size * 3 +
              'px'
            : options.size +
              'px';
      }

      this.element
        .appendChild(
          particle
        );

      this.particles.add(
        particle
      );

      requestAnimationFrame(
        () => {
          particle.classList.add(
            'tfm-fire'
          );
        }
      );

      const lifetime =
        (
          options.duration ||
          800
        ) + 120;

      this.disposables
        .addTimeout(
          setTimeout(() => {
            this.particles.delete(
              particle
            );

            if (
              particle.parentNode
            ) {
              particle.remove();
            }
          }, lifetime)
        );

      return particle;
    }

    burst(
      x,
      y,
      amount = null,
      radius = 190
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        !this.effectsAllowed() ||
        config.energyParticles ===
          false
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const count =
        Math.max(
          4,
          Math.min(
            80,
            Number(
              amount ??
              config.particleAmount
            ) || 20
          )
        );

      for (
        let index = 0;
        index < count;
        index++
      ) {
        const angle =
          (
            Math.PI * 2 *
            index
          ) / count +
          (
            Math.random() -
            0.5
          ) * 0.45;

        const distance =
          radius *
          (
            0.45 +
            Math.random() *
            0.65
          );

        this.createParticle(
          x,
          y,
          {
            x:
              Math.cos(angle) *
              distance,

            y:
              Math.sin(angle) *
              distance,

            duration:
              520 +
              Math.random() *
              520,

            size:
              5 +
              Math.random() *
              8
          }
        );
      }
    }

    auraBurst(
      element,
      amount = 18
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        !this.effectsAllowed() ||
        config.auraParticles ===
          false ||
        !element
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const rect =
        element
          .getBoundingClientRect();

      const count =
        Math.max(
          4,
          Math.min(
            60,
            amount
          )
        );

      for (
        let index = 0;
        index < count;
        index++
      ) {
        const x =
          rect.left +
          Math.random() *
          rect.width;

        const y =
          rect.bottom -
          Math.random() *
          rect.height *
          0.35;

        this.createParticle(
          x,
          y,
          {
            aura: true,

            x:
              (
                Math.random() -
                0.5
              ) * 65,

            y:
              -90 -
              Math.random() *
              170,

            duration:
              650 +
              Math.random() *
              650,

            size:
              4 +
              Math.random() *
              5
          }
        );
      }
    }

    centreBurst(
      amount = null
    ) {
      this.burst(
        window.innerWidth / 2,
        window.innerHeight / 2,
        amount,
        Math.min(
          240,
          window.innerWidth *
          0.28
        )
      );
    }

    getAudio(
      type
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const url =
        config.sounds?.[
          type
        ];

      if (!url) {
        return null;
      }

      if (
        this.audioCache.has(
          url
        )
      ) {
        return this.audioCache
          .get(url);
      }

      try {
        const audio =
          new Audio(url);

        audio.preload =
          'auto';

        this.audioCache.set(
          url,
          audio
        );

        return audio;
      } catch (error) {
        debugLogger.warn(
          'Could not create DBZ audio.',
          {
            type,
            url,
            error
          }
        );

        return null;
      }
    }

    playSound(
      type,
      volumeMultiplier = 1
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        config.sceneSounds ===
          false
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const audio =
        this.getAudio(type);

      if (!audio) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        audio.pause();

        audio.currentTime =
          0;

        audio.volume =
          Math.max(
            0,
            Math.min(
              1,
              Number(
                settings.get(
                  'volume'
                ) || 0.7
              ) *
              Number(
                volumeMultiplier
              )
            )
          );

        audio.play()
          .catch(
            () => {}
          );
      } catch (error) {}
    }

    updateSettings(
      updates
    ) {
      const current =
        this.getSettings();

      effectSettings = {
        ...current,
        ...(updates || {}),

        sounds: {
          ...current.sounds,
          ...(
            updates?.sounds ||
            {}
          )
        }
      };

      settings.set(
        'dbzEffects',
        effectSettings
      );

      return {
        ...effectSettings,
        sounds: {
          ...effectSettings.sounds
        }
      };
    }

    bindEvents() {
      eventManager.on(
        'DROP_FOUND',
        () => {
          if (
            settings.get(
              'theme'
            ) !== 'dbz'
          ) {
            return;
          }

          this.playSound(
            'detect',
            0.8
          );

          this.centreBurst(
            12
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_START',
        () => {
          if (
            settings.get(
              'theme'
            ) !== 'dbz'
          ) {
            return;
          }

          this.playSound(
            'charge',
            0.9
          );

          this.auraBurst(
            dbzSceneManager
              .goku,
            20
          );

          this.cameraShake(
            0.45,
            false,
            380
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_RETRY',
        () => {
          if (
            settings.get(
              'theme'
            ) !== 'dbz'
          ) {
            return;
          }

          this.playSound(
            'blast',
            0.8
          );

          this.cameraShake(
            0.7,
            false,
            470
          );

          this.centreBurst(
            16
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
        () => {
          if (
            settings.get(
              'theme'
            ) !== 'dbz'
          ) {
            return;
          }

          this.playSound(
            'victory',
            1
          );

          this.impactFlash();

          this.cameraShake(
            0.8,
            true,
            620
          );

          this.centreBurst();
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_FAIL',
        () => {
          if (
            settings.get(
              'theme'
            ) !== 'dbz'
          ) {
            return;
          }

          this.playSound(
            'failure',
            0.9
          );

          this.impactFlash();

          this.cameraShake(
            1,
            true,
            680
          );

          this.centreBurst(
            30
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        () => {
          this.cameraShake(
            0.35,
            false,
            320
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'V4_DESTROYED',
        () => {
          this.destroy();
        }
      );
    }

    clearParticles() {
      this.particles
        .forEach(
          particle => {
            if (
              particle.parentNode
            ) {
              particle.remove();
            }
          }
        );

      this.particles.clear();
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables.clear();

      this.clearParticles();

      this.audioCache
        .forEach(
          audio => {
            try {
              audio.pause();

              audio.src = '';
            } catch (
              error
            ) {}
          }
        );

      this.audioCache.clear();

      if (
        this.element &&
        this.element.parentNode
      ) {
        this.element.remove();
      }

      document.documentElement
        .classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-dbz-camera-shake',
          'tfm-dbz-heavy-shake'
        );

      this.element = null;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // PATCH DBZ CONTROL PANEL
  // ==========================================================

  function patchDbzControlPanel(
    effectLayer
  ) {
    const panel =
      extension
        .dbzControlPanel;

    if (
      !panel ||
      panel
        .__effectsPatched
    ) {
      return;
    }

    panel.__effectsPatched =
      true;

    const originalCreate =
      panel.create
        ?.bind(panel);

    if (!originalCreate) {
      return;
    }

    panel.create =
      function patchedCreate() {
        const result =
          originalCreate();

        setTimeout(() => {
          const panelElement =
            document
              .getElementById(
                'tfm-dbz-control-panel'
              );

          if (
            !panelElement ||
            panelElement
              .querySelector(
                '#tfm-dbz-effects-section'
              )
          ) {
            return;
          }

          const config =
            effectLayer
              .getSettings();

          const section =
            document.createElement(
              'div'
            );

          section.id =
            'tfm-dbz-effects-section';

          section.className =
            'tfm-dbz-control-section';

          const heading =
            document.createElement(
              'div'
            );

          heading.className =
            'tfm-dbz-control-heading';

          heading.textContent =
            'Advanced effects';

          section.appendChild(
            heading
          );

          const addCheckbox =
            (
              labelText,
              key
            ) => {
              const row =
                document.createElement(
                  'div'
                );

              row.className =
                'tfm-dbz-control-row';

              const label =
                document.createElement(
                  'label'
                );

              label.textContent =
                labelText;

              const input =
                document.createElement(
                  'input'
                );

              input.type =
                'checkbox';

              input.checked =
                config[key] !==
                false;

              input.addEventListener(
                'change',
                () => {
                  effectLayer
                    .updateSettings({
                      [key]:
                        input.checked
                    });
                }
              );

              row.appendChild(
                label
              );

              row.appendChild(
                input
              );

              section.appendChild(
                row
              );
            };

          addCheckbox(
            'Camera shake',
            'cameraShake'
          );

          addCheckbox(
            'Impact flash',
            'impactFlash'
          );

          addCheckbox(
            'Energy particles',
            'energyParticles'
          );

          addCheckbox(
            'Aura particles',
            'auraParticles'
          );

          addCheckbox(
            'Scene sounds',
            'sceneSounds'
          );

          addCheckbox(
            'Reduced motion',
            'reducedMotion'
          );

          const testButton =
            document.createElement(
              'button'
            );

          testButton.className =
            'tfm-dbz-control-button tfm-gold';

          testButton.textContent =
            'Test impact effects';

          testButton.addEventListener(
            'click',
            () => {
              effectLayer
                .impactFlash();

              effectLayer
                .cameraShake(
                  1,
                  true,
                  650
                );

              effectLayer
                .centreBurst(
                  32
                );

              effectLayer
                .auraBurst(
                  dbzSceneManager
                    .goku,
                  24
                );
            }
          );

          section.appendChild(
            testButton
          );

          panelElement
            .appendChild(
              section
            );
        }, 70);

        return result;
      };

    debugLogger.info(
      'DBZ control panel patched with advanced effects.'
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // INITIALISE
  // ==========================================================

  const dbzEffectLayer =
    new DBZEffectLayer();

  patchDbzControlPanel(
    dbzEffectLayer
  );

  extension.dbzEffectLayer =
    dbzEffectLayer;

  core.dbzEffectLayer =
    dbzEffectLayer;

  // ==========================================================
  // PUBLIC COMMANDS
  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    dbzEffects: {
      settings() {
        return {
          ...dbzEffectLayer
            .getSettings()
        };
      },

      update(
        updates
      ) {
        return dbzEffectLayer
          .updateSettings(
            updates
          );
      },

      shake(
        strength = 1,
        heavy = false
      ) {
        return dbzEffectLayer
          .cameraShake(
            strength,
            heavy,
            heavy
              ? 650
              : 450
          );
      },

      flash() {
        return dbzEffectLayer
          .impactFlash();
      },

      burst(
        amount = 24
      ) {
        return dbzEffectLayer
          .centreBurst(
            amount
          );
      },

      aura() {
        return dbzEffectLayer
          .auraBurst(
            dbzSceneManager
              .goku,
            24
          );
      },

      test() {
        dbzEffectLayer
          .impactFlash();

        dbzEffectLayer
          .cameraShake(
            1,
            true,
            650
          );

        dbzEffectLayer
          .centreBurst(
            32
          );

        dbzEffectLayer
          .auraBurst(
            dbzSceneManager
              .goku,
            24
          );

        return true;
      },

      clear() {
        return dbzEffectLayer
          .clearParticles();
      }
    }
  };

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 24 loaded successfully.'
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_PART_24_READY',
    {
      dbzEffectLayer,
      settings: {
        ...effectSettings
      }
    }
  );
})();

  function mergeAudioSettings() {

        ...(

          {}
        ),
        ...(
          current.sounds ||
          {}
        )
      }
    };

    settings.set(
      'dbzAudio',
      merged
    );

    return merged;
  }

  let audioSettings =
    mergeAudioSettings();

  // ==========================================================
  // AUDIO ENGINE
  // ==========================================================

  class DBZAudioManager {
    constructor() {
      this.cache =
        new Map();

      this.lastPlayedAt =
        new Map();

      this.unlocked = false;

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.unlockHandler =
        this.unlock.bind(this);

      this.bindUnlock();
      this.bindEvents();
      this.preloadAll();
    }

    getSettings() {
      audioSettings =
        mergeAudioSettings();

      return audioSettings;
    }

    bindUnlock() {
      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'pointerdown',
          this.unlockHandler,
          {
            once: true,
            capture: true
          }
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'keydown',
          this.unlockHandler,
          {
            once: true,
            capture: true
          }
        );
    }

    unlock() {
      if (this.unlocked) {
        return;
      }

      this.unlocked = true;

      debugLogger.info(
        'DBZ audio playback unlocked.'
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'DBZ_AUDIO_UNLOCKED'
      );
    }

    getUrl(
      type
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      return String(
        config.sounds?.[
          type
        ] || ''
      ).trim();
    }

    getMultiplier(
      type
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const keyMap = {
        detect:
          'detectMultiplier',

        charge:
          'chargeMultiplier',

        blast:
          'blastMultiplier',

        victory:
          'victoryMultiplier',

        failure:
          'failureMultiplier'
      };

      const key =
        keyMap[type];

      return Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(
          2,
          Number(
            config[key]
          ) || 1
        )
      );
    }

    getAudio(
      type
    ) {
      const url =
        this.getUrl(type);

      if (!url) {
        return null;
      }

      const cacheKey =
        type + '|' + url;

      if (
        this.cache.has(
          cacheKey
        )
      ) {
        return this.cache
          .get(cacheKey);
      }

      try {
        const audio =
          new Audio();

        audio.preload =
          'auto';

        audio.src =
          url;

        audio.crossOrigin =
          'anonymous';

        this.cache.set(
          cacheKey,
          audio
        );

        return audio;
      } catch (error) {
        debugLogger.warn(
          'Could not create DBZ audio element.',
          {
            type,
            url,
            error
          }
        );

        return null;
      }
    }

    canReplay(
      type
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const gap =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            config.minimumReplayGap
          ) || 0
        );

      const last =
        this.lastPlayedAt
          .get(type) || 0;

      return (
        Date.now() -
          last >=
        gap
      );
    }

    calculateVolume(
      type,
      extraMultiplier = 1
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const baseVolume =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(
            1,
            Number(
              settings.get(
                'volume'
              ) || 0.7
            )
          )
        );

      const master =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(
            2,
            Number(
              config.masterMultiplier
            ) || 1
          )
        );

      const channel =
        this.getMultiplier(
          type
        );

      return Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(
          1,
          baseVolume *
            master *
            channel *
            Number(
              extraMultiplier || 1
            )
        )
      );
    }

    async play(
      type,
      extraMultiplier = 1,
      force = false
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        config.enabled ===
          false ||
        settings.get(
          'theme'
        ) !== 'dbz'
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      if (
        !force &&
        !this.canReplay(
          type
        )
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      const audio =
        this.getAudio(type);

      if (!audio) {
        return false;
      }

      try {
        audio.pause();

        audio.currentTime =
          0;

        audio.volume =
          this.calculateVolume(
            type,
            extraMultiplier
          );

        const result =
          audio.play();

        if (
          result &&
          typeof result.then ===
            'function'
        ) {
          await result;
        }

        this.lastPlayedAt
          .set(
            type,
            Date.now()
          );

        eventManager.emit(
          'DBZ_AUDIO_PLAYED',
          {
            type,
            volume:
              audio.volume
          }
        );

        return true;
      } catch (error) {
        debugLogger.warn(
          'DBZ sound playback failed.',
          {
            type,
            error
          }
        );

        eventManager.emit(
          'DBZ_AUDIO_FAILED',
          {
            type,
            reason:
              String(
                error?.message ||
                error
              )
          }
        );

        return false;
      }
    }

    stop(
      type = null
    ) {
      this.cache.forEach(
        (
          audio,
          key
        ) => {
          if (
            type &&
            !key.startsWith(
              type + '|'
            )
          ) {
            return;
          }

          try {
            audio.pause();

            audio.currentTime =
              0;
          } catch (
            error
          ) {}
        }
      );
    }

    preload(
      type
    ) {
      const audio =
        this.getAudio(type);

      if (!audio) {
        return false;
      }

      try {
        audio.load();

        return true;
      } catch (error) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    preloadAll() {
      [
        'detect',
        'charge',
        'blast',
        'victory',
        'failure'
      ].forEach(
        type => {
          this.preload(
            type
          );
        }
      );
    }

    clearCache() {
      this.cache.forEach(
        audio => {
          try {
            audio.pause();
            audio.src = '';
          } catch (
            error
          ) {}
        }
      );

      this.cache.clear();
      this.lastPlayedAt.clear();
    }

    update(
      updates
    ) {
      const current =
        this.getSettings();

      audioSettings = {
        ...current,
        ...(updates || {}),

        sounds: {
          ...current.sounds,
          ...(
            updates?.sounds ||
            {}
          )
        }
      };

      settings.set(
        'dbzAudio',
        audioSettings
      );

      dbzEffectLayer
        .updateSettings({
          sounds: {
            ...audioSettings.sounds
          }
        });

      this.clearCache();
      this.preloadAll();

      eventManager.emit(
        'DBZ_AUDIO_SETTINGS_CHANGED',
        {
          settings: {
            ...audioSettings,
            sounds: {
              ...audioSettings.sounds
            }
          }
        }
      );

      return {
        ...audioSettings,
        sounds: {
          ...audioSettings.sounds
        }
      };
    }

    bindEvents() {
      eventManager.on(
        'DROP_FOUND',
        () => {
          this.play(
            'detect',
            0.85
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_START',
        () => {
          this.play(
            'charge',
            0.95
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_RETRY',
        () => {
          this.play(
            'blast',
            0.9
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
        () => {
          this.play(
            'victory',
            1
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_FAIL',
        () => {
          this.play(
            'failure',
            0.95
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        () => {
          this.stop();
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'V4_DESTROYED',
        () => {
          this.destroy();
        }
      );
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables.clear();
      this.stop();
      this.clearCache();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // AUDIO PANEL
  // ==========================================================

  class DBZAudioPanel {
    constructor(
      audioManager
    ) {
      this.audioManager =
        audioManager;

      this.element = null;
      this.backdrop = null;
      this.visible = false;

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.create();
      this.bindKeyboard();
    }

    getSettings() {
      return {
        ...this.audioManager
          .getSettings(),

        sounds: {
          ...this.audioManager
            .getSettings()
            .sounds
        }
      };
    }

    createButton(
      text,
      className,
      handler
    ) {
      const button =
        document.createElement(
          'button'
        );

      button.className =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-button ' +
        (
          className || ''
        );

      button.textContent =
        text;

      button.addEventListener(
        'click',
        handler
      );

      return button;
    }

    createSoundRow(
      type,
      labelText,
      url
    ) {
      const row =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      row.className =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-row';

      const label =
        document.createElement(
          'label'
        );

      label.textContent =
        labelText;

      const input =
        document.createElement(
          'input'
        );

      input.type =
        'url';

      input.value =
        url || '';

      input.placeholder =
        'https://...';

      const testButton =
        document.createElement(
          'button'
        );

      testButton.className =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-test';

      testButton.textContent =
        '▶';

      testButton.title =
        'Test sound';

      testButton.addEventListener(
        'click',
        () => {
          this.saveSoundInput(
            type,
            input.value
          );

          this.audioManager
            .play(
              type,
              1,
              true
            );
        }
      );

      input.addEventListener(
        'change',
        () => {
          this.saveSoundInput(
            type,
            input.value
          );
        }
      );

      row.appendChild(label);
      row.appendChild(input);
      row.appendChild(
        testButton
      );

      return row;
    }

    createMultiplierRow(
      labelText,
      key,
      value
    ) {
      const row =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      row.className =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-row';

      row.style.gridTemplateColumns =
        '92px 1fr 42px';

      const label =
        document.createElement(
          'label'
        );

      label.textContent =
        labelText;

      const input =
        document.createElement(
          'input'
        );

      input.type =
        'range';

      input.min =
        '0';

      input.max =
        '2';

      input.step =
        '0.05';

      input.value =
        String(value);

      const display =
        document.createElement(
          'span'
        );

      display.style.cssText =
        'font:800 10px ui-monospace,monospace;' +
        'color:#e0c8ef;' +
        'text-align:right;';

      const updateDisplay =
        () => {
          display.textContent =
            Number(
              input.value
            ).toFixed(2) +
            '×';
        };

      updateDisplay();

      input.addEventListener(
        'input',
        () => {
          updateDisplay();

          this.audioManager
            .update({
              [key]:
                Number(
                  input.value
                )
            });
        }
      );

      row.appendChild(label);
      row.appendChild(input);
      row.appendChild(display);

      return row;
    }

    saveSoundInput(
      type,
      value
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      this.audioManager
        .update({
          sounds: {
            ...config.sounds,
            [type]:
              String(
                value || ''
              ).trim()
          }
        });

      this.refreshStatus();
    }

    create() {
      const existing =
        document.getElementById(
          'tfm-dbz-audio-panel'
        );

      if (existing) {
        existing.remove();
      }

      const existingBackdrop =
        document.getElementById(
          'tfm-dbz-audio-backdrop'
        );

      if (existingBackdrop) {
        existingBackdrop.remove();
      }

      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const backdrop =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      backdrop.id =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-backdrop';

      backdrop.addEventListener(
        'click',
        () => {
          this.hide();
        }
      );

      const panel =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      panel.id =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-panel';

      const header =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      header.id =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-header';

      const title =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      title.id =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-title';

      title.textContent =
        '🔊 DBZ Audio Control';

      const close =
        document.createElement(
          'button'
        );

      close.id =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-close';

      close.textContent =
        '✕';

      close.addEventListener(
        'click',
        () => {
          this.hide();
        }
      );

      header.appendChild(title);
      header.appendChild(close);

      panel.appendChild(header);

      const generalSection =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      generalSection.className =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-section';

      generalSection.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tfm-dbz-audio-heading">
          General
        </div>
      `;

      const enabledRow =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      enabledRow.className =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-row';

      enabledRow.style.gridTemplateColumns =
        '1fr auto';

      const enabledLabel =
        document.createElement(
          'label'
        );

      enabledLabel.textContent =
        'Enable scene audio';

      const enabledInput =
        document.createElement(
          'input'
        );

      enabledInput.type =
        'checkbox';

      enabledInput.checked =
        config.enabled !==
        false;

      enabledInput.addEventListener(
        'change',
        () => {
          this.audioManager
            .update({
              enabled:
                enabledInput.checked
            });
        }
      );

      enabledRow.appendChild(
        enabledLabel
      );

      enabledRow.appendChild(
        enabledInput
      );

      generalSection.appendChild(
        enabledRow
      );

      generalSection.appendChild(
        this.createMultiplierRow(
          'Master',
          'masterMultiplier',
          config.masterMultiplier
        )
      );

      panel.appendChild(
        generalSection
      );

      const soundSection =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      soundSection.className =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-section';

      soundSection.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tfm-dbz-audio-heading">
          Sound URLs
        </div>
      `;

      [
        [
          'detect',
          'Detection'
        ],
        [
          'charge',
          'Charge'
        ],
        [
          'blast',
          'Blast'
        ],
        [
          'victory',
          'Victory'
        ],
        [
          'failure',
          'Failure'
        ]
      ].forEach(
        ([type, label]) => {
          soundSection
            .appendChild(
              this.createSoundRow(
                type,
                label,
                config.sounds[
                  type
                ]
              )
            );
        }
      );

      panel.appendChild(
        soundSection
      );

      const balanceSection =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      balanceSection.className =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-section';

      balanceSection.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tfm-dbz-audio-heading">
          Channel balance
        </div>
      `;

      [
        [
          'Detect',
          'detectMultiplier'
        ],
        [
          'Charge',
          'chargeMultiplier'
        ],
        [
          'Blast',
          'blastMultiplier'
        ],
        [
          'Victory',
          'victoryMultiplier'
        ],
        [
          'Failure',
          'failureMultiplier'
        ]
      ].forEach(
        ([label, key]) => {
          balanceSection
            .appendChild(
              this.createMultiplierRow(
                label,
                key,
                config[key]
              )
            );
        }
      );

      panel.appendChild(
        balanceSection
      );

      const testSection =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      testSection.className =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-section';

      testSection.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tfm-dbz-audio-heading">
          Testing
        </div>
      `;

      const testGrid =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      testGrid.className =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-grid';

      testGrid.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Test all sounds',
          'tfm-purple',
          async () => {
            const types = [
              'detect',
              'charge',
              'blast',
              'victory',
              'failure'
            ];

            for (
              const type
              of types
            ) {
              await this.audioManager
                .play(
                  type,
                  1,
                  true
                );

              await new Promise(
                resolve => {
                  setTimeout(
                    resolve,
                    650
                  );
                }
              );
            }
          }
        )
      );

      testGrid.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Stop sounds',
          'tfm-red',
          () => {
            this.audioManager
              .stop();
          }
        )
      );

      testGrid.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Preload sounds',
          '',
          () => {
            this.audioManager
              .preloadAll();

            eventToast?.show(
              'DBZ sounds preloaded',
              1100,
              'success'
            );
          }
        )
      );

      testGrid.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Clear cache',
          'tfm-gold',
          () => {
            this.audioManager
              .clearCache();

            eventToast?.show(
              'Audio cache cleared',
              1000,
              'info'
            );
          }
        )
      );

      testSection.appendChild(
        testGrid
      );

      const status =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      status.id =
        'tfm-dbz-audio-status';

      testSection.appendChild(
        status
      );

      panel.appendChild(
        testSection
      );

      document.body
        .appendChild(
          backdrop
        );

      document.body
        .appendChild(
          panel
        );

      this.element =
        panel;

      this.backdrop =
        backdrop;

      this.refreshStatus();

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            this.refreshStatus();
          }, 1200)
        );
    }

    refreshStatus() {
      const status =
        this.element
          ?.querySelector(
            '#tfm-dbz-audio-status'
          );

      if (!status) {
        return;
      }

      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const configured =
        Object.entries(
          config.sounds
        )
          .filter(
            ([, url]) =>
              Boolean(
                String(
                  url || ''
                ).trim()
              )
          )
          .map(
            ([type]) =>
              type
          );

      status.textContent =
        [
          'enabled: ' +
            (
              config.enabled !==
              false
            ),

          'unlocked: ' +
            this.audioManager
              .unlocked,

          'configured: ' +
            (
              configured.length
                ? configured.join(
                    ', '
                  )
                : 'none'
            ),

          'cached: ' +
            this.audioManager
              .cache
              .size,

          'master: ' +
            Number(
              config.masterMultiplier
            ).toFixed(2) +
            '×',

          'site volume: ' +
            Math.round(
              Number(
                settings.get(
                  'volume'
                ) || 0
              ) * 100
            ) +
            '%'
        ].join(' • ');
    }

    bindKeyboard() {
      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'keydown',
          event => {
            if (
              event.shiftKey &&
              event.key
                .toLowerCase() ===
                'a'
            ) {
              event.preventDefault();

              this.toggle();
            }

            if (
              event.key ===
              'Escape' &&
              this.visible
            ) {
              this.hide();
            }
          }
        );
    }

    show() {
      if (!this.element) {
        this.create();
      }

      this.visible = true;

      this.element
        .classList
        .add(
          'tfm-visible'
        );

      this.backdrop
        ?.classList
        .add(
          'tfm-visible'
        );

      this.refreshStatus();
    }

    hide() {
      this.visible = false;

      this.element
        ?.classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-visible'
        );

      this.backdrop
        ?.classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-visible'
        );
    }

    toggle() {
      if (this.visible) {
        this.hide();
      } else {
        this.show();
      }
    }

    recreate() {
      const wasVisible =
        this.visible;

      this.disposables.clear();

      this.element
        ?.remove();

      this.backdrop
        ?.remove();

      this.element = null;
      this.backdrop = null;

      this.create();
      this.bindKeyboard();

      if (wasVisible) {
        this.show();
      }
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables.clear();

      this.element
        ?.remove();

      this.backdrop
        ?.remove();

      this.element = null;
      this.backdrop = null;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // CONTROL-PANEL PATCH
  // ==========================================================

  function patchDbzControlPanel(
    audioPanel
  ) {
    if (
      !dbzControlPanel ||
      dbzControlPanel
        .__audioPatched
    ) {
      return;
    }

    dbzControlPanel
      .__audioPatched =
      true;

    const originalCreate =
      dbzControlPanel
        .create
        ?.bind(
          dbzControlPanel
        );

    if (!originalCreate) {
      return;
    }

    dbzControlPanel.create =
      function patchedCreate() {
        const result =
          originalCreate();

        setTimeout(() => {
          const panel =
            document.getElementById(
              'tfm-dbz-control-panel'
            );

          if (
            !panel ||
            panel.querySelector(
              '#tfm-open-dbz-audio'
            )
          ) {
            return;
          }

          const section =
            document.createElement(
              'div'
            );

          section.className =
            'tfm-dbz-control-section';

          const heading =
            document.createElement(
              'div'
            );

          heading.className =
            'tfm-dbz-control-heading';

          heading.textContent =
            'Scene audio';

          const button =
            document.createElement(
              'button'
            );

          button.id =
            'tfm-open-dbz-audio';

          button.className =
            'tfm-dbz-control-button tfm-blue';

          button.textContent =
            '🔊 Open DBZ Audio Control';

          button.addEventListener(
            'click',
            () => {
              audioPanel.show();
            }
          );

          section.appendChild(
            heading
          );

          section.appendChild(
            button
          );

          panel.appendChild(
            section
          );
        }, 90);

        return result;
      };

    debugLogger.info(
      'DBZ control panel patched with audio controls.'
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // INITIALISE
  // ==========================================================

  const dbzAudioManager =
    new DBZAudioManager();

  const dbzAudioPanel =
    new DBZAudioPanel(
      dbzAudioManager
    );

  patchDbzControlPanel(
    dbzAudioPanel
  );

  extension.dbzAudioManager =
    dbzAudioManager;

  extension.dbzAudioPanel =
    dbzAudioPanel;

  core.dbzAudioManager =
    dbzAudioManager;

  core.dbzAudioPanel =
    dbzAudioPanel;

  // ==========================================================
  // EVENT CONNECTIONS
  // ==========================================================

  eventManager.on(
    'DBZ_AUDIO_SETTINGS_CHANGED',
    event => {
      debugLogger.info(
        'DBZ audio settings changed.',
        {
          enabled:
            event.settings
              .enabled,

          configured:
            Object.values(
              event.settings
                .sounds
            )
              .filter(Boolean)
              .length
        }
      );
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'DBZ_AUDIO_FAILED',
    event => {
      if (
        settings.get(
          'debugMode'
        )
      ) {
        eventToast?.show(
          `DBZ sound failed: ${event.type}`,
          1300,
          'warning'
        );
      }
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'V4_DESTROYED',
    () => {
      dbzAudioPanel
        .destroy();

      dbzAudioManager
        .destroy();
    }
  );

  // ==========================================================
  // PUBLIC COMMANDS
  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    openDbzAudio() {
      return dbzAudioPanel
        .show();
    },

    closeDbzAudio() {
      return dbzAudioPanel
        .hide();
    },

    toggleDbzAudio() {
      return dbzAudioPanel
        .toggle();
    },

    dbzAudio: {
      settings() {
        return dbzAudioPanel
          .getSettings();
      },

      update(
        updates
      ) {
        return dbzAudioManager
          .update(
            updates
          );
      },

      play(
        type,
        multiplier = 1
      ) {
        return dbzAudioManager
          .play(
            type,
            multiplier,
            true
          );
      },

      stop(
        type = null
      ) {
        return dbzAudioManager
          .stop(type);
      },

      preload() {
        return dbzAudioManager
          .preloadAll();
      },

      clearCache() {
        return dbzAudioManager
          .clearCache();
      }
    }
  };

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 25 loaded successfully.',
    {
      shortcut:
        'Shift+A',

      configuredSounds:
        Object.values(
          audioSettings.sounds
        )
          .filter(Boolean)
          .length
    }
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_PART_25_READY',
    {
      dbzAudioManager,
      dbzAudioPanel
    }
  );
})();
// ============================================================
// THEFRESHMAKER v4 OPTIONAL VISUAL EXTENSION
// Part 26
// DBZ scene queue, overlap protection, priority handling,
// skipped-scene recovery and scene lifecycle tracking.
// Paste directly after Part 25.
// ============================================================

(function TheFreshMakerV4Part26() {
  'use strict';

  const extension =
    window.TheFreshMakerV4;

  const core =
    window.BFHelper;

  if (!extension || !core) {
    console.error(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 26 requires Parts 17–25.'
    );

    return;
  }

  if (
    window.TFM_V4_PART_26_LOADED
  ) {
    console.warn(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 26 already loaded.'
    );

    return;
  }

  window.TFM_V4_PART_26_LOADED =
    true;

  const {
    eventManager,
    debugLogger,
    dbzSceneManager,
    dbzEffectLayer,
    dbzAudioManager,
    eventToast
  } = extension;

  const {
    settings,
    Disposables
  } = core;

  if (!dbzSceneManager) {
    console.error(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] DBZ scene manager was not found.'
    );

    return;
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // DEFAULTS
  // ==========================================================

  const DBZ_QUEUE_DEFAULTS = {
    enabled: true,

    maximumQueueLength: 8,

    dropFoundPriority: 10,

    claimStartPriority: 20,

    retryPriority: 30,

    successPriority: 50,

    failurePriority: 50,

    watchdogPriority: 100,

    duplicateWindowMs: 450,

    staleSceneMs: 9000,

    cancelLowerPriority: true,

    skipWhenHidden: false
  };

  function mergeQueueSettings() {
    const current =
      settings.get(
        'dbzQueue'
      ) || {};

    const merged = {
      ...DBZ_QUEUE_DEFAULTS,
      ...current
    };

    settings.set(
      'dbzQueue',
      merged
    );

    return merged;
  }

  let queueSettings =
    mergeQueueSettings();

  // ==========================================================
  // SCENE REQUEST
  // ==========================================================

  class DBZSceneRequest {
    constructor(
      type,
      payload = {},
      priority = 0
    ) {
      this.id =
        'scene_' +
        Date.now() +
        '_' +
        Math.random()
          .toString(36)
          .slice(2, 9);

      this.type =
        type;

      this.payload =
        payload;

      this.priority =
        Number(priority) ||
        0;

      this.createdAt =
        Date.now();

      this.startedAt =
        null;

      this.completedAt =
        null;

      this.cancelledAt =
        null;

      this.status =
        'queued';

      this.result =
        null;

      this.error =
        null;
    }

    markStarted() {
      this.status =
        'running';

      this.startedAt =
        Date.now();
    }

    markCompleted(
      result = null
    ) {
      this.status =
        'completed';

      this.completedAt =
        Date.now();

      this.result =
        result;
    }

    markCancelled(
      reason = 'cancelled'
    ) {
      this.status =
        'cancelled';
