      this.cancelledAt =
        Date.now();

      this.result = {
        reason
      };
    }

    markFailed(
      error
    ) {
      this.status =
        'failed';

      this.completedAt =
        Date.now();

      this.error =
        String(
          error?.message ||
          error ||
          'unknown'
        );
    }

    age() {
      return (
        Date.now() -
        this.createdAt
      );
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // SCENE QUEUE MANAGER
  // ==========================================================

  class DBZSceneQueue {
    constructor() {
      this.queue = [];

      this.current =
        null;

      this.processing =
        false;

      this.destroyed =
        false;

      this.history = [];

      this.lastRequestByType =
        new Map();

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.bindEvents();
      this.startMaintenance();
    }

    getSettings() {
      queueSettings =
        mergeQueueSettings();

      return queueSettings;
    }

    isEnabled() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const sceneSettings =
        settings.get(
          'dbzScene'
        ) || {};

      return (
        config.enabled !==
          false &&
        sceneSettings.enabled !==
          false &&
        settings.get(
          'theme'
        ) === 'dbz'
      );
    }

    getPriority(
      type
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const map = {
        dropFound:
          config.dropFoundPriority,

        claimStart:
          config.claimStartPriority,

        retry:
          config.retryPriority,

        success:
          config.successPriority,

        failure:
          config.failurePriority,

        watchdog:
          config.watchdogPriority
      };

      return Number(
        map[type]
      ) || 0;
    }

    isDuplicate(
      type
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const last =
        this.lastRequestByType
          .get(type) || 0;

      return (
        Date.now() -
          last <
        Number(
          config.duplicateWindowMs
        )
      );
    }

    rememberType(
      type
    ) {
      this.lastRequestByType
        .set(
          type,
          Date.now()
        );
    }

    trimQueue() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const maximum =
        Math.max(
          1,
          Number(
            config.maximumQueueLength
          ) || 8
        );

      if (
        this.queue.length <=
        maximum
      ) {
        return;
      }

      this.queue.sort(
        (
          first,
          second
        ) =>
          second.priority -
            first.priority ||
          first.createdAt -
            second.createdAt
      );

      const removed =
        this.queue.splice(
          maximum
        );

      removed.forEach(
        request => {
          request.markCancelled(
            'queue-trimmed'
          );

          this.recordHistory(
            request
          );
        }
      );

      if (
        removed.length > 0
      ) {
        debugLogger.warn(
          'DBZ queue trimmed.',
          {
            removed:
              removed.length
          }
        );
      }
    }

    cancelLowerPriority(
      incoming
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        config.cancelLowerPriority ===
        false
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        this.current &&
        this.current.priority <
          incoming.priority
      ) {
        this.current
          .markCancelled(
            'higher-priority-scene'
          );

        dbzSceneManager
          .cancel();

        eventManager.emit(
          'DBZ_SCENE_INTERRUPTED',
          {
            interrupted:
              this.current,
            incoming
          }
        );

        this.recordHistory(
          this.current
        );

        this.current =
          null;

        this.processing =
          false;
      }

      const kept = [];

      this.queue.forEach(
        request => {
          if (
            request.priority <
            incoming.priority
          ) {
            request.markCancelled(
              'higher-priority-queued'
            );

            this.recordHistory(
              request
            );
          } else {
            kept.push(request);
          }
        }
      );

      this.queue =
        kept;
    }

    enqueue(
      type,
      payload = {},
      priority = null
    ) {
      if (
        this.destroyed ||
        !this.isEnabled()
      ) {
        return null;
      }

      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        config.skipWhenHidden &&
        document.hidden
      ) {
        eventManager.emit(
          'DBZ_SCENE_SKIPPED',
          {
            type,
            reason:
              'page-hidden'
          }
        );

        return null;
      }

      if (
        this.isDuplicate(
          type
        )
      ) {
        eventManager.emit(
          'DBZ_SCENE_SKIPPED',
          {
            type,
            reason:
              'duplicate'
          }
        );

        return null;
      }

      this.rememberType(type);

      const request =
        new DBZSceneRequest(
          type,
          payload,
          priority ??
            this.getPriority(
              type
            )
        );

      this.cancelLowerPriority(
        request
      );

      this.queue.push(
        request
      );

      this.queue.sort(
        (
          first,
          second
        ) =>
          second.priority -
            first.priority ||
          first.createdAt -
            second.createdAt
      );

      this.trimQueue();

      eventManager.emit(
        'DBZ_SCENE_QUEUED',
        {
          request,
          queueLength:
            this.queue.length
        }
      );

      debugLogger.info(
        'DBZ scene queued.',
        {
          type,
          priority:
            request.priority,
          queueLength:
            this.queue.length
        }
      );

      this.process();

      return request;
    }

    nextRequest() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const staleMs =
        Math.max(
          1000,
          Number(
            config.staleSceneMs
          ) || 9000
        );

      while (
        this.queue.length > 0
      ) {
        const request =
          this.queue.shift();

        if (
          request.age() >
          staleMs
        ) {
          request.markCancelled(
            'stale'
          );

          this.recordHistory(
            request
          );

          eventManager.emit(
            'DBZ_SCENE_SKIPPED',
            {
              type:
                request.type,
              reason:
                'stale'
            }
          );

          continue;
        }

        return request;
      }

      return null;
    }

    async execute(
      request
    ) {
      request.markStarted();

      this.current =
        request;

      eventManager.emit(
        'DBZ_SCENE_STARTED',
        {
          request
        }
      );

      debugLogger.info(
        'DBZ scene started.',
        {
          type:
            request.type,
          id:
            request.id
        }
      );

      let result =
        null;

      switch (
        request.type
      ) {
        case 'dropFound':
          result =
            await dbzSceneManager
              .playDropFound();
          break;

        case 'claimStart':
          result =
            await dbzSceneManager
              .playClaimStart();
          break;

        case 'retry':
          if (
            dbzEffectLayer
          ) {
            dbzEffectLayer
              .cameraShake(
                0.65,
                false,
                420
              );

            dbzEffectLayer
              .centreBurst(
                16
              );
          }

          if (
            dbzAudioManager
          ) {
            dbzAudioManager
              .play(
                'blast',
                0.9
              );
          }

          result =
            true;
          break;

        case 'success':
          result =
            await dbzSceneManager
              .handleSuccess(
                request.payload
              );
          break;

        case 'failure':
          result =
            await dbzSceneManager
              .handleFailure(
                request.payload
              );
          break;

        case 'watchdog':
          dbzSceneManager
            .cancel();

          result =
            true;
          break;

        default:
          throw new Error(
            'Unknown DBZ scene type: ' +
            request.type
          );
      }

      return result;
    }

    async process() {
      if (
        this.processing ||
        this.destroyed ||
        !this.isEnabled()
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const request =
        this.nextRequest();

      if (!request) {
        return;
      }

      this.processing =
        true;

      try {
        const result =
          await this.execute(
            request
          );

        if (
          request.status !==
          'cancelled'
        ) {
          request.markCompleted(
            result
          );

          eventManager.emit(
            'DBZ_SCENE_COMPLETED',
            {
              request,
              result
            }
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        request.markFailed(
          error
        );

        debugLogger.warn(
          'DBZ queued scene failed.',
          {
            type:
              request.type,
            error
          }
        );

        eventManager.emit(
          'DBZ_SCENE_FAILED',
          {
            request,
            error:
              String(
                error?.message ||
                error
              )
          }
        );
      } finally {
        this.recordHistory(
          request
        );

        if (
          this.current ===
          request
        ) {
          this.current =
            null;
        }

        this.processing =
          false;

        setTimeout(() => {
          this.process();
        }, 30);
      }
    }

    recordHistory(
      request
    ) {
      if (!request) {
        return;
      }

      this.history.push({
        id:
          request.id,

        type:
          request.type,

        priority:
          request.priority,

        status:
          request.status,

        createdAt:
          request.createdAt,

        startedAt:
          request.startedAt,

        completedAt:
          request.completedAt,

        cancelledAt:
          request.cancelledAt,

        result:
          request.result,

        error:
          request.error
      });

      if (
        this.history.length >
        200
      ) {
        this.history.splice(
          0,
          this.history.length -
            200
        );
      }
    }

    clear(
      reason = 'manual-clear'
    ) {
      this.queue.forEach(
        request => {
          request.markCancelled(
            reason
          );

          this.recordHistory(
            request
          );
        }
      );

      this.queue = [];

      if (this.current) {
        this.current
          .markCancelled(
            reason
          );

        this.recordHistory(
          this.current
        );
      }

      this.current =
        null;

      this.processing =
        false;

      dbzSceneManager
        .cancel();

      eventManager.emit(
        'DBZ_QUEUE_CLEARED',
        {
          reason
        }
      );
    }

    snapshot() {
      return {
        enabled:
          this.isEnabled(),

        processing:
          this.processing,

        current:
          this.current
            ? {
                id:
                  this.current.id,
                type:
                  this.current.type,
                priority:
                  this.current
                    .priority,
                status:
                  this.current.status,
                age:
                  this.current.age()
              }
            : null,

        queue:
          this.queue.map(
            request => ({
              id:
                request.id,
              type:
                request.type,
              priority:
                request.priority,
              status:
                request.status,
              age:
                request.age()
            })
          ),

        historyCount:
          this.history.length
      };
    }

    startMaintenance() {
      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            if (
              this.destroyed
            ) {
              return;
            }

            const config =
              this.getSettings();

            const staleMs =
              Math.max(
                1000,
                Number(
                  config.staleSceneMs
                ) || 9000
              );

            this.queue =
              this.queue.filter(
                request => {
                  if (
                    request.age() >
                    staleMs
                  ) {
                    request
                      .markCancelled(
                        'maintenance-stale'
                      );

                    this.recordHistory(
                      request
                    );

                    return false;
                  }

                  return true;
                }
              );

            if (
              this.current &&
              this.current.startedAt &&
              Date.now() -
                this.current
                  .startedAt >
                staleMs * 1.5
            ) {
              debugLogger.warn(
                'DBZ scene queue recovered a stuck scene.',
                {
                  type:
                    this.current.type,
                  age:
                    Date.now() -
                    this.current
                      .startedAt
                }
              );

              this.clear(
                'stuck-scene'
              );

              eventToast?.show(
                'DBZ scene recovered',
                1100,
                'warning'
              );
            }
          }, 1500)
        );
    }

    bindEvents() {
      eventManager.on(
        'DROP_FOUND',
        event => {
          this.enqueue(
            'dropFound',
            event
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_START',
        event => {
          this.enqueue(
            'claimStart',
            event
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_RETRY',
        event => {
          this.enqueue(
            'retry',
            event
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
        event => {
          this.enqueue(
            'success',
            event
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_FAIL',
        event => {
          this.enqueue(
            'failure',
            event
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        event => {
          this.enqueue(
            'watchdog',
            event
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'SNIPER_TOGGLED',
        event => {
          if (
            !event.enabled
          ) {
            this.clear(
              'sniper-disabled'
            );
          }
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'PAGE_VISIBILITY_CHANGED',
        event => {
          const config =
            this.getSettings();

          if (
            config.skipWhenHidden &&
            event.hidden
          ) {
            this.clear(
              'page-hidden'
            );
          }
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'V4_DESTROYED',
        () => {
          this.destroy();
        }
      );
    }

    updateSettings(
      updates
    ) {
      queueSettings = {
        ...this.getSettings(),
        ...(updates || {})
      };

      settings.set(
        'dbzQueue',
        queueSettings
      );

      return {
        ...queueSettings
      };
    }

    destroy() {
      this.destroyed =
        true;

      this.clear(
        'destroyed'
      );

      this.disposables
        .clear();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // DISABLE DIRECT SCENE EVENT HANDLERS
  // ==========================================================

  function installQueueOwnership() {
    if (
      dbzSceneManager
        .__queueOwned
    ) {
      return;
    }

    dbzSceneManager
      .__queueOwned =
      true;

    debugLogger.info(
      'DBZ scene queue now owns scene sequencing.'
    );
  }

  installQueueOwnership();

  // ==========================================================
  // INITIALISE
  // ==========================================================

  const dbzSceneQueue =
    new DBZSceneQueue();

  extension.dbzSceneQueue =
    dbzSceneQueue;

  core.dbzSceneQueue =
    dbzSceneQueue;

  // ==========================================================
  // EVENT RESPONSES
  // ==========================================================

  eventManager.on(
    'DBZ_SCENE_SKIPPED',
    event => {
      debugLogger.info(
        'DBZ scene skipped.',
        event
      );
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'DBZ_SCENE_FAILED',
    event => {
      if (
        settings.get(
          'debugMode'
        )
      ) {
        eventToast?.show(
          `DBZ scene failed: ${event.request.type}`,
          1200,
          'warning'
        );
      }
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'DBZ_QUEUE_CLEARED',
    event => {
      debugLogger.info(
        'DBZ queue cleared.',
        event
      );
    }
  );

  // ==========================================================
  // PUBLIC COMMANDS
  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    dbzQueue: {
      status() {
        return dbzSceneQueue
          .snapshot();
      },

      settings() {
        return {
          ...dbzSceneQueue
            .getSettings()
        };
      },

      update(
        updates
      ) {
        return dbzSceneQueue
          .updateSettings(
            updates
          );
      },

      clear(
        reason =
          'manual-clear'
      ) {
        return dbzSceneQueue
          .clear(reason);
      },

      history(
        limit = 40
      ) {
        return dbzSceneQueue
          .history
          .slice(
            -Math.max(
              1,
              limit
            )
          );
      },

      test(
        type = 'success'
      ) {
        const valid = [
          'dropFound',
          'claimStart',
          'retry',
          'success',
          'failure',
          'watchdog'
        ];

        const chosen =
          valid.includes(type)
            ? type
            : 'success';

        return dbzSceneQueue
          .enqueue(
            chosen,
            {
              manual: true,
              reaction: 777,
              reason:
                'manual-test'
            }
          );
      }
    }
  };

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 26 loaded successfully.',
    {
      maximumQueueLength:
        queueSettings
          .maximumQueueLength,

      cancelLowerPriority:
        queueSettings
          .cancelLowerPriority
    }
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_PART_26_READY',
    {
      dbzSceneQueue,
      settings: {
        ...queueSettings
      }
    }
  );
})();
// ============================================================
// THEFRESHMAKER v4 OPTIONAL VISUAL EXTENSION
// Part 27
// DBZ performance governor, mobile mode, adaptive particle
// limits, frame-rate monitoring and low-power recovery.
// Paste directly after Part 26.
// ============================================================

(function TheFreshMakerV4Part27() {
  'use strict';

  const extension =
    window.TheFreshMakerV4;

  const core =
    window.BFHelper;

  if (!extension || !core) {
    console.error(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 27 requires Parts 17–26.'
    );

    return;
  }

  if (
    window.TFM_V4_PART_27_LOADED
  ) {
    console.warn(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 27 already loaded.'
    );

    return;
  }

  window.TFM_V4_PART_27_LOADED =
    true;

  const {
    eventManager,
    debugLogger,
    dbzEffectLayer,
    dbzSceneQueue,
    dbzSceneManager,
    eventToast
  } = extension;

  const {
    settings,
    Disposables
  } = core;

  // ==========================================================
  // DEFAULTS
  // ==========================================================

  const PERFORMANCE_DEFAULTS = {
    enabled: true,

    adaptiveMode: true,

    targetFps: 50,

    lowFpsThreshold: 35,

    criticalFpsThreshold: 22,

    recoveryFpsThreshold: 48,

    sampleWindow: 90,

    lowFpsSamplesRequired: 3,

    recoverySamplesRequired: 4,

    mobileMode: 'auto',

    pauseEffectsWhenHidden: true,

    reduceEffectsOnBattery: true,

    mobileParticleMultiplier: 0.55,

    lowPowerParticleMultiplier: 0.4,

    criticalParticleMultiplier: 0.2,

    normalParticleMultiplier: 1,

    disableCameraShakeCritical: true,

    disableAuraCritical: true,

    disableSceneSoundsCritical: false,

    currentMode: 'normal',

    lastMeasuredFps: null,

    lastModeChangeAt: null
  };

  function mergePerformanceSettings() {
    const current =
      settings.get(
        'dbzPerformance'
      ) || {};

    const merged = {
      ...PERFORMANCE_DEFAULTS,
      ...current
    };

    settings.set(
      'dbzPerformance',
      merged
    );

    return merged;
  }

  let performanceSettings =
    mergePerformanceSettings();

  // ==========================================================
  // DEVICE HELPERS
  // ==========================================================

  function isMobileDevice() {
    const coarsePointer =
      window.matchMedia?.(
        '(pointer: coarse)'
      )?.matches;

    const narrowScreen =
      Math.min(
        window.innerWidth,
        window.innerHeight
      ) < 700;

    const userAgentMobile =
      /android|iphone|ipad|ipod|mobile/i
        .test(
          navigator.userAgent ||
          ''
        );

    return Boolean(
      coarsePointer ||
      narrowScreen ||
      userAgentMobile
    );
  }

  function getHardwareScore() {
    const cores =
      Number(
        navigator.hardwareConcurrency
      ) || 4;

    const memory =
      Number(
        navigator.deviceMemory
      ) || 4;

    const width =
      window.screen?.width ||
      window.innerWidth ||
      1280;

    const height =
      window.screen?.height ||
      window.innerHeight ||
      720;

    const pixels =
      width * height;

    let score = 0;

    score +=
      Math.min(
        8,
        cores
      );

    score +=
      Math.min(
        8,
        memory
      );

    if (
      pixels <=
      1280 * 720
    ) {
      score += 3;
    } else if (
      pixels <=
      1920 * 1080
    ) {
      score += 2;
    } else {
      score += 1;
    }

    return score;
  }

  function shouldUseMobileMode() {
    const config =
      mergePerformanceSettings();

    if (
      config.mobileMode ===
      'on'
    ) {
      return true;
    }

    if (
      config.mobileMode ===
      'off'
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    return isMobileDevice();
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // FRAME RATE MONITOR
  // ==========================================================

  class FrameRateMonitor {
    constructor(
      onSample
    ) {
      this.onSample =
        onSample;

      this.running =
        false;

      this.frameTimes =
        [];

      this.lastFrameTime =
        0;

      this.animationFrameId =
        null;

      this.sampleStartedAt =
        0;

      this.sampleFrames =
        0;

      this.start();
    }

    start() {
      if (this.running) {
        return;
      }

      this.running =
        true;

      this.lastFrameTime =
        performance.now();

      this.sampleStartedAt =
        performance.now();

      this.sampleFrames =
        0;

      const tick =
        currentTime => {
          if (!this.running) {
            return;
          }

          const delta =
            currentTime -
            this.lastFrameTime;

          this.lastFrameTime =
            currentTime;

          if (
            delta > 0 &&
            delta < 1000
          ) {
            this.frameTimes.push(
              delta
            );
          }

          const config =
            mergePerformanceSettings();

          const maximumSamples =
            Math.max(
              30,
              Number(
                config.sampleWindow
              ) || 90
            );

          if (
            this.frameTimes.length >
            maximumSamples
          ) {
            this.frameTimes.splice(
              0,
              this.frameTimes.length -
                maximumSamples
            );
          }

          this.sampleFrames += 1;

          const sampleElapsed =
            currentTime -
            this.sampleStartedAt;

          if (
            sampleElapsed >= 2000
          ) {
            const fps =
              this.calculateFps();

            this.onSample?.(
              fps,
              {
                frameCount:
                  this.sampleFrames,

                elapsed:
                  sampleElapsed,

                averageFrameTime:
                  this.averageFrameTime()
              }
            );

            this.sampleStartedAt =
              currentTime;

            this.sampleFrames =
              0;
          }

          this.animationFrameId =
            requestAnimationFrame(
              tick
            );
        };

      this.animationFrameId =
        requestAnimationFrame(
          tick
        );
    }

    averageFrameTime() {
      if (
        this.frameTimes.length ===
        0
      ) {
        return 0;
      }

      const total =
        this.frameTimes.reduce(
          (
            sum,
            value
          ) =>
            sum +
            value,
          0
        );

      return (
        total /
        this.frameTimes.length
      );
    }

    calculateFps() {
      const average =
        this.averageFrameTime();

      if (!average) {
        return 60;
      }

      return Math.max(
        1,
        Math.min(
          240,
          Math.round(
            1000 /
            average
          )
        )
      );
    }

    stop() {
      this.running =
        false;

      if (
        this.animationFrameId
      ) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(
          this.animationFrameId
        );
      }

      this.animationFrameId =
        null;
    }

    reset() {
      this.frameTimes =
        [];

      this.sampleStartedAt =
        performance.now();

      this.sampleFrames =
        0;
    }

    destroy() {
      this.stop();
      this.frameTimes = [];
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // PERFORMANCE GOVERNOR
  // ==========================================================

  class DBZPerformanceGovernor {
    constructor() {
      this.mode =
        'normal';

      this.previousMode =
        null;

      this.lowFpsCounter =
        0;

      this.recoveryCounter =
        0;

      this.lastFps =
        null;

      this.mobile =
        shouldUseMobileMode();

      this.hardwareScore =
        getHardwareScore();

      this.battery =
        null;

      this.originalEffectSettings =
        null;

      this.originalAudioSettings =
        null;

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.frameMonitor =
        new FrameRateMonitor(
          (
            fps,
            metadata
          ) => {
            this.handleFpsSample(
              fps,
              metadata
            );
          }
        );

      this.initializeBattery();
      this.bindEvents();
      this.applyInitialMode();
    }

    getSettings() {
      performanceSettings =
        mergePerformanceSettings();

      return performanceSettings;
    }

    async initializeBattery() {
      if (
        !navigator.getBattery
      ) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        this.battery =
          await navigator
            .getBattery();

        const update =
          () => {
            this.evaluateBattery();
          };

        this.battery
          .addEventListener(
            'levelchange',
            update
          );

        this.battery
          .addEventListener(
            'chargingchange',
            update
          );

        this.disposables
          .listeners
          .push({
            el:
              this.battery,
            event:
              'levelchange',
            fn:
              update,
            options:
              undefined
          });

        this.disposables
          .listeners
          .push({
            el:
              this.battery,
            event:
              'chargingchange',
            fn:
              update,
            options:
              undefined
          });

        this.evaluateBattery();
      } catch (error) {
        debugLogger.info(
          'Battery API unavailable.',
          error
        );
      }
    }

    evaluateBattery() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        !this.battery ||
        config.reduceEffectsOnBattery ===
          false
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const lowBattery =
        this.battery.level <=
          0.2 &&
        !this.battery.charging;

      if (
        lowBattery &&
        this.mode === 'normal'
      ) {
        this.setMode(
          'low-power',
          'low-battery'
        );
      }

      if (
        !lowBattery &&
        this.mode ===
          'low-power' &&
        this.lastFps >=
          config.recoveryFpsThreshold
      ) {
        this.setMode(
          this.mobile
            ? 'mobile'
            : 'normal',
          'battery-recovered'
        );
      }
    }

    applyInitialMode() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const savedMode =
        String(
          config.currentMode ||
          'normal'
        );

      if (
        savedMode ===
        'critical'
      ) {
        this.setMode(
          'low-power',
          'startup-recovery'
        );

        return;
      }

      if (
        this.mobile
      ) {
        this.setMode(
          'mobile',
          'mobile-device'
        );

        return;
      }

      if (
        this.hardwareScore <
        9
      ) {
        this.setMode(
          'low-power',
          'limited-hardware'
        );

        return;
      }

      this.setMode(
        'normal',
        'startup'
      );
    }

    handleFpsSample(
      fps,
      metadata = {}
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      this.lastFps =
        fps;

      performanceSettings.lastMeasuredFps =
        fps;

      settings.set(
        'dbzPerformance',
        {
          ...performanceSettings,
          lastMeasuredFps:
            fps
        }
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'DBZ_FPS_SAMPLE',
        {
          fps,
          mode:
            this.mode,
          metadata
        }
      );

      if (
        config.enabled ===
          false ||
        config.adaptiveMode ===
          false ||
        document.hidden
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        fps <=
        config.criticalFpsThreshold
      ) {
        this.lowFpsCounter +=
          2;

        this.recoveryCounter =
          0;
      } else if (
        fps <=
        config.lowFpsThreshold
      ) {
        this.lowFpsCounter +=
          1;

        this.recoveryCounter =
          0;
      } else if (
        fps >=
        config.recoveryFpsThreshold
      ) {
        this.recoveryCounter +=
          1;

        this.lowFpsCounter =
          Math.max(
            0,
            this.lowFpsCounter -
              1
          );
      } else {
        this.lowFpsCounter =
          Math.max(
            0,
            this.lowFpsCounter -
              1
          );

        this.recoveryCounter =
          Math.max(
            0,
            this.recoveryCounter -
              1
          );
      }

      const lowRequired =
        Math.max(
          1,
          Number(
            config.lowFpsSamplesRequired
          ) || 3
        );

      const recoveryRequired =
        Math.max(
          1,
          Number(
            config.recoverySamplesRequired
          ) || 4
        );

      if (
        this.lowFpsCounter >=
          lowRequired * 2
      ) {
        this.setMode(
          'critical',
          'critical-fps'
        );

        this.lowFpsCounter =
          0;

        return;
      }

      if (
        this.lowFpsCounter >=
          lowRequired
      ) {
        if (
          this.mode ===
          'normal' ||
          this.mode ===
          'mobile'
        ) {
          this.setMode(
            'low-power',
            'low-fps'
          );
        }

        this.lowFpsCounter =
          0;

        return;
      }

      if (
        this.recoveryCounter >=
          recoveryRequired
      ) {
        if (
          this.mode ===
          'critical'
        ) {
          this.setMode(
            'low-power',
            'fps-partial-recovery'
          );
        } else if (
          this.mode ===
          'low-power'
        ) {
          this.setMode(
            this.mobile
              ? 'mobile'
              : 'normal',
            'fps-recovered'
          );
        }

        this.recoveryCounter =
          0;
      }
    }

    getParticleMultiplier(
      mode
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      switch (mode) {
        case 'mobile':
          return Number(
            config
              .mobileParticleMultiplier
          ) || 0.55;

        case 'low-power':
          return Number(
            config
              .lowPowerParticleMultiplier
          ) || 0.4;

        case 'critical':
          return Number(
            config
              .criticalParticleMultiplier
          ) || 0.2;

        default:
          return Number(
            config
              .normalParticleMultiplier
          ) || 1;
      }
    }

    captureOriginalSettings() {
      if (
        !this.originalEffectSettings &&
        dbzEffectLayer
      ) {
        this.originalEffectSettings = {
          ...dbzEffectLayer
            .getSettings()
        };
      }

      if (
        !this.originalAudioSettings &&
        extension.dbzAudioManager
      ) {
        this.originalAudioSettings = {
          ...extension
            .dbzAudioManager
            .getSettings()
        };
      }
    }

    applyEffectProfile(
      mode
    ) {
      this.captureOriginalSettings();

      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const multiplier =
        this.getParticleMultiplier(
          mode
        );

      const currentEffects =
        dbzEffectLayer
          ?.getSettings?.() ||
        {};

      const baseParticles =
        Number(
          this.originalEffectSettings
            ?.particleAmount ||
          currentEffects
            .particleAmount ||
          22
        );

      const updates = {
        particleAmount:
          Math.max(
            4,
            Math.round(
              baseParticles *
              multiplier
            )
          )
      };

      if (
        mode === 'critical'
      ) {
        if (
          config.disableCameraShakeCritical
        ) {
          updates.cameraShake =
            false;
        }

        if (
          config.disableAuraCritical
        ) {
          updates.auraParticles =
            false;
        }

        updates.energyParticles =
          false;
      } else if (
        mode === 'low-power'
      ) {
        updates.cameraShake =
          true;

        updates.auraParticles =
          false;

        updates.energyParticles =
          true;
      } else if (
        mode === 'mobile'
      ) {
        updates.cameraShake =
          true;

        updates.auraParticles =
          true;

        updates.energyParticles =
          true;
      } else {
        updates.cameraShake =
          this.originalEffectSettings
            ?.cameraShake !==
            false;

        updates.auraParticles =
          this.originalEffectSettings
            ?.auraParticles !==
            false;

        updates.energyParticles =
          this.originalEffectSettings
            ?.energyParticles !==
            false;
      }

      dbzEffectLayer
        ?.updateSettings?.(
          updates
        );

      if (
        extension.dbzAudioManager
      ) {
        const audioUpdates = {};

        if (
          mode === 'critical' &&
          config.disableSceneSoundsCritical
        ) {
          audioUpdates.enabled =
            false;
        } else if (
          this.originalAudioSettings
        ) {
          audioUpdates.enabled =
            this.originalAudioSettings
              .enabled !==
            false;
        }

        if (
          Object.keys(
            audioUpdates
          ).length
        ) {
          extension
            .dbzAudioManager
            .update(
              audioUpdates
            );
        }
      }
    }

    setMode(
      mode,
      reason = 'manual'
    ) {
      const validModes = [
        'normal',
        'mobile',
        'low-power',
        'critical',
        'paused'
      ];

      const nextMode =
        validModes.includes(
          mode
        )
          ? mode
          : 'normal';

      if (
        this.mode ===
        nextMode
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      const previousMode =
        this.mode;

      this.previousMode =
        previousMode;

      this.mode =
        nextMode;

      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      performanceSettings = {
        ...config,
        currentMode:
          nextMode,
        lastModeChangeAt:
          Date.now()
      };

      settings.set(
        'dbzPerformance',
        performanceSettings
      );

      if (
        nextMode === 'paused'
      ) {
        dbzSceneQueue
          ?.clear?.(
            'performance-paused'
          );

        dbzSceneManager
          ?.cancel?.();

        dbzEffectLayer
          ?.clearParticles?.();
      } else {
        this.applyEffectProfile(
          nextMode
        );
      }

      debugLogger.info(
        `DBZ performance mode: ${previousMode} → ${nextMode}`,
        {
          reason,
          fps:
            this.lastFps,
          mobile:
            this.mobile,
          hardwareScore:
            this.hardwareScore
        }
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'DBZ_PERFORMANCE_MODE_CHANGED',
        {
          previousMode,
          mode:
            nextMode,
          reason,
          fps:
            this.lastFps,
          mobile:
            this.mobile,
          hardwareScore:
            this.hardwareScore
        }
      );

      return true;
    }

    pauseForVisibility() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        config.pauseEffectsWhenHidden ===
          false
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        document.hidden
      ) {
        if (
          this.mode !==
          'paused'
        ) {
          this.previousMode =
            this.mode;

          this.setMode(
            'paused',
            'page-hidden'
          );
        }
      } else if (
        this.mode ===
        'paused'
      ) {
        this.setMode(
          this.previousMode ||
          (
            this.mobile
              ? 'mobile'
              : 'normal'
          ),
          'page-visible'
        );

        this.frameMonitor
          .reset();
      }
    }

    bindEvents() {
      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'visibilitychange',
          () => {
            this.pauseForVisibility();
          }
        );

      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          window,
          'resize',
          () => {
            const wasMobile =
              this.mobile;

            this.mobile =
              shouldUseMobileMode();

            if (
              wasMobile !==
              this.mobile
            ) {
              this.setMode(
                this.mobile
                  ? 'mobile'
                  : 'normal',
                'viewport-changed'
              );
            }
          }
        );

      eventManager.on(
        'DBZ_SCENE_STARTED',
        () => {
          if (
            this.mode ===
            'critical'
          ) {
            dbzEffectLayer
              ?.clearParticles?.();
          }
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'DBZ_SCENE_COMPLETED',
        () => {
          if (
            this.lastFps !==
              null &&
            this.lastFps <
              this.getSettings()
                .criticalFpsThreshold
          ) {
            this.setMode(
              'critical',
              'post-scene-fps'
            );
          }
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        () => {
          this.setMode(
            'low-power',
            'watchdog-reset'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'V4_DESTROYED',
        () => {
          this.destroy();
        }
      );
    }

    snapshot() {
      return {
        mode:
          this.mode,

        previousMode:
          this.previousMode,

        fps:
          this.lastFps,

        mobile:
          this.mobile,

        hardwareScore:
          this.hardwareScore,

        battery:
          this.battery
            ? {
                level:
                  this.battery
                    .level,

                charging:
                  this.battery
                    .charging
              }
            : null,

        lowFpsCounter:
          this.lowFpsCounter,

        recoveryCounter:
          this.recoveryCounter,

        settings:
          {
            ...this.getSettings()
          }
      };
    }

    updateSettings(
      updates
    ) {
      performanceSettings = {
        ...this.getSettings(),
        ...(updates || {})
      };

      settings.set(
        'dbzPerformance',
        performanceSettings
      );

      this.mobile =
        shouldUseMobileMode();

      this.applyEffectProfile(
        this.mode
      );

      return {
        ...performanceSettings
      };
    }

    forceMode(
      mode
    ) {
      return this.setMode(
        mode,
        'manual'
      );
    }

    recover() {
      this.lowFpsCounter =
        0;

      this.recoveryCounter =
        0;

      this.frameMonitor
        .reset();

      this.mobile =
        shouldUseMobileMode();

      this.setMode(
        this.mobile
          ? 'mobile'
          : 'normal',
        'manual-recovery'
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'DBZ_PERFORMANCE_RECOVERED'
      );

      return this.snapshot();
    }

    destroy() {
      this.frameMonitor
        .destroy();

      this.disposables
        .clear();

      dbzEffectLayer
        ?.clearParticles?.();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // PERFORMANCE STATUS BADGE
  // ==========================================================

  class PerformanceBadge {
    constructor(
      governor
    ) {
      this.governor =
        governor;

      this.element =
        null;

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      if (window.TFM_PILL_ONLY_MODE) return;

      this.create();
      this.bind();
    }

    create() {
      const existing =
        document.getElementById(
          'tfm-performance-badge'
        );

      if (existing) {
        existing.remove();
      }

      const badge =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      badge.id =
        'tfm-performance-badge';

      badge.style.cssText = `
        position:fixed;
        right:14px;
        top:14px;
        min-width:86px;
        padding:7px 9px;
        border-radius:9px;
        background:
          rgba(8,12,16,0.9);
        border:
          1px solid
          rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
        color:#dffbf7;
        font:
          800 10px/1.25
          ui-monospace,
          SFMono-Regular,
          Menlo,
          Consolas,
          monospace;
        text-align:center;
        pointer-events:none;
        user-select:none;
        z-index:2147483643;
        box-shadow:
          0 8px 24px
          rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
        backdrop-filter:
          blur(7px);
        opacity:0.88;
      `;

      document.body
        .appendChild(
          badge
        );

      this.element =
        badge;

      this.render();
    }

    render() {
      if (!this.element) {
        return;
      }

      const state =
        this.governor
          .snapshot();

      const modeLabels = {
        normal:
          'NORMAL',

        mobile:
          'MOBILE',

        'low-power':
          'LOW POWER',

        critical:
          'CRITICAL',

        paused:
          'PAUSED'
      };

      const colours = {
        normal:
          '#72ffd8',

        mobile:
          '#91d7ff',

        'low-power':
          '#ffd37d',

        critical:
          '#ff8d8d',

        paused:
          '#b4b4b4'
      };

      this.element
        .style.borderColor =
        colours[
          state.mode
        ] || '#fff';

      this.element
        .style.color =
        colours[
          state.mode
        ] || '#fff';

      this.element
        .innerHTML =
        `${modeLabels[
          state.mode
        ] || state.mode}<br>` +
        `${
          state.fps === null
            ? '--'
            : state.fps
        } FPS`;

      const visuals =
        settings.get(
          'visuals'
        ) || {};

      this.element
        .style.display =
        visuals.enabled ===
          false
          ? 'none'
          : 'block';
    }

    bind() {
      eventManager.on(
        'DBZ_FPS_SAMPLE',
        () => {
          this.render();
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'DBZ_PERFORMANCE_MODE_CHANGED',
        event => {
          this.render();

          if (
            event.mode ===
            'critical'
          ) {
            eventToast?.show(
              '⚠️ DBZ effects reduced',
              1200,
              'warning'
            );
          }

          if (
            event.mode ===
              'normal' &&
            event.previousMode !==
              null
          ) {
            eventToast?.show(
              '✓ DBZ performance restored',
              1100,
              'success'
            );
          }
        }
      );

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            this.render();
          }, 2000)
        );
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables
        .clear();

      this.element
        ?.remove();

      this.element =
        null;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // INITIALISE
  // ==========================================================

  const dbzPerformanceGovernor =
    new DBZPerformanceGovernor();

  const performanceBadge =
    new PerformanceBadge(
      dbzPerformanceGovernor
    );

  extension.dbzPerformanceGovernor =
    dbzPerformanceGovernor;

  extension.performanceBadge =
    performanceBadge;

  core.dbzPerformanceGovernor =
    dbzPerformanceGovernor;

  core.performanceBadge =
    performanceBadge;

  // ==========================================================
  // PUBLIC COMMANDS
  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    performance: {
      status() {
        return dbzPerformanceGovernor
          .snapshot();
      },

      settings() {
        return {
          ...dbzPerformanceGovernor
            .getSettings()
        };
      },

      update(
        updates
      ) {
        return dbzPerformanceGovernor
          .updateSettings(
            updates
          );
      },

      normal() {
        return dbzPerformanceGovernor
          .forceMode(
            'normal'
          );
      },

      mobile() {
        return dbzPerformanceGovernor
          .forceMode(
            'mobile'
          );
      },

      lowPower() {
        return dbzPerformanceGovernor
          .forceMode(
            'low-power'
          );
      },

      critical() {
        return dbzPerformanceGovernor
          .forceMode(
            'critical'
          );
      },

      recover() {
        return dbzPerformanceGovernor
          .recover();
      }
    }
  };

  eventManager.on(
    'V4_DESTROYED',
    () => {
      performanceBadge
        .destroy();

      dbzPerformanceGovernor
        .destroy();
    }
  );

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 27 loaded successfully.',
    {
      mobile:
        dbzPerformanceGovernor
          .mobile,

      hardwareScore:
        dbzPerformanceGovernor
          .hardwareScore,

      initialMode:
        dbzPerformanceGovernor
          .mode
    }
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_PART_27_READY',
    {
      dbzPerformanceGovernor,
      performanceBadge
    }
  );
})();

// THEFRESHMAKER v4 OPTIONAL VISUAL EXTENSION
// Part 28
// Session analytics, claim timeline, performance summaries,
// CSV/JSON export and advanced statistics panel.
// Paste directly after Part 27.

(function TheFreshMakerV4Part28() {
  'use strict';

  const extension =
    window.TheFreshMakerV4;

  const core =
    window.BFHelper;

  if (!extension || !core) {
    console.error(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 28 requires Parts 17–27.'
    );

    return;
  }

  if (
    window.TFM_V4_PART_28_LOADED
  ) {
    console.warn(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 28 already loaded.'
    );

    return;
  }

  window.TFM_V4_PART_28_LOADED =
    true;

  const {
    eventManager,
    debugLogger,
    statsManager,
    eventHistory,
    eventToast
  } = extension;

  const {
    settings,
    Storage,
    Disposables
  } = core;

  // ==========================================================
  // DEFAULTS
  // ==========================================================

  const ANALYTICS_DEFAULTS = {
    enabled: true,

    maximumRecords: 1000,

    persistTimeline: true,

    showAdvancedPanel: false,

    autoSnapshotIntervalMs:
      5 * 60 * 1000,

    reactionBuckets: [
      300,
      500,
      750,
      1000,
      1250,
      1500,
      2000,
      3000
    ]
  };

  function mergeAnalyticsSettings() {
    const current =
      settings.get(
        'analytics'
      ) || {};

    const merged = {
      ...ANALYTICS_DEFAULTS,
      ...current
    };

    settings.set(
      'analytics',
      merged
    );

    return merged;
  }

  let analyticsSettings =
    mergeAnalyticsSettings();

  // ==========================================================
  // UTILITIES
  // ==========================================================

  function cloneValue(
    value
  ) {
    try {
      return structuredClone(
        value
      );
    } catch (error) {
      return JSON.parse(
        JSON.stringify(
          value
        )
      );
    }
  }

  function average(
    values
  ) {
    if (
      !Array.isArray(values) ||
      values.length === 0
    ) {
      return 0;
    }

    return (
      values.reduce(
        (
          total,
          value
        ) =>
          total +
          Number(value || 0),
        0
      ) /
      values.length
    );
  }

  function median(
    values
  ) {
    if (
      !Array.isArray(values) ||
      values.length === 0
    ) {
      return 0;
    }

    const sorted =
      values
        .map(Number)
        .filter(
          Number.isFinite
        )
        .sort(
          (
            first,
            second
          ) =>
            first - second
        );

    if (
      sorted.length === 0
    ) {
      return 0;
    }

    const middle =
      Math.floor(
        sorted.length / 2
      );

    if (
      sorted.length % 2
    ) {
      return sorted[
        middle
      ];
    }

    return (
      sorted[
        middle - 1
      ] +
      sorted[
        middle
      ]
    ) / 2;
  }

  function percentile(
    values,
    percentileValue
  ) {
    if (
      !Array.isArray(values) ||
      values.length === 0
    ) {
      return 0;
    }

    const sorted =
      values
        .map(Number)
        .filter(
          Number.isFinite
        )
        .sort(
          (
            first,
            second
          ) =>
            first - second
        );

    if (
      sorted.length === 0
    ) {
      return 0;
    }

    const index =
      Math.min(
        sorted.length - 1,
        Math.max(
          0,
          Math.ceil(
            (
              percentileValue /
              100
            ) *
            sorted.length
          ) - 1
        )
      );

    return sorted[index];
  }

  function standardDeviation(
    values
  ) {
    if (
      !Array.isArray(values) ||
      values.length < 2
    ) {
      return 0;
    }

    const mean =
      average(values);

    const variance =
      average(
        values.map(
          value =>
            Math.pow(
              Number(value) -
              mean,
              2
            )
        )
      );

    return Math.sqrt(
      variance
    );
  }

  function escapeCsv(
    value
  ) {
    const text =
      String(
        value ??
        ''
      );

    if (
      /[",\n\r]/.test(
        text
      )
    ) {
      return (
        '"' +
        text.replace(
          /"/g,
          '""'
        ) +
        '"'
      );
    }

    return text;
  }

  function downloadText(
    filename,
    text,
    mimeType
  ) {
    const blob =
      new Blob(
        [text],
        {
          type:
            mimeType ||
            'text/plain'
        }
      );

    const url =
      URL.createObjectURL(
        blob
      );

    const anchor =
      document.createElement(
        'a'
      );

    anchor.href =
      url;

    anchor.download =
      filename;

    document.body
      .appendChild(
        anchor
      );

    anchor.click();
    anchor.remove();

    setTimeout(() => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(
        url
      );
    }, 1000);
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // CLAIM RECORD
  // ==========================================================

  class ClaimRecord {
    constructor(
      data = {}
    ) {
      this.id =
        data.id ||
        (
          'claim_' +
          Date.now() +
          '_' +
          Math.random()
            .toString(36)
            .slice(2, 8)
        );

      this.detectedAt =
        data.detectedAt ||
        null;

      this.claimStartedAt =
        data.claimStartedAt ||
        null;

      this.clickedAt =
        data.clickedAt ||
        null;

      this.completedAt =
        data.completedAt ||
        null;

      this.reaction =
        data.reaction ??
        null;

      this.result =
        data.result ||
        'pending';

      this.reason =
        data.reason ||
        null;

      this.signal =
        data.signal ||
        null;

      this.retryUsed =
        Boolean(
          data.retryUsed
        );

      this.profile =
        data.profile ||
        null;

      this.detectionMethod =
        data.detectionMethod ||
        null;

      this.score =
        data.score ??
        null;

      this.red =
        Boolean(
          data.red
        );

      this.page =
        data.page ||
        window.location.href;

      this.sessionId =
        data.sessionId ||
        null;
    }

    duration() {
      if (
        !this.detectedAt ||
        !this.completedAt
      ) {
        return null;
      }

      return (
        this.completedAt -
        this.detectedAt
      );
    }

    toJSON() {
      return {
        id:
          this.id,

        detectedAt:
          this.detectedAt,

        claimStartedAt:
          this.claimStartedAt,

        clickedAt:
          this.clickedAt,

        completedAt:
          this.completedAt,

        reaction:
          this.reaction,

        result:
          this.result,

        reason:
          this.reason,

        signal:
          this.signal,

        retryUsed:
          this.retryUsed,

        profile:
          this.profile,

        detectionMethod:
          this.detectionMethod,

        score:
          this.score,

        red:
          this.red,

        page:
          this.page,

        sessionId:
          this.sessionId
      };
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // ANALYTICS MANAGER
  // ==========================================================

  class AnalyticsManager {
    constructor() {
      this.sessionId =
        'session_' +
        Date.now() +
        '_' +
        Math.random()
          .toString(36)
          .slice(2, 8);

      this.records =
        [];

      this.current =
        null;

      this.snapshots =
        [];

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.load();
      this.bindEvents();
      this.startSnapshots();
    }

    getSettings() {
      analyticsSettings =
        mergeAnalyticsSettings();

      return analyticsSettings;
    }

    isEnabled() {
      return (
        this.getSettings()
          .enabled !==
        false
      );
    }

    load() {
      const stored =
        Storage.get(
          'bf_analyticsTimeline',
          []
        );

      if (
        Array.isArray(
          stored
        )
      ) {
        this.records =
          stored.map(
            record =>
              new ClaimRecord(
                record
              )
          );
      }

      const storedSnapshots =
        Storage.get(
          'bf_analyticsSnapshots',
          []
        );

      if (
        Array.isArray(
          storedSnapshots
        )
      ) {
        this.snapshots =
          storedSnapshots;
      }

      this.trim();
    }

    persist() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        config.persistTimeline ===
        false
      ) {
        return;
      }

      Storage.set(
        'bf_analyticsTimeline',
        this.records.map(
          record =>
            record.toJSON()
        )
      );

      Storage.set(
        'bf_analyticsSnapshots',
        this.snapshots
      );
    }

    trim() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      const maximum =
        Math.max(
          50,
          Number(
            config.maximumRecords
          ) || 1000
        );

      if (
        this.records.length >
        maximum
      ) {
        this.records.splice(
          0,
          this.records.length -
            maximum
        );
      }

      if (
        this.snapshots.length >
        500
      ) {
        this.snapshots.splice(
          0,
          this.snapshots.length -
            500
        );
      }
    }

    beginRecord(
      event
    ) {
      if (
        !this.isEnabled()
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        this.current &&
        this.current.result ===
          'pending'
      ) {
        this.current.result =
          'abandoned';

        this.current.reason =
          'new-drop-detected';

        this.current.completedAt =
          Date.now();

        this.records.push(
          this.current
        );
      }

      this.current =
        new ClaimRecord({
          detectedAt:
            Date.now(),

          result:
            'pending',

          profile:
            settings.get(
              'profile'
            ) || 'normal',

          detectionMethod:
            event
              .detectionMethod ||
            null,

          score:
            event.score,

          red:
            event.red,

          sessionId:
            this.sessionId
        });

      eventManager.emit(
        'ANALYTICS_RECORD_STARTED',
        {
          record:
            cloneValue(
              this.current
                .toJSON()
            )
        }
      );
    }

    markClaimStarted() {
      if (!this.current) {
        return;
      }

      this.current
        .claimStartedAt =
        Date.now();
    }

    markClicked() {
      if (!this.current) {
        return;
      }

      this.current.clickedAt =
        Date.now();
    }

    completeSuccess(
      event
    ) {
      if (!this.current) {
        this.current =
          new ClaimRecord({
            sessionId:
              this.sessionId
          });
      }

      this.current.result =
        'success';

      this.current.completedAt =
        Date.now();

      this.current.reaction =
        Number(
          event.reaction
        ) || null;

      this.current.signal =
        event.signal ||
        null;

      this.current.retryUsed =
        Boolean(
          event.retryUsed
        );

      this.records.push(
        this.current
      );

      const completed =
        this.current;

      this.current =
        null;

      this.trim();
      this.persist();

      eventManager.emit(
        'ANALYTICS_RECORD_COMPLETED',
        {
          record:
            cloneValue(
              completed.toJSON()
            )
        }
      );
    }

    completeFailure(
      event
    ) {
      if (!this.current) {
        this.current =
          new ClaimRecord({
            sessionId:
              this.sessionId
          });
      }

      this.current.result =
        'failure';

      this.current.completedAt =
        Date.now();

      this.current.reason =
        event.reason ||
        'unknown';

      this.current.retryUsed =
        Boolean(
          event.retryUsed
        );

      this.records.push(
        this.current
      );

      const completed =
        this.current;

      this.current =
        null;

      this.trim();
      this.persist();

      eventManager.emit(
        'ANALYTICS_RECORD_COMPLETED',
        {
          record:
            cloneValue(
              completed.toJSON()
            )
        }
      );
    }

    successfulRecords() {
      return this.records.filter(
        record =>
          record.result ===
          'success'
      );
    }

    failedRecords() {
      return this.records.filter(
        record =>
          record.result ===
          'failure'
      );
    }

    reactions() {
      return this
        .successfulRecords()
        .map(
          record =>
            Number(
              record.reaction
            )
        )
        .filter(
          value =>
            Number.isFinite(
              value
            ) &&
            value >= 0
        );
    }

    profileSummary() {
      const summary = {};

      this.records.forEach(
        record => {
          const profile =
            record.profile ||
            'unknown';

          if (!summary[profile]) {
            summary[profile] = {
              total: 0,
              success: 0,
              failure: 0,
              reactions: []
            };
          }

          summary[
            profile
          ].total += 1;

          if (
            record.result ===
            'success'
          ) {
            summary[
              profile
            ].success += 1;

            if (
              Number.isFinite(
                Number(
                  record.reaction
                )
              )
            ) {
              summary[
                profile
              ].reactions.push(
                Number(
                  record.reaction
                )
              );
            }
          }

          if (
            record.result ===
            'failure'
          ) {
            summary[
              profile
            ].failure += 1;
          }
        }
      );

      Object.values(
        summary
      ).forEach(
        data => {
          data.successRate =
            data.total
              ? Number(
                  (
                    data.success /
                    data.total *
                    100
                  ).toFixed(2)
                )
              : 0;

          data.averageReaction =
            Math.round(
              average(
                data.reactions
              )
            );

          data.fastestReaction =
            data.reactions.length
              ? Math.min(
                  ...data.reactions
                )
              : null;

          delete data.reactions;
        }
      );

      return summary;
    }

    detectionSummary() {
      const summary = {};

      this.records.forEach(
        record => {
          const method =
            record
              .detectionMethod ||
            'unknown';

          if (!summary[method]) {
            summary[method] = {
              total: 0,
              success: 0,
              failure: 0
            };
          }

          summary[
            method
          ].total += 1;

          if (
            record.result ===
            'success'
          ) {
            summary[
              method
            ].success += 1;
          }

          if (
            record.result ===
            'failure'
          ) {
            summary[
              method
            ].failure += 1;
          }
        }
      );

      Object.values(
        summary
      ).forEach(
        data => {
          data.successRate =
            data.total
              ? Number(
                  (
                    data.success /
                    data.total *
                    100
                  ).toFixed(2)
                )
              : 0;
        }
      );

      return summary;
    }

    buildReactionHistogram() {
      const buckets =
        this.getSettings()
          .reactionBuckets ||
        ANALYTICS_DEFAULTS
          .reactionBuckets;

      const histogram = {};

      buckets.forEach(
        bucket => {
          histogram[
            `≤${bucket}ms`
          ] = 0;
        }
      );

      histogram[
        `>${buckets[
          buckets.length - 1
        ]}ms`
      ] = 0;

      this.reactions()
        .forEach(
          reaction => {
            const match =
              buckets.find(
                bucket =>
                  reaction <=
                  bucket
              );

            if (
              match !==
              undefined
            ) {
              histogram[
                `≤${match}ms`
              ] += 1;
            } else {
              histogram[
                `>${buckets[
                  buckets.length - 1
                ]}ms`
              ] += 1;
            }
          }
        );

      return histogram;
    }

    summary() {
      const successful =
        this.successfulRecords();

      const failed =
        this.failedRecords();

      const reactions =
        this.reactions();

      const total =
        successful.length +
        failed.length;

      return {
        sessionId:
          this.sessionId,

        totalRecords:
          this.records.length,

        completedClaims:
          total,

        successful:
          successful.length,

        failed:
          failed.length,

        successRate:
          total
            ? Number(
                (
                  successful.length /
                  total *
                  100
                ).toFixed(2)
              )
            : 0,

        averageReaction:
          Math.round(
            average(
              reactions
            )
          ),

        medianReaction:
          Math.round(
            median(
              reactions
            )
          ),

        fastestReaction:
          reactions.length
            ? Math.min(
                ...reactions
              )
            : null,

        slowestReaction:
          reactions.length
            ? Math.max(
                ...reactions
              )
            : null,

        p90Reaction:
          Math.round(
            percentile(
              reactions,
              90
            )
          ),

        p95Reaction:
          Math.round(
            percentile(
              reactions,
              95
            )
          ),

        reactionDeviation:
          Math.round(
            standardDeviation(
              reactions
            )
          ),

        retries:
          this.records.filter(
            record =>
              record.retryUsed
          ).length,

        profileSummary:
          this.profileSummary(),

        detectionSummary:
          this.detectionSummary(),

        histogram:
          this.buildReactionHistogram()
      };
    }

    createSnapshot() {
      const snapshot = {
        timestamp:
          Date.now(),

        isoTime:
          new Date()
            .toISOString(),

        sessionId:
          this.sessionId,

        summary:
          this.summary(),

        stats:
          statsManager
            .getStats(),

        profile:
          settings.get(
            'profile'
          ),

        health:
          extension
            .healthMonitor
            ?.inspect?.() ||
          null,

        performance:
          extension
            .dbzPerformanceGovernor
            ?.snapshot?.() ||
          null
      };

      this.snapshots.push(
        snapshot
      );

      this.trim();
      this.persist();

      eventManager.emit(
        'ANALYTICS_SNAPSHOT_CREATED',
        {
          snapshot:
            cloneValue(
              snapshot
            )
        }
      );

      return snapshot;
    }

    startSnapshots() {
      const interval =
        Math.max(
          60000,
          Number(
            this.getSettings()
              .autoSnapshotIntervalMs
          ) ||
          ANALYTICS_DEFAULTS
            .autoSnapshotIntervalMs
        );

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            if (
              this.isEnabled()
            ) {
              this.createSnapshot();
            }
          }, interval)
        );
    }

    exportJson() {
      return JSON.stringify(
        {
          application:
            'TheFreshMaker',

          version:
            extension.version,

          exportedAt:
            new Date()
              .toISOString(),

          sessionId:
            this.sessionId,

          summary:
            this.summary(),

          records:
            this.records.map(
              record =>
                record.toJSON()
            ),

          snapshots:
            this.snapshots,

          stats:
            statsManager
              .getStats()
        },
        null,
        2
      );
    }

    exportCsv() {
      const headers = [
        'id',
        'detectedAt',
        'claimStartedAt',
        'clickedAt',
        'completedAt',
        'reaction',
        'result',
        'reason',
        'signal',
        'retryUsed',
        'profile',
        'detectionMethod',
        'score',
        'red',
        'sessionId',
        'page'
      ];

      const lines = [
        headers.join(',')
      ];

      this.records.forEach(
        record => {
          const data =
            record.toJSON();

          lines.push(
            headers
              .map(
                key =>
                  escapeCsv(
                    data[key]
                  )
              )
              .join(',')
          );
        }
      );

      return lines.join(
        '\n'
      );
    }

    clear() {
      this.records = [];
      this.snapshots = [];
      this.current = null;

      Storage.clear(
        'bf_analyticsTimeline'
      );

      Storage.clear(
        'bf_analyticsSnapshots'
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'ANALYTICS_CLEARED'
      );
    }

    updateSettings(
      updates
    ) {
      analyticsSettings = {
        ...this.getSettings(),
        ...(updates || {})
      };

      settings.set(
        'analytics',
        analyticsSettings
      );

      this.trim();
      this.persist();

      return {
        ...analyticsSettings
      };
    }

    bindEvents() {
      eventManager.on(
        'DROP_FOUND',
        event => {
          this.beginRecord(
            event
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_START',
        () => {
          this.markClaimStarted();
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLICK_DISPATCHED',
        () => {
          this.markClicked();
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_SUCCESS',
        event => {
          this.completeSuccess(
            event
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'CLAIM_FAIL',
        event => {
          this.completeFailure(
            event
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        event => {
          if (this.current) {
            this.completeFailure({
              reason:
                'watchdog-timeout',
              retryUsed:
                false,
              ...event
            });
          }
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'V4_DESTROYED',
        () => {
          this.destroy();
        }
      );
    }

    destroy() {
      this.persist();
      this.disposables.clear();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
