  // ==========================================================
  // ANALYTICS PANEL
  // ==========================================================

  class AnalyticsPanel {
    constructor(
      analyticsManager
    ) {
      this.analyticsManager =
        analyticsManager;

      this.element = null;
      this.backdrop = null;
      this.visible = false;

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      if (window.TFM_PILL_ONLY_MODE) return;

      this.create();
      this.bindKeyboard();
    }

    createButton(
      text,
      className,
      handler
    ) {
      const button =
        document.createElement(
          'button'
        );

      button.className =
        'tfm-analytics-button ' +
        (
          className || ''
        );

      button.textContent =
        text;

      button.addEventListener(
        'click',
        handler
      );

      return button;
    }

    create() {
      document.getElementById(
        'tfm-analytics-panel'
      )?.remove();

      document.getElementById(
        'tfm-analytics-backdrop'
      )?.remove();

      const backdrop =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      backdrop.id =
        'tfm-analytics-backdrop';

      backdrop.addEventListener(
        'click',
        () => this.hide()
      );

      const panel =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      panel.id =
        'tfm-analytics-panel';

      const header =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      header.id =
        'tfm-analytics-header';

      const title =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      title.id =
        'tfm-analytics-title';

      title.textContent =
        '📊 TheFreshMaker Analytics';

      const close =
        document.createElement(
          'button'
        );

      close.id =
        'tfm-analytics-close';

      close.textContent =
        '✕';

      close.addEventListener(
        'click',
        () => this.hide()
      );

      header.appendChild(title);
      header.appendChild(close);

      const summary =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      summary.id =
        'tfm-analytics-summary';

      const histogramSection =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      histogramSection.className =
        'tfm-analytics-section';

      histogramSection.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tfm-analytics-heading">
          Reaction distribution
        </div>

        <div id="tfm-analytics-histogram"></div>
      `;

      const profileSection =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      profileSection.className =
        'tfm-analytics-section';

      profileSection.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tfm-analytics-heading">
          Profile performance
        </div>

        <div id="tfm-analytics-profiles"></div>
      `;

      const timelineSection =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      timelineSection.className =
        'tfm-analytics-section';

      timelineSection.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tfm-analytics-heading">
          Recent claims
        </div>

        <div id="tfm-analytics-timeline"></div>
      `;

      const controlsSection =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      controlsSection.className =
        'tfm-analytics-section';

      const buttons =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      buttons.className =
        'tfm-analytics-buttons';

      buttons.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Export JSON',
          '',
          () => {
            downloadText(
              `TheFreshMaker-analytics-${Date.now()}.json`,
              this.analyticsManager
                .exportJson(),
              'application/json'
            );
          }
        )
      );

      buttons.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Export CSV',
          'tfm-purple',
          () => {
            downloadText(
              `TheFreshMaker-claims-${Date.now()}.csv`,
              this.analyticsManager
                .exportCsv(),
              'text/csv'
            );
          }
        )
      );

      buttons.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Create snapshot',
          'tfm-warning',
          () => {
            this.analyticsManager
              .createSnapshot();

            eventToast?.show(
              'Analytics snapshot created',
              1100,
              'success'
            );

            this.render();
          }
        )
      );

      buttons.appendChild(
        this.createButton(
          'Clear analytics',
          'tfm-danger',
          () => {
            if (
              !confirm(
                'Clear the entire claim analytics history?'
              )
            ) {
              return;
            }

            this.analyticsManager
              .clear();

            eventToast?.show(
              'Analytics cleared',
              1100,
              'success'
            );

            this.render();
          }
        )
      );

      controlsSection.appendChild(
        buttons
      );

      panel.appendChild(header);
      panel.appendChild(summary);
      panel.appendChild(
        histogramSection
      );
      panel.appendChild(
        profileSection
      );
      panel.appendChild(
        timelineSection
      );
      panel.appendChild(
        controlsSection
      );

      document.body
        .appendChild(
          backdrop
        );

      document.body
        .appendChild(
          panel
        );

      this.element =
        panel;

      this.backdrop =
        backdrop;

      this.render();
    }

    renderSummary(
      summary
    ) {
      const element =
        this.element
          ?.querySelector(
            '#tfm-analytics-summary'
          );

      if (!element) {
        return;
      }

      const values = [
        [
          summary.completedClaims,
          'Claims'
        ],
        [
          summary.successful,
          'Success'
        ],
        [
          summary.failed,
          'Failed'
        ],
        [
          summary.successRate +
            '%',
          'Success rate'
        ],
        [
          summary.averageReaction
            ? summary
                .averageReaction +
              'ms'
            : '-',
          'Average'
        ],
        [
          summary
            .medianReaction
            ? summary
                .medianReaction +
              'ms'
            : '-',
          'Median'
        ],
        [
          summary
            .fastestReaction !==
            null
            ? summary
                .fastestReaction +
              'ms'
            : '-',
          'Fastest'
        ],
        [
          summary.retries,
          'Retries'
        ]
      ];

      element.innerHTML =
        '';

      values.forEach(
        ([value, label]) => {
          const card =
            document.createElement(
              'div'
            );

          card.className =
            'tfm-analytics-card';

          card.innerHTML = `
            <span class="tfm-analytics-value">
              ${value}
            </span>

            <span class="tfm-analytics-label">
              ${label}
            </span>
          `;

          element.appendChild(
            card
          );
        }
      );
    }

    renderHistogram(
      histogram
    ) {
      const element =
        this.element
          ?.querySelector(
            '#tfm-analytics-histogram'
          );

      if (!element) {
        return;
      }

      element.innerHTML =
        '';

      const maximum =
        Math.max(
          1,
          ...Object.values(
            histogram
          )
        );

      Object.entries(
        histogram
      ).forEach(
        ([label, count]) => {
          const row =
            document.createElement(
              'div'
            );

          row.className =
            'tfm-histogram-row';

          const width =
            Math.max(
              1,
              Math.round(
                count /
                maximum *
                100
              )
            );

          row.innerHTML = `
            <span>${label}</span>

            <div class="tfm-histogram-bar-wrap">
              <div
                class="tfm-histogram-bar"
                style="width:${width}%"
              ></div>
            </div>

            <span>${count}</span>
          `;

          element.appendChild(
            row
          );
        }
      );
    }

    renderProfiles(
      profiles
    ) {
      const element =
        this.element
          ?.querySelector(
            '#tfm-analytics-profiles'
          );

      if (!element) {
        return;
      }

      const entries =
        Object.entries(
          profiles
        );

      if (
        entries.length === 0
      ) {
        element.textContent =
          'No profile data yet.';

        return;
      }

      const table =
        document.createElement(
          'table'
        );

      table.className =
        'tfm-analytics-table';

      table.innerHTML = `
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Profile</th>
            <th>Total</th>
            <th>Success</th>
            <th>Failed</th>
            <th>Rate</th>
            <th>Average</th>
            <th>Fastest</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
      `;

      const body =
        document.createElement(
          'tbody'
        );

      entries.forEach(
        ([profile, data]) => {
          const row =
            document.createElement(
              'tr'
            );

          row.innerHTML = `
            <td>${profile}</td>
            <td>${data.total}</td>
            <td class="tfm-analytics-success">
              ${data.success}
            </td>
            <td class="tfm-analytics-failure">
              ${data.failure}
            </td>
            <td>${data.successRate}%</td>
            <td>
              ${
                data.averageReaction
                  ? data.averageReaction +
                    'ms'
                  : '-'
              }
            </td>
            <td>
              ${
                data.fastestReaction !==
                null
                  ? data.fastestReaction +
                    'ms'
                  : '-'
              }
            </td>
          `;

          body.appendChild(
            row
          );
        }
      );

      table.appendChild(body);

      element.innerHTML =
        '';

      element.appendChild(
        table
      );
    }

    renderTimeline() {
      const element =
        this.element
          ?.querySelector(
            '#tfm-analytics-timeline'
          );

      if (!element) {
        return;
      }

      const records =
        this.analyticsManager
          .records
          .slice(-25)
          .reverse();

      if (
        records.length === 0
      ) {
        element.textContent =
          'No claim records yet.';

        return;
      }

      const table =
        document.createElement(
          'table'
        );

      table.className =
        'tfm-analytics-table';

      table.innerHTML = `
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Time</th>
            <th>Result</th>
            <th>Reaction</th>
            <th>Profile</th>
            <th>Method</th>
            <th>Retry</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
      `;

      const body =
        document.createElement(
          'tbody'
        );

      records.forEach(
        record => {
          const row =
            document.createElement(
              'tr'
            );

          const date =
            record.completedAt ||
            record.detectedAt;

          const time =
            date
              ? new Date(
                  date
                )
                  .toLocaleTimeString()
              : '-';

          const resultClass =
            record.result ===
              'success'
              ? 'tfm-analytics-success'
              : record.result ===
                  'failure'
                ? 'tfm-analytics-failure'
                : '';

          row.innerHTML = `
            <td>${time}</td>

            <td class="${resultClass}">
              ${record.result}
            </td>

            <td>
              ${
                record.reaction !==
                null
                  ? record.reaction +
                    'ms'
                  : '-'
              }
            </td>

            <td>
              ${record.profile || '-'}
            </td>

            <td>
              ${
                record
                  .detectionMethod ||
                '-'
              }
            </td>

            <td>
              ${
                record.retryUsed
                  ? 'Yes'
                  : 'No'
              }
            </td>
          `;

          body.appendChild(
            row
          );
        }
      );

      table.appendChild(body);

      element.innerHTML =
        '';

      element.appendChild(
        table
      );
    }

    render() {
      if (!this.element) {
        return;
      }

      const summary =
        this.analyticsManager
          .summary();

      this.renderSummary(
        summary
      );

      this.renderHistogram(
        summary.histogram
      );

      this.renderProfiles(
        summary.profileSummary
      );

      this.renderTimeline();
    }

    bindKeyboard() {
      this.disposables
        .addEventListener(
          document,
          'keydown',
          event => {
            if (
              event.shiftKey &&
              event.key
                .toLowerCase() ===
                'x'
            ) {
              event.preventDefault();

              this.toggle();
            }

            if (
              event.key ===
                'Escape' &&
              this.visible
            ) {
              this.hide();
            }
          }
        );
    }

    show() {
      if (!this.element) {
        this.create();
      }

      this.visible =
        true;

      this.element
        .classList
        .add(
          'tfm-visible'
        );

      this.backdrop
        ?.classList
        .add(
          'tfm-visible'
        );

      this.render();
    }

    hide() {
      this.visible =
        false;

      this.element
        ?.classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-visible'
        );

      this.backdrop
        ?.classList
        .remove(
          'tfm-visible'
        );
    }

    toggle() {
      if (this.visible) {
        this.hide();
      } else {
        this.show();
      }
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables.clear();

      this.element
        ?.remove();

      this.backdrop
        ?.remove();

      this.element =
        null;

      this.backdrop =
        null;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // INITIALISE
  // ==========================================================

  const analyticsManager =
    new AnalyticsManager();

  const analyticsPanel =
    new AnalyticsPanel(
      analyticsManager
    );

  extension.analyticsManager =
    analyticsManager;

  extension.analyticsPanel =
    analyticsPanel;

  core.analyticsManager =
    analyticsManager;

  core.analyticsPanel =
    analyticsPanel;

  // ==========================================================
  // EVENT CONNECTIONS
  // ==========================================================

  eventManager.on(
    'ANALYTICS_RECORD_COMPLETED',
    () => {
      if (
        analyticsPanel.visible
      ) {
        analyticsPanel.render();
      }
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'ANALYTICS_SNAPSHOT_CREATED',
    () => {
      debugLogger.info(
        'Analytics snapshot created.'
      );
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'ANALYTICS_CLEARED',
    () => {
      debugLogger.info(
        'Analytics history cleared.'
      );
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'V4_DESTROYED',
    () => {
      analyticsPanel
        .destroy();

      analyticsManager
        .destroy();
    }
  );

  // ==========================================================
  // PUBLIC COMMANDS
  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    analytics: {
      open() {
        return analyticsPanel
          .show();
      },

      close() {
        return analyticsPanel
          .hide();
      },

      toggle() {
        return analyticsPanel
          .toggle();
      },

      summary() {
        return analyticsManager
          .summary();
      },

      records(
        limit = 50
      ) {
        return analyticsManager
          .records
          .slice(
            -Math.max(
              1,
              limit
            )
          )
          .map(
            record =>
              record.toJSON()
          );
      },

      snapshots(
        limit = 20
      ) {
        return analyticsManager
          .snapshots
          .slice(
            -Math.max(
              1,
              limit
            )
          );
      },

      createSnapshot() {
        return analyticsManager
          .createSnapshot();
      },

      exportJson() {
        return analyticsManager
          .exportJson();
      },

      exportCsv() {
        return analyticsManager
          .exportCsv();
      },

      downloadJson() {
        return downloadText(
          `TheFreshMaker-analytics-${Date.now()}.json`,
          analyticsManager
            .exportJson(),
          'application/json'
        );
      },

      downloadCsv() {
        return downloadText(
          `TheFreshMaker-claims-${Date.now()}.csv`,
          analyticsManager
            .exportCsv(),
          'text/csv'
        );
      },

      clear() {
        return analyticsManager
          .clear();
      },

      settings() {
        return {
          ...analyticsManager
            .getSettings()
        };
      },

      update(
        updates
      ) {
        return analyticsManager
          .updateSettings(
            updates
          );
      }
    }
  };

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 28 loaded successfully.',
    {
      shortcut:
        'Shift+X',

      records:
        analyticsManager
          .records
          .length,

      snapshots:
        analyticsManager
          .snapshots
          .length
    }
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_PART_28_READY',
    {
      analyticsManager,
      analyticsPanel
    }
  );
})();
// ============================================================
// THEFRESHMAKER v4 FINAL VALIDATION EXTENSION
// Part 29
// Runtime self-tests, compatibility checks, module validation,
// startup gate, emergency safe mode and integrity reporting.
// Paste directly after Part 28.
// ============================================================

(function TheFreshMakerV4Part29() {
  'use strict';

  const extension =
    window.TheFreshMakerV4;

  const core =
    window.BFHelper;

  if (!extension || !core) {
    console.error(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 29 requires Parts 17–28.'
    );

    return;
  }

  if (
    window.TFM_V4_PART_29_LOADED
  ) {
    console.warn(
      '[TheFreshMaker v4] Part 29 already loaded.'
    );

    return;
  }

  window.TFM_V4_PART_29_LOADED =
    true;

  const {
    eventManager,
    debugLogger,
    sniper,
    statsManager,
    healthMonitor,
    runtimeCoordinator,
    settingsPanel,
    liveHUD,
    statsDashboard,
    eventToast,
    analyticsManager,
    dbzSceneManager,
    dbzSceneQueue,
    dbzEffectLayer,
    dbzPerformanceGovernor
  } = extension;

  const {
    settings,
    Storage,
    Disposables
  } = core;

  // ==========================================================
  // VALIDATION DEFAULTS
  // ==========================================================

  const VALIDATION_DEFAULTS = {
    enabled: true,

    runAtStartup: true,

    runIntervalMs:
      60 * 1000,

    automaticallyRecover: true,

    enterSafeModeOnCritical: true,

    maximumConsecutiveFailures: 3,

    testDomAccess: true,

    testStorage: true,

    testEventManager: true,

    testSniper: true,

    testStatistics: true,

    testUi: true,

    testDbz: true,

    testAnalytics: true,

    lastRunAt: null,

    lastResult: null,

    consecutiveFailures: 0,

    safeMode: false
  };

  function mergeValidationSettings() {
    const current =
      settings.get(
        'validation'
      ) || {};

    const merged = {
      ...VALIDATION_DEFAULTS,
      ...current
    };

    settings.set(
      'validation',
      merged
    );

    return merged;
  }

  let validationSettings =
    mergeValidationSettings();

  // ==========================================================
  // VALIDATION RESULT
  // ==========================================================

  class ValidationResult {
    constructor(
      name
    ) {
      this.name =
        name;

      this.passed =
        false;

      this.critical =
        false;

      this.message =
        '';

      this.data =
        null;

      this.startedAt =
        performance.now();

      this.completedAt =
        null;

      this.duration =
        null;

      this.error =
        null;
    }

    pass(
      message = 'Passed',
      data = null
    ) {
      this.passed =
        true;

      this.message =
        message;

      this.data =
        data;

      this.complete();

      return this;
    }

    fail(
      message,
      error = null,
      critical = false,
      data = null
    ) {
      this.passed =
        false;

      this.message =
        message;

      this.error =
        error
          ? String(
              error?.message ||
              error
            )
          : null;

      this.critical =
        Boolean(critical);

      this.data =
        data;

      this.complete();

      return this;
    }

    complete() {
      this.completedAt =
        performance.now();

      this.duration =
        Math.round(
          (
            this.completedAt -
            this.startedAt
          ) * 100
        ) / 100;
    }

    toJSON() {
      return {
        name:
          this.name,

        passed:
          this.passed,

        critical:
          this.critical,

        message:
          this.message,

        data:
          this.data,

        duration:
          this.duration,

        error:
          this.error
      };
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // MODULE INTEGRITY TESTER
  // ==========================================================

  class ModuleIntegrityTester {
    constructor() {
      this.lastReport =
        null;

      this.runCount =
        0;

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.safeMode =
        Boolean(
          mergeValidationSettings()
            .safeMode
        );

      this.start();
    }

    getSettings() {
      validationSettings =
        mergeValidationSettings();

      return validationSettings;
    }

    async test(
      name,
      callback,
      options = {}
    ) {
      const result =
        new ValidationResult(
          name
        );

      try {
        const output =
          await callback();

        if (
          output === false
        ) {
          return result.fail(
            options.failureMessage ||
            'Test returned false.',
            null,
            options.critical,
            options.data
          );
        }

        if (
          output &&
          typeof output ===
            'object' &&
          output.passed ===
            false
        ) {
          return result.fail(
            output.message ||
            options.failureMessage ||
            'Test failed.',
            output.error,
            output.critical ??
              options.critical,
            output.data
          );
        }

        return result.pass(
          options.successMessage ||
          'Passed.',
          output === true
            ? null
            : output
        );
      } catch (error) {
        return result.fail(
          options.failureMessage ||
          'Test threw an exception.',
          error,
          options.critical
        );
      }
    }

    async testDomAccess() {
      return this.test(
        'dom-access',
        async () => {
          if (
            !document ||
            !document.documentElement ||
            !document.body
          ) {
            return false;
          }

          const probe =
            document.createElement(
              'div'
            );

          probe.id =
            'tfm-validation-probe';

          probe.style.display =
            'none';

          document.body
            .appendChild(
              probe
            );

          const found =
            document.getElementById(
              'tfm-validation-probe'
            );

          probe.remove();

          return Boolean(found);
        },
        {
          critical: true,

          failureMessage:
            'Document access is unavailable.'
        }
      );
    }

    async testStorage() {
      return this.test(
        'storage',
        async () => {
          const key =
            'bf_validation_probe';

          const value = {
            timestamp:
              Date.now(),

            random:
              Math.random()
          };

          Storage.set(
            key,
            value
          );

          const read =
            Storage.get(
              key,
              null
            );

          Storage.clear(key);

          return Boolean(
            read &&
            read.timestamp ===
              value.timestamp &&
            read.random ===
              value.random
          );
        },
        {
          critical: true,

          failureMessage:
            'Persistent storage read/write failed.'
        }
      );
    }

    async testEvents() {
      return this.test(
        'event-manager',
        async () => {
          if (
            !eventManager ||
            typeof eventManager.on !==
              'function' ||
            typeof eventManager.emit !==
              'function'
          ) {
            return false;
          }

          const eventName =
            'TFM_VALIDATION_EVENT_' +
            Date.now();

          let received =
            false;

          const unsubscribe =
            eventManager.on(
              eventName,
              payload => {
                received =
                  payload?.valid ===
                  true;
              }
            );

          eventManager.emit(
            eventName,
            {
              valid: true
            }
          );

          unsubscribe?.();

          return received;
        },
        {
          critical: true,

          failureMessage:
            'Internal event manager failed.'
        }
      );
    }

    async testSniper() {
      return this.test(
        'sniper-core',
        async () => {
          if (
            !sniper ||
            typeof sniper.health !==
              'function' ||
            typeof sniper.scan !==
              'function' ||
            typeof sniper.recover !==
              'function'
          ) {
            return false;
          }

          const health =
            sniper.health();

          return {
            passed:
              health &&
              health.state !==
                'DESTROYED' &&
              health.observerAttached !==
                false,

            message:
              'Sniper health check failed.',

            critical: true,

            data:
              health
          };
        },
        {
          critical: true,

          failureMessage:
            'Sniper module is unavailable.'
        }
      );
    }

    async testStats() {
      return this.test(
        'statistics',
        async () => {
          if (
            !statsManager ||
            typeof statsManager.getStats !==
              'function'
          ) {
            return false;
          }

          const stats =
            statsManager.getStats();

          if (
            !stats ||
            typeof stats !==
              'object'
          ) {
            return false;
          }

          const requiredKeys = [
            'detectedDrops',
            'successfulClaims',
            'failedAttempts',
            'sessionStart'
          ];

          const missing =
            requiredKeys.filter(
              key =>
                !(key in stats)
            );

          return {
            passed:
              missing.length ===
              0,

            message:
              missing.length
                ? 'Statistics fields are missing.'
                : 'Statistics structure is valid.',

            data: {
              missing
            }
          };
        },
        {
          failureMessage:
            'Statistics manager failed.'
        }
      );
    }

    async testUi() {
      return this.test(
        'ui-components',
        async () => {
          const components = {
            pill:
              Boolean(
                document.getElementById(
                  'bf-pill'
                )
              ),

            hud:
              Boolean(
                document.getElementById(
                  'tfm-live-hud'
                )
              ),

            stats:
              Boolean(
                document.getElementById(
                  'tfm-stats-panel'
                )
              ),

            settings:
              Boolean(
                document.getElementById(
                  'tfm-settings-panel'
                )
              )
          };

          const important =
            [
              components.pill,
              components.hud,
              components.stats
            ];

          return {
            passed:
              important.some(Boolean),

            message:
              'No primary UI components were found.',

            data:
              components
          };
        },
        {
          failureMessage:
            'UI component validation failed.'
        }
      );
    }

    async testDbz() {
      return this.test(
        'dbz-modules',
        async () => {
          const theme =
            settings.get(
              'theme'
            );

          const modules = {
            sceneManager:
              Boolean(
                dbzSceneManager
              ),

            queue:
              Boolean(
                dbzSceneQueue
              ),

            effectLayer:
              Boolean(
                dbzEffectLayer
              ),

            performance:
              Boolean(
                dbzPerformanceGovernor
              )
          };

          const available =
            Object.values(
              modules
            ).filter(Boolean)
              .length;

          return {
            passed:
              theme !== 'dbz' ||
              available >= 2,

            message:
              theme === 'dbz' &&
              available < 2
                ? 'Required DBZ modules are unavailable.'
                : 'DBZ modules are valid.',

            data: {
              theme,
              modules
            }
          };
        },
        {
          failureMessage:
            'DBZ module validation failed.'
        }
      );
    }

    async testAnalytics() {
      return this.test(
        'analytics',
        async () => {
          if (
            !analyticsManager
          ) {
            return {
              passed: true,

              message:
                'Analytics module is optional and unavailable.',

              data: {
                optional: true
              }
            };
          }

          const summary =
            analyticsManager
              .summary?.();

          return Boolean(
            summary &&
            typeof summary ===
              'object'
          );
        },
        {
          failureMessage:
            'Analytics module failed.'
        }
      );
    }

    buildSummary(
      results
    ) {
      const passed =
        results.filter(
          result =>
            result.passed
        );

      const failed =
        results.filter(
          result =>
            !result.passed
        );

      const critical =
        failed.filter(
          result =>
            result.critical
        );

      return {
        timestamp:
          Date.now(),

        isoTime:
          new Date()
            .toISOString(),

        total:
          results.length,

        passed:
          passed.length,

        failed:
          failed.length,

        criticalFailures:
          critical.length,

        healthy:
          critical.length ===
            0,

        results:
          results.map(
            result =>
              result.toJSON()
          )
      };
    }

    async run(
      reason = 'manual'
    ) {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        config.enabled ===
          false
      ) {
        return {
          skipped: true,
          reason:
            'validation-disabled'
        };
      }

      const startedAt =
        performance.now();

      const results = [];

      if (
        config.testDomAccess !==
        false
      ) {
        results.push(
          await this
            .testDomAccess()
        );
      }

      if (
        config.testStorage !==
        false
      ) {
        results.push(
          await this
            .testStorage()
        );
      }

      if (
        config.testEventManager !==
        false
      ) {
        results.push(
          await this
            .testEvents()
        );
      }

      if (
        config.testSniper !==
        false
      ) {
        results.push(
          await this
            .testSniper()
        );
      }

      if (
        config.testStatistics !==
        false
      ) {
        results.push(
          await this
            .testStats()
        );
      }

      if (
        config.testUi !==
        false
      ) {
        results.push(
          await this
            .testUi()
        );
      }

      if (
        config.testDbz !==
        false
      ) {
        results.push(
          await this
            .testDbz()
        );
      }

      if (
        config.testAnalytics !==
        false
      ) {
        results.push(
          await this
            .testAnalytics()
        );
      }

      const report =
        this.buildSummary(
          results
        );

      report.reason =
        reason;

      report.duration =
        Math.round(
          (
            performance.now() -
            startedAt
          ) * 100
        ) / 100;

      this.lastReport =
        report;

      this.runCount +=
        1;

      validationSettings = {
        ...config,

        lastRunAt:
          report.timestamp,

        lastResult:
          report,

        consecutiveFailures:
          report.healthy
            ? 0
            : Number(
                config
                  .consecutiveFailures ||
                0
              ) + 1
      };

      settings.set(
        'validation',
        validationSettings
      );

      Storage.set(
        'bf_validationLastReport',
        report
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'VALIDATION_COMPLETED',
        {
          report
        }
      );

      if (
        report.healthy
      ) {
        this.handleSuccess(
          report
        );
      } else {
        await this.handleFailure(
          report
        );
      }

      return report;
    }

    handleSuccess(
      report
    ) {
      if (
        this.safeMode &&
        report.healthy
      ) {
        this.exitSafeMode(
          'validation-recovered'
        );
      }

      debugLogger.info(
        'Runtime validation passed.',
        {
          duration:
            report.duration,
          passed:
            report.passed
        }
      );
    }

    async handleFailure(
      report
    ) {
      debugLogger.warn(
        'Runtime validation failed.',
        report
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'VALIDATION_FAILED',
        {
          report
        }
      );

      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        config.automaticallyRecover !==
        false
      ) {
        try {
          sniper?.recover?.();

          healthMonitor
            ?.recover?.();

          runtimeCoordinator
            ?.restart?.();

          eventManager.emit(
            'VALIDATION_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTED',
            {
              report
            }
          );
        } catch (error) {
          debugLogger.error(
            'Validation recovery attempt failed.',
            error
          );
        }
      }

      const failures =
        Number(
          validationSettings
            .consecutiveFailures ||
          0
        );

      const threshold =
        Math.max(
          1,
          Number(
            config
              .maximumConsecutiveFailures
          ) || 3
        );

      if (
        config.enterSafeModeOnCritical !==
          false &&
        (
          report.criticalFailures >
            0 ||
          failures >= threshold
        )
      ) {
        this.enterSafeMode(
          'validation-failure'
        );
      }
    }

    enterSafeMode(
      reason =
        'manual'
    ) {
      if (this.safeMode) {
        return;
      }

      this.safeMode =
        true;

      validationSettings = {
        ...this.getSettings(),

        safeMode: true
      };

      settings.set(
        'validation',
        validationSettings
      );

      const visuals =
        settings.get(
          'visuals'
        ) || {};

      settings.set(
        'visuals',
        {
          ...visuals,

          animations: false,

          particles: false,

          screenFlash: false,

          coinScene: false,

          spriteReactions: false
        }
      );

      try {
        dbzSceneQueue
          ?.clear?.(
            'safe-mode'
          );

        dbzSceneManager
          ?.cancel?.();

        dbzEffectLayer
          ?.clearParticles?.();

        dbzPerformanceGovernor
          ?.forceMode?.(
            'critical'
          );
      } catch (error) {}

      liveHUD?.setStatus(
        '🛡️ Safe mode active',
        'warning'
      );

      eventToast?.show(
        '🛡️ SAFE MODE ENABLED',
        1800,
        'warning'
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'SAFE_MODE_ENABLED',
        {
          reason
        }
      );

      debugLogger.warn(
        'Safe mode enabled.',
        {
          reason
        }
      );
    }

    exitSafeMode(
      reason =
        'manual'
    ) {
      if (!this.safeMode) {
        return;
      }

      this.safeMode =
        false;

      validationSettings = {
        ...this.getSettings(),

        safeMode: false,

        consecutiveFailures: 0
      };

      settings.set(
        'validation',
        validationSettings
      );

      const visuals =
        settings.get(
          'visuals'
        ) || {};

      settings.set(
        'visuals',
        {
          ...visuals,

          animations: true,

          particles: true,

          screenFlash: true,

          coinScene: true,

          spriteReactions: true
        }
      );

      dbzPerformanceGovernor
        ?.recover?.();

      sniper?.recover?.();

      liveHUD?.setStatus(
        '🟢 Safe mode cleared',
        'success'
      );

      eventToast?.show(
        '✓ NORMAL MODE RESTORED',
        1500,
        'success'
      );

      eventManager.emit(
        'SAFE_MODE_DISABLED',
        {
          reason
        }
      );

      debugLogger.info(
        'Safe mode disabled.',
        {
          reason
        }
      );
    }

    start() {
      const config =
        this.getSettings();

      if (
        config.runAtStartup !==
        false
      ) {
        this.disposables
          .addTimeout(
            setTimeout(() => {
              this.run(
                'startup'
              );
            }, 2500)
          );
      }

      const interval =
        Math.max(
          15000,
          Number(
            config.runIntervalMs
          ) ||
          60000
        );

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            this.run(
              'scheduled'
            );
          }, interval)
        );

      eventManager.on(
        'HEALTH_WARNING',
        () => {
          this.run(
            'health-warning'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        () => {
          this.run(
            'watchdog-reset'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'V4_DESTROYED',
        () => {
          this.destroy();
        }
      );
    }

    updateSettings(
      updates
    ) {
      validationSettings = {
        ...this.getSettings(),
        ...(updates || {})
      };

      settings.set(
        'validation',
        validationSettings
      );

      return {
        ...validationSettings
      };
    }

    snapshot() {
      return {
        safeMode:
          this.safeMode,

        runCount:
          this.runCount,

        lastReport:
          this.lastReport,

        settings: {
          ...this.getSettings()
        }
      };
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables
        .clear();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // INTEGRITY BADGE
  // ==========================================================

  class IntegrityBadge {
    constructor(
      tester
    ) {
      this.tester =
        tester;

      this.element =
        null;

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      if (window.TFM_PILL_ONLY_MODE) return;

      this.create();
      this.bind();
    }

    create() {
      document
        .getElementById(
          'tfm-integrity-badge'
        )
        ?.remove();

      const badge =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      badge.id =
        'tfm-integrity-badge';

      badge.style.cssText = `
        position:fixed;
        right:14px;
        top:62px;
        min-width:86px;
        padding:6px 9px;
        border-radius:9px;
        background:
          rgba(8,12,16,0.9);
        border:
          1px solid
          rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
        color:#b9c9cc;
        font:
          800 9px/1.25
          ui-monospace,
          SFMono-Regular,
          Menlo,
          Consolas,
          monospace;
        text-align:center;
        pointer-events:none;
        user-select:none;
        z-index:2147483643;
        box-shadow:
          0 8px 24px
          rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
        backdrop-filter:
          blur(7px);
        opacity:0.88;
      `;

      badge.textContent =
        'CHECKING';

      document.body
        .appendChild(
          badge
        );

      this.element =
        badge;
    }

    render(
      report = null
    ) {
      if (!this.element) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        this.tester
          .safeMode
      ) {
        this.element
          .textContent =
          'SAFE MODE';

        this.element
          .style.color =
          '#ffd27d';

        this.element
          .style.borderColor =
          '#ffd27d';

        return;
      }

      if (!report) {
        this.element
          .textContent =
          'CHECKING';

        this.element
          .style.color =
          '#b9c9cc';

        return;
      }

      if (report.healthy) {
        this.element
          .textContent =
          `HEALTHY ${report.passed}/${report.total}`;

        this.element
          .style.color =
          '#77ffd1';

        this.element
          .style.borderColor =
          '#77ffd1';
      } else {
        this.element
          .textContent =
          `FAULT ${report.failed}`;

        this.element
          .style.color =
          '#ff9898';

        this.element
          .style.borderColor =
          '#ff9898';
      }
    }

    bind() {
      eventManager.on(
        'VALIDATION_COMPLETED',
        event => {
          this.render(
            event.report
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'SAFE_MODE_ENABLED',
        () => {
          this.render(
            this.tester
              .lastReport
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager.on(
        'SAFE_MODE_DISABLED',
        () => {
          this.render(
            this.tester
              .lastReport
          );
        }
      );

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            this.render(
              this.tester
                .lastReport
            );
          }, 4000)
        );
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables
        .clear();

      this.element
        ?.remove();

      this.element =
        null;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // INITIALISE
  // ==========================================================

  const integrityTester =
    new ModuleIntegrityTester();

  const integrityBadge =
    new IntegrityBadge(
      integrityTester
    );

  extension.integrityTester =
    integrityTester;

  extension.integrityBadge =
    integrityBadge;

  core.integrityTester =
    integrityTester;

  core.integrityBadge =
    integrityBadge;

  // ==========================================================
  // EVENT RESPONSES
  // ==========================================================

  eventManager.on(
    'VALIDATION_FAILED',
    event => {
      liveHUD?.setStatus(
        '⚠️ Integrity check failed',
        'warning'
      );

      if (
        settings.get(
          'debugMode'
        )
      ) {
        eventToast?.show(
          `${event.report.failed} integrity test(s) failed`,
          1600,
          'warning'
        );
      }
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'VALIDATION_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTED',
    () => {
      debugLogger.info(
        'Automatic validation recovery attempted.'
      );
    }
  );

  eventManager.on(
    'V4_DESTROYED',
    () => {
      integrityBadge
        .destroy();

      integrityTester
        .destroy();
    }
  );

  // ==========================================================
  // PUBLIC COMMANDS
  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    integrity: {
      async run(
        reason = 'manual'
      ) {
        return integrityTester
          .run(reason);
      },

      status() {
        return integrityTester
          .snapshot();
      },

      report() {
        return integrityTester
          .lastReport;
      },

      settings() {
        return {
          ...integrityTester
            .getSettings()
        };
      },

      update(
        updates
      ) {
        return integrityTester
          .updateSettings(
            updates
          );
      },

      enterSafeMode(
        reason =
          'manual'
      ) {
        return integrityTester
          .enterSafeMode(
            reason
          );
      },

      exitSafeMode(
        reason =
          'manual'
      ) {
        return integrityTester
          .exitSafeMode(
            reason
          );
      }
    }
  };

  debugLogger.info(
    'Part 29 loaded successfully.',
    {
      validationEnabled:
        validationSettings
          .enabled,

      runAtStartup:
        validationSettings
          .runAtStartup,

      safeMode:
        integrityTester
          .safeMode
    }
  );

  eventManager.emit(
    'V4_PART_29_READY',
    {
      integrityTester,
      integrityBadge
    }
  );
})();

  function safeCall(
    callback,
    fallback = null,
    label = 'operation'
  ) {
    try {
      return callback();
    } catch (error) {
      debugLogger?.warn?.(
        `Final bootstrap ${label} failed.`,
        error
      );

      return fallback;
    }
  }

  async function safeCallAsync(
    callback,
    fallback = null,
    label = 'async operation'
  ) {
    try {
      return await callback();
    } catch (error) {
      debugLogger?.warn?.(
        `Final bootstrap ${label} failed.`,
        error
      );

      return fallback;
    }
  }

  function wait(
    milliseconds
  ) {
    return new Promise(
      resolve => {
        setTimeout(
          resolve,
          Math.max(
            0,
            Number(milliseconds) || 0
          )
        );
      }
    );
  }

  function cloneValue(
    value
  ) {
    try {
      return structuredClone(
        value
      );
    } catch (error) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(
          JSON.stringify(value)
        );
      } catch (
        cloneError
      ) {
        return value;
      }
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // PART VALIDATOR
  // ==========================================================

  class PartValidator {
    static getFlag(
      part
    ) {
      return Boolean(
        window[
          `TFM_V4_PART_${part}_LOADED`
        ]
      );
    }

    static inspect() {
      const loaded = [];

      const missing = [];

      REQUIRED_PARTS.forEach(
        part => {
          if (
            this.getFlag(part)
          ) {
            loaded.push(part);
          } else {
            missing.push(part);
          }
        }
      );

      return {
        required:
          [...REQUIRED_PARTS],

        loaded,

        missing,

        complete:
          missing.length === 0
      };
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // COMPATIBILITY BRIDGE

  class CompatibilityBridge {
    constructor() {
      this.report = {
        createdAt:
          Date.now(),

        repairs: [],

        warnings: []
      };

      this.install();
    }

    addRepair(
      message
    ) {
      this.report.repairs.push(
        message
      );

      debugLogger?.info?.(
        message
      );
    }

    addWarning(
      message
    ) {
      this.report.warnings.push(
        message
      );

      debugLogger?.warn?.(
        message
      );
    }

    installAudioFallback() {
      if (
        core.audioManager
      ) {
        return;
      }

      core.audioManager = {
        async play(
          type = 'drop'
        ) {
          const urls =
            settings.get(
              'soundUrls'
            ) || {};

          const url =
            urls[type];

          if (!url) {
            return false;
          }

          try {
            const audio =
              new Audio(url);

            audio.volume =
              Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(
                  1,
                  Number(
                    settings.get(
                      'volume'
                    ) || 0.7
                  )
                )
              );

            await audio
              .play();

            return true;
          } catch (
            error
          ) {
            return false;
          }
        }
      };

      this.addRepair(
        'Installed audio-manager compatibility fallback.'
      );
    }

    installEffectsFallback() {
      if (
        core.Effects
      ) {
        return;
      }

      core.Effects = {
        showFireworks() {
          if (
            typeof window.confetti !==
            'function'
          ) {
            return false;
          }

          try {
            window.confetti({
              particleCount: 70,
              spread: 75,
              origin: {
                x: 0.5,
                y: 0.58
              }
            });

            return true;
          } catch (
            error
          ) {
            return false;
          }
        },

        createPulse(
          element
        ) {
          if (!element) {
            return false;
          }

              element
                .getBoundingClientRect();

              document.createElement(

              );

              width:${rect.width}px;
              height:${rect.height}px;
              border:
                2px solid

              border-radius:12px;

              z-index:2147483647;
              opacity:1;
              transform:scale(1);
              transition:
                opacity 500ms ease,
                transform 500ms ease;
            `;

            document.body

                pulse
              );

            requestAnimationFrame(

                pulse.style.opacity =
                  '0';

                pulse.style.transform =

              }

            setTimeout(() => {
              pulse.remove();

            return true;
          } catch (
            error
          ) {
            return false;
          }

    exposeExtensionServices() {

        liveHUD,

  // ==========================================================
  // DUPLICATE DBZ SCENE GUARD
  // ==========================================================

  class DuplicateSceneGuard {
    constructor() {
      this.installed =
        false;

      this.lastCalls =
        new Map();

      this.originalMethods =
        new Map();

      this.install();
    }

    shouldBlock(
      methodName
    ) {
      finalSettings =
        getFinalSettings();

      if (
        finalSettings
          .preventDuplicateScenes ===
        false
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      const windowMs =
        Math.max(
          50,
          Number(
            finalSettings
              .duplicateSceneWindowMs
          ) || 350
        );

      const now =
        Date.now();

      const last =
        this.lastCalls.get(
          methodName
        ) || 0;

      this.lastCalls.set(
        methodName,
        now
      );

      return (
        now - last <
        windowMs
      );
    }

    wrap(
      methodName
    ) {
      if (
        !dbzSceneManager ||
        typeof dbzSceneManager[
          methodName
        ] !== 'function'
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        this.originalMethods.has(
          methodName
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const original =
        dbzSceneManager[
          methodName
        ].bind(
          dbzSceneManager
        );

      this.originalMethods.set(
        methodName,
        original
      );

      dbzSceneManager[
        methodName
      ] =
        async (...args) => {
          if (
            this.shouldBlock(
              methodName
            )
          ) {
            debugLogger?.info?.(
              `Duplicate DBZ scene blocked: ${methodName}`
            );

            return false;
          }

          return original(
            ...args
          );
        };
    }

    install() {
      if (
        this.installed ||
        !dbzSceneManager
      ) {
        return;
      }

      [
        'playDropFound',
        'playClaimStart',
        'playFriezaInterruption',
        'playGokuVictory',
        'playBrolyFailure',
        'handleSuccess',
        'handleFailure'
      ].forEach(
        methodName => {
          this.wrap(
            methodName
          );
        }
      );

      this.installed =
        true;

      debugLogger?.info?.(
        'Duplicate DBZ scene guard installed.'
      );
    }

    restore() {
      this.originalMethods
        .forEach(
          (
            original,
            methodName
          ) => {
            dbzSceneManager[
              methodName
            ] = original;
          }
        );

      this.originalMethods
        .clear();

      this.lastCalls
        .clear();

      this.installed =
        false;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // FINAL RUNTIME AUDITOR
  // ==========================================================

  class FinalRuntimeAuditor {
    constructor() {
      this.lastReport =
        null;

      this.auditCount =
        0;

      this.disposables =
        new Disposables();

      this.start();
    }

    inspectModules() {
      return {
        core:
          Boolean(core),

        extension:
          Boolean(extension),

        eventManager:
          Boolean(eventManager),

        sniper:
          Boolean(sniper),

        statsManager:
          Boolean(statsManager),

        healthMonitor:
          Boolean(healthMonitor),

        runtimeCoordinator:
          Boolean(
            runtimeCoordinator
          ),

        liveHUD:
          Boolean(liveHUD),

        settingsPanel:
          Boolean(settingsPanel),

        analytics:
          Boolean(
            analyticsManager
          ),

        integrity:
          Boolean(
            integrityTester
          ),

        dbzScene:
          Boolean(
            dbzSceneManager
          ),

        dbzQueue:
          Boolean(
            dbzSceneQueue
          ),

        dbzEffects:
          Boolean(
            dbzEffectLayer
          )
      };
    }

    inspectUi() {
      return {
        pill:
          Boolean(
            document.getElementById(
              'bf-pill'
            )
          ),

        hud:
          Boolean(
            document.getElementById(
              'tfm-live-hud'
            )
          ),

        stats:
          Boolean(
            document.getElementById(
              'tfm-stats-panel'
            )
          ),

        settings:
          Boolean(
            document.getElementById(
              'tfm-settings-panel'
            )
          )
      };
    }

    inspect() {
      const parts =
        PartValidator.inspect();

      const modules =
        this.inspectModules();

      const ui =
        this.inspectUi();

      const sniperHealth =
        safeCall(
          () =>
            sniper?.health?.(),
          null,
          'sniper health inspection'
        );

      const systemHealth =
        safeCall(
          () =>
            healthMonitor
              ?.inspect?.(),
          null,
          'system health inspection'
        );

      const missingModules =
        Object.entries(
          modules
        )
          .filter(
            ([, available]) =>
              !available
          )
          .map(
            ([name]) =>
              name
          );

      const report = {
        timestamp:
          Date.now(),

        isoTime:
          new Date()
            .toISOString(),

        version:
          FINAL_VERSION,

        build:
          BUILD_NAME,

        parts,

        modules,

        ui,

        sniper:
          sniperHealth,

        health:
          systemHealth,

        missingModules,

        healthy:
          parts.complete &&
          modules.core &&
          modules.extension &&
          modules.eventManager &&
          modules.sniper &&
          (
            sniperHealth
              ?.state !==
            'DESTROYED'
          )
      };

      this.lastReport =
        report;

      this.auditCount +=
        1;

      Storage.set(
        'bf_v4FinalAudit',
        report
      );

      eventManager?.emit?.(
        'FINAL_AUDIT_COMPLETED',
        {
          report
        }
      );

      return report;
    }

    repairUi() {
      finalSettings =
        getFinalSettings();

      if (
        finalSettings
          .automaticallyRepairUi ===
        false
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const ui =
        this.inspectUi();

      if (!ui.pill) {
        core.pillButton
          ?.recreate?.();
      }

      if (!ui.hud) {
        liveHUD
          ?.create?.();
      }

      if (!ui.stats) {
        statsDashboard
          ?.create?.();
      }
    }

    repairSniper() {
      finalSettings =
        getFinalSettings();

      if (
        finalSettings
          .automaticallyRepairSniper ===
        false
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const health =
        safeCall(
          () =>
            sniper?.health?.(),
          null,
          'sniper repair inspection'
        );

      if (
        settings.get(
          'sniperEnabled'
        ) &&
        (
          !health ||
          health.state ===
            'DESTROYED' ||
          health.observerAttached ===
            false
        )
      ) {
        sniper
          ?.recover?.();
      }
    }

    async auditAndRepair(
      reason = 'scheduled'
    ) {
      let report =
        this.inspect();

      if (!report.healthy) {
        debugLogger?.warn?.(
          'Final runtime audit found an issue.',
          {
            reason,
            report
          }
        );

        this.repairUi();

        this.repairSniper();

        healthMonitor
          ?.recover?.();

        await wait(250);

        report =
          this.inspect();
      }

      return report;
    }

    start() {
      const interval =
        Math.max(
          5000,
          Number(
            getFinalSettings()
              .runtimeAuditIntervalMs
          ) || 15000
        );

      this.disposables
        .addInterval(
          setInterval(() => {
            this.auditAndRepair(
              'scheduled'
            );
          }, interval)
        );

      eventManager?.on?.(
        'WATCHDOG_RESET',
        () => {
          this.auditAndRepair(
            'watchdog'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager?.on?.(
        'HEALTH_WARNING',
        () => {
          this.auditAndRepair(
            'health-warning'
          );
        }
      );

      eventManager?.on?.(
        'V4_DESTROYED',
        () => {
          this.destroy();
        }
      );
    }

    destroy() {
      this.disposables
        .clear();
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // FINAL STARTUP COORDINATOR
  // ==========================================================

  class FinalStartupCoordinator {
    constructor(
      auditor
    ) {
      this.auditor =
        auditor;

      this.started =
        false;

      this.completed =
        false;

      this.startedAt =
        null;

      this.completedAt =
        null;

      this.report =
        null;
    }

    async run() {
      if (this.started) {
        return this.report;
      }

      this.started =
        true;

      this.startedAt =
        Date.now();

      finalSettings =
        getFinalSettings();

      debugLogger?.info?.(
        `${BUILD_NAME} final startup beginning.`
      );

      const partReport =
        PartValidator.inspect();

      if (
        !partReport.complete
      ) {
        debugLogger?.warn?.(
          'One or more v4 parts are missing.',
          partReport
        );

        liveHUD?.setStatus?.(
          `⚠️ Missing parts: ${partReport.missing.join(', ')}`,
          'warning'
        );

        eventToast?.show?.(
          `Missing part(s): ${partReport.missing.join(', ')}`,
          2600,
          'warning'
        );
      }

      if (
        finalSettings
          .startupRecovery !==
        false
      ) {
        safeCall(
          () =>
            healthMonitor
              ?.recover?.(),
          null,
          'startup health recovery'
        );

        safeCall(
          () =>
            sniper
              ?.recover?.(),
          null,
          'startup sniper recovery'
        );
      }

      await wait(350);

      const audit =
        await this.auditor
          .auditAndRepair(
            'final-startup'
          );

      let integrity =
        null;

      if (
        finalSettings
          .startupValidation !==
          false &&
        integrityTester
          ?.run
      ) {
        integrity =
          await safeCallAsync(
            () =>
              integrityTester.run(
                'final-startup'
              ),
            null,
            'startup integrity validation'
          );
      }

      const healthy =
        Boolean(
          audit?.healthy &&
          (
            !integrity ||
            integrity.healthy !==
              false
          )
        );

      this.completed =
        true;

      this.completedAt =
        Date.now();

      this.report = {
        build:
          BUILD_NAME,

        version:
          FINAL_VERSION,

        startedAt:
          this.startedAt,

        completedAt:
          this.completedAt,

        duration:
          this.completedAt -
          this.startedAt,

        parts:
          partReport,

        audit,

        integrity,

        healthy
      };

      Storage.set(
        'bf_v4FinalStartupReport',
        this.report
      );

      Storage.set(
        'bf_v4BuildComplete',
        true
      );

      Storage.set(
        'bf_v4BuildVersion',
        FINAL_VERSION
      );

      Storage.set(
        'bf_v4BuildCompletedAt',
        Date.now()
      );

      if (healthy) {
        liveHUD?.setStatus?.(
          '🟢 TheFreshMaker v4 ready',
          'success'
        );

        if (
          finalSettings
            .startupToast !==
          false
        ) {
          eventToast?.show?.(
            '✅ THEFRESHMAKER v4 READY',
            2200,
            'success'
          );
        }
      } else {
        liveHUD?.setStatus?.(
          '⚠️ v4 loaded with warnings',
          'warning'
        );

        if (
          finalSettings
            .startupToast !==
          false
        ) {
          eventToast?.show?.(
            '⚠️ v4 loaded with warnings',
            2400,
            'warning'
          );
        }
      }

      eventManager?.emit?.(
        'THEFRESHMAKER_V4_COMPLETE',
        {
          report:
            cloneValue(
              this.report
            )
        }
      );

      debugLogger?.info?.(
        `${BUILD_NAME} startup complete.`,
        this.report
      );

      return this.report;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // COMMAND REFERENCE
  // ==========================================================

  const COMMAND_REFERENCE = {
    system: [
      'TFM.snapshot()',
      'TFM.health()',
      'TFM.restart()',
      'TFM.fullRecovery()',
      'TFM.finalAudit()',
      'TFM.finalStartupReport()'
    ],

    sniper: [
      'TFM.enable()',
      'TFM.disable()',
      'TFM.scan()',
      'TFM.findButton()',
      'TFM.recover()'
    ],

    interface: [
      'TFM.settingsPanel()',
      'TFM.openControlCentre()',
      'TFM.openDbzControls()',
      'TFM.openDbzAudio()',
      'TFM.analytics.open()'
    ],

    dbz: [
      'TFM.dbz.testGoku()',
      'TFM.dbz.testFrieza()',
      'TFM.dbz.testBroly()',
      'TFM.dbzEffects.test()',
      'TFM.dbzQueue.status()'
    ],

    diagnostics: [
      'TFM.logs()',
      'TFM.exportLogs()',
      'TFM.eventHistory()',
      'TFM.integrity.run()',
      'TFM.analytics.summary()'
    ],

    shortcuts: {
      originalMenu:
        'Shift+M',

      v4ControlCentre:
        'Shift+V',

      dbzControls:
        'Shift+D',

      dbzAudio:
        'Shift+A',

      analytics:
        'Shift+X'
    }
  };

  // ==========================================================
  // INITIALISE FINAL SERVICES
  // ==========================================================

  const compatibilityBridge =
    new CompatibilityBridge();

  const duplicateSceneGuard =
    new DuplicateSceneGuard();

  const finalRuntimeAuditor =
    new FinalRuntimeAuditor();

  const finalStartupCoordinator =
    new FinalStartupCoordinator(
      finalRuntimeAuditor
    );

  extension.compatibilityBridge =
    compatibilityBridge;

  extension.duplicateSceneGuard =
    duplicateSceneGuard;

  extension.finalRuntimeAuditor =
    finalRuntimeAuditor;

  extension.finalStartupCoordinator =
    finalStartupCoordinator;

  extension.commandReference =
    COMMAND_REFERENCE;

  core.compatibilityBridge =
    compatibilityBridge;

  core.finalRuntimeAuditor =
    finalRuntimeAuditor;

  core.finalStartupCoordinator =
    finalStartupCoordinator;

  // ==========================================================
  // FINAL PUBLIC API
  // ==========================================================

  window.TFM = {
    ...(window.TFM || {}),

    version:
      FINAL_VERSION,

    build:
      BUILD_NAME,

    complete:
      true,

    commands() {
      console.table(
        COMMAND_REFERENCE
          .shortcuts
      );

      console.log(
        '[TheFreshMaker commands]',
        COMMAND_REFERENCE
      );

      return cloneValue(
        COMMAND_REFERENCE
      );
    },

    parts() {
      return PartValidator
        .inspect();
    },

    finalAudit() {
      return finalRuntimeAuditor
        .inspect();
    },

    async finalAuditAndRepair() {
      return finalRuntimeAuditor
        .auditAndRepair(
          'manual'
        );
    },

    finalStartupReport() {
      return cloneValue(
        finalStartupCoordinator
          .report
      );
    },

    compatibilityReport() {
      return cloneValue(
        compatibilityBridge
          .report
      );
    },

    updateFinalSettings(
      updates
    ) {
      finalSettings = {
        ...getFinalSettings(),
        ...(updates || {})
      };

      settings.set(
        'finalBuild',
        finalSettings
      );

      return cloneValue(
        finalSettings
      );
    },

    getFinalSettings() {
      return cloneValue(
        getFinalSettings()
      );
    },

    async emergencyRecovery() {
      liveHUD?.setStatus?.(
        '🛠️ Emergency recovery running',
        'warning'
      );

      dbzSceneQueue
        ?.clear?.(
          'emergency-recovery'
        );

      dbzSceneManager
        ?.cancel?.();

      dbzEffectLayer
        ?.clearParticles?.();

      core.pillButton
        ?.recreate?.();

      liveHUD
        ?.create?.();

      statsDashboard
        ?.create?.();

      sniper
        ?.recover?.();

      healthMonitor
        ?.recover?.();

      runtimeCoordinator
        ?.restart?.();

      await wait(400);

      const report =
        await finalRuntimeAuditor
          .auditAndRepair(
            'emergency-recovery'
          );

      liveHUD?.setStatus?.(
        report.healthy
          ? '🟢 Emergency recovery complete'
          : '⚠️ Recovery completed with warnings',
        report.healthy
          ? 'success'
          : 'warning'
      );

      eventToast?.show?.(
        report.healthy
          ? '✅ SYSTEM RECOVERED'
          : '⚠️ CHECK DIAGNOSTICS',
        1800,
        report.healthy
          ? 'success'
          : 'warning'
      );

      return report;
    },

    finalSnapshot() {
      return {
        application:
          'TheFreshMaker',

        version:
          FINAL_VERSION,

        build:
          BUILD_NAME,

        complete:
          true,

        timestamp:
          Date.now(),

        parts:
          PartValidator.inspect(),

        audit:
          finalRuntimeAuditor
            .inspect(),

        startup:
          cloneValue(
            finalStartupCoordinator
              .report
          ),

        settings:
          cloneValue(
            settings.data ||
            {}
          ),

        stats:
          safeCall(
            () =>
              statsManager
                ?.getStats?.(),
            null,
            'final stats snapshot'
          ),

        sniper:
          safeCall(
            () =>
              sniper
                ?.health?.(),
            null,
            'final sniper snapshot'
          ),

        analytics:
          safeCall(
            () =>
              analyticsManager
                ?.summary?.(),
            null,
            'final analytics snapshot'
          ),

        integrity:
          safeCall(
            () =>
              integrityTester
                ?.snapshot?.(),
            null,
            'final integrity snapshot'
          ),

        compatibility:
          cloneValue(
            compatibilityBridge
              .report
          )
      };
    }
  };

  // ==========================================================
  // FINAL BFHELPER EXPORT
  // ==========================================================

  window.BFHelper = {
    ...core,

    VERSION:
      FINAL_VERSION,

    BUILD:
      BUILD_NAME,

    COMPLETE:
      true,

    TheFreshMakerV4:
      extension,

    TFM:
      window.TFM,

    commandReference:
      COMMAND_REFERENCE,

    finalRuntimeAuditor,

    finalStartupCoordinator,

    compatibilityBridge,

    duplicateSceneGuard
  };

  // ==========================================================
  // DESTROY BRIDGE
  // ==========================================================

  eventManager?.on?.(
    'V4_DESTROYED',
    () => {
      finalRuntimeAuditor
        .destroy();

      duplicateSceneGuard
        .restore();

      Storage.set(
        'bf_v4DestroyedAt',
        Date.now()
      );
    }
  );

  // ==========================================================
  // FINAL START
  // ==========================================================

  finalStartupCoordinator
    .run()
    .catch(
      error => {
        console.error(
          '[TheFreshMaker v4] Final startup failed.',
          error
        );

        debugLogger?.error?.(
          'Final startup coordinator failed.',
          error
        );

        liveHUD?.setStatus?.(
          '❌ Final startup error',
          'error'
        );
      }
    );

  console.log(
    '%c TheFreshMaker v4.4.0 ',
    [
      'background:#071016',
      'color:#72ffe2',
      'font-size:16px',
      'font-weight:900',
      'padding:8px 14px',
      'border-radius:8px',
      'border:1px solid #00bfa5'
    ].join(';')
  );

  console.log(
    '%c Complete build loaded — Parts 1 through 30 ',
    [
      'color:#c7fff5',
      'font-size:12px',
      'font-weight:700'
    ].join(';')
  );

  console.log(
    '[TheFreshMaker] Type TFM.commands() for the command list.'
  );

  eventManager?.emit?.(
    'V4_PART_30_READY',
    {
      version:
        FINAL_VERSION,

      build:
        BUILD_NAME,

      complete:
        true,

      parts:
        PartValidator.inspect()
    }
  );
})();
